1czgid-claude-code-live-progress-bar.summary: A dark Claude Code composer (page #1a1a1a, a faintly lighter app band x10–1265, y235–485) holds a rounded #222 tray (x28–1248, y247–363, radius ~12) with two task rows above a bordered input box (x29–1248, y375–437, radius ~14, 1px #3a3a3a border, placeholder "Type / for commands", circle-dot record icon at right) and a toolbar row at y≈463 ("+", mic, chevron, "Auto" left; a "Progress" chip, "Opus 5.5", "Medium" and a static blue ring spinner right). Each task row is: a 6px status mark at x≈47, a white ~18px label, a full-radius 35px-tall #2c2c2c track (x383–1117), a percentage in mid-grey (~x1143–1188) and a grey × at x1218. The track carries short grey tick marks (stage subdivisions) and taller, lighter major ticks (stage boundaries); the done portion is a dot-matrix fill of small square pixels whose brightness twinkles constantly and grows denser toward a rounded stage pill (bold stage name + lighter "n/m") that sits at the leading edge. Row 1 "Start at zero, tick marks" holds purple "Tasks 3/5" 40% until ~12.9s, when its pill slides right to "Tasks 5/5" and the readout becomes 80%. Row 2 "Release pipeline" walks a 9-step pipeline: "Prepare 1/2" 0% → (≈0.75s) "Build 1/3" 22% → (≈3.25s) "Deploy 1/2" 56%, all purple; then (≈6.05s) the whole row turns amber with a "?" mark and "? Deploy 2/2" 67%; (≈8.85s) red with "!" and "× Verify 1/2" 78%; (≈11.5s) green with "✓" and "✓ Done 9/9" 100% filling the track. Each step the pill slides right over ~0.4–0.6s with the dot fill extending behind it, the label and percent swap at the start of the slide, and the colour of fill, pill, ticks and row mark change together. Nothing else moves; the spinner is static.

16febh-playful-feedback-toggle-buttons.summary:
A light-gray canvas (#f1f1f1) holds one centred pair of feedback buttons. Together they look like a pill split in two by a 12 px gap: the left half (thumbs-up) runs x 174–354 and the right half (thumbs-down) runs x 366–546, both y 294–426. Each half is 180×132. Its outer end is a full semicircle (radius ~66) and its inner corners are only slightly rounded (~8 px). The fill is an off-white #f7f7f7 with a hairline gray border and a soft drop shadow underneath. Each half holds a solid black glyph about 60 px across. The thumbs-up points up and right; the thumbs-down is its mirror. A black macOS-style arrow cursor with a white outline acts out four clicks:
1. **Like on, ~0.45s.** The left half shrinks to about 0.9 scale. From 0.65s to 0.95s the glyph turns dark green, grows to about 2× and leaps up out of the button, its top reaching y≈203. Meanwhile a mint radial glow fills the button.
2. **Glyph lands, 1.0–1.25s.** The glyph drops back, turns bright green (#0dbc39) and settles on the glow.
3. **Like off, ~1.85s.** The button shrinks again. The glyph darkens to deep green, then black, and the glow fades. The button is neutral by 2.35s.
4. **Dislike on, ~2.95s.** The cursor moves to the right half and clicks. The button shrinks, and from 3.05s to 3.35s the glyph goes dark red, then bright red (#e5173f). It wobbles in place (it does not fly), and a pink radial glow fills the button.
5. **Dislike off, ~4.15s.** A second click darkens the red glyph back to black and clears the glow. Everything is neutral by 4.6s.

The only moving parts are the cursor, the press scale, the glyph colour, scale and position, and the glow.

10d4te-animated-sidebar-menu.summary: A single, centred accordion sidebar on a near-white #fcfcfc page (faint 1px #eaeaea frame edge). A 2px light-grey vertical rail runs at x≈571 from y≈229 to y≈937. Right of it, 86px further in at x≈657, sit three section headings in a ~36px medium-weight sans (Inter-like): "Transactional Email", "Email Analytics", "AI Email Templates". Only one section is open at a time. The open heading is near-black. The closed headings are mid-grey (#9c9c9c), 110px apart. A 5px × 53px accent bar sits on the rail beside the open heading. It is orange for section 1, blue for section 2 and violet for section 3. Under the open heading is a tree of three sub-items, 89px apart. Each has a 34px line icon and a ~32px label at x≈778. A thin vertical connector at x≈658 has a rounded elbow (~20px radius) into a short stub ending at x≈700 for each row. The connector is painted in the section's accent colour from its top down to the active row's elbow; below that it stays light grey. The active sub-item has a bold near-black label and an accent-coloured icon. Inactive items are regular weight, grey text, with grey duotone icons (grey stroke, pale fill). A black macOS-style arrow cursor with a soft shadow hovers each item in turn. Motion: inside a section, the hovered item becomes active roughly every 1.2s. The coloured connector stretches or shrinks to the new row's elbow while the old item fades to grey and the new one turns bold and coloured (~0.2s). Every ~3.6s the menu moves to the next section (2.45–2.9s, 5.95–6.4s, 9.9–10.2s). The old submenu collapses in height and fades, clipped. The next heading slides into place, the new submenu expands below it with clipped reveal, and the accent bar glides down the rail 110px with a fast ease-out (296→407→517), then jumps back up 221px to 296 at the loop. Headings never change x. Only their y and grey/black colour change.

11sur7-invoice-date-picker-interaction.summary: A centred invoice-payment screen on a pale grey (#f3f3f5) canvas. Top: a small tracked grey eyebrow "NORTHWIND PTY LTD · $1,572.50", a bold dark title "Invoice FUI-0067" and a grey one-line helper. Under it sits a large white rounded card (≈462×273, radius ≈60) with a soft glossy top-lit fill and a wide diffuse shadow. Its top-left label is "PAID" in spaced grey caps, its top-right corner holds a red dot, and the body holds three iOS-style wheel columns (day / month / year). Each column has a light-grey pill behind the selected row. Rows away from the centre blur and fade, and grey caps labels DAY / MONTH / YEAR sit underneath. Below the card: a bold date line, a segmented tab control (Paid active as a white chip; Received, Approved, Due), a thin divider, five colour swatches with a ring around the selected red one, a black pill "Mark as paid" button and a tiny "or press Enter" hint. Motion: a grey translucent cursor dot drags the day wheel up twice, 13→14 (≈0.4–1.0s) and 14→15 (≈1.1–1.5s), and the date line updates each time. At ≈1.9s the button is clicked. From 2.05 to 3.0s the page gives way to a camera move into a 3D scene: a white A4 invoice lies tilted in perspective, and the picker card has become a thick 3D rubber-stamp block with a black base. Around 3.2–3.7s the block presses down onto the paper and lifts, leaving a red double-ruled "PAID / 15 SEP 2026" stamp at a slight clockwise tilt. About 4.2s a white toast "● Marked as paid · 15 Sep 2026  Undo  Done" rises at the bottom. Done is pressed at ≈4.9–5.2s. From 5.45 to 6.1s the toast fades, the block leaves upward, and the paper flattens and shrinks to a centred upright sheet. By ≈6.2–6.7s the header returns ≈38px higher with a red-dot status line "Marked as paid on Tuesday, 15 September 2026", and two buttons appear below the sheet: grey "Download PDF" and black "Next invoice". The rest of the clip holds still.

brtnu9-cloudflare-brand-refresh.summary: A 30 s brand-film in seven scenes on a full-bleed 1920x1080 stage. 0–2 s: flat Cloudflare orange (#ea451a) with white dashed construction guides (one vertical, one horizontal) and a thin white outlined four-point sparkle that slides and stretches while a thin white rectangle and faint circles sketch the cloud's construction. ~2.2 s: the construction resolves into the solid cream Cloudflare cloud logo (orange four-point sparkle cut through its base) centred at ~[513,356,736,338] on a mottled orange grain. ~3.5 s: the logo shrinks to a small mark above centre, the background turns into a dot-matrix screen (rows of tiny light dashes about 10 px apart) and a warm yellow glow rises from the bottom centre. White centred sans text types in word by word: "Everything we learned from" (5 s), then "powering 8% of the Internet." whose number counts up to 20%. ~8.5 s: a small cream pill "Start building" appears and scales up until it fills the frame (10.4–10.9 s); its rim and the outer glyphs break into a coarse pixel mosaic. ~11.3 s: the camera pushes into the letters (huge blurred maroon strokes), then cuts to a cream (#fcf8f2) canvas where a red arrow button leads to a node diagram drawn with dashed bezier links: Workflow, Compute, Workers AI and Storage nodes, then a wide canvas (18.5 s) with User A/B, Compute, a route list, Dispatch Namespace, Data & Storage and Coordinator, all slowly zooming out. ~20–22 s: "Trusted by the teams you trust" over a row of customer logos. ~22.5–25 s: "Go from localhost → global in minutes" where the middle words scramble in orange outline letters. 25.6 s: hard cut back to orange and a rotating dot-matrix globe with white pin badges, which then zooms in under "Region: Earth" (~27.5 s). ~29 s: a cream dot-grid canvas with PLAYER 1/PLAYER 2 cursors and a dashed image frame. Type is a neo-grotesk sans for headlines and a monospace for diagram labels. Corners are sharp everywhere except the fully rounded pill and the rounded route box.

1wdmnr-collaborative-cursor-portfolio-in.summary: A portfolio intro staged as a live Figma-style canvas on a flat #f2f2f2 page. From 0 to about 4 s a single white artboard (#fdfdfd, 1 px blue #1e90ff selection outline with four small square white handles at its corners, a small blue "Portfolio" frame label above its top-left at x≈235 y≈271, and a blue pill dimension badge under the bottom edge) is resized by a purple multiplayer cursor labelled "Alim" from 1076 × 430 (0.5 s, box ≈234,288 → 1461,780) to 1100 × 440 (from about 1 s, box 234,288 → 1488,791). An orange cursor labelled "Client" sits under the artboard. Inside it the name "Alim Joldaspayev" types in letter by letter (≈1.0–1.9 s) as a very heavy, tightly tracked grotesk (~130 px cap height, near-black #0a0a0a, centred at x≈862, baseline ≈550) with a blue text caret, then a grey (#8a8a8a) subtitle "UX/UI Designer, Framer expert" types in under it (≈2.0–3.5 s, ~36 px, centred, y≈598–632). The Client cursor drifts up to x≈862 y≈678 meanwhile. A white rounded "Skip" button sits bottom-right at all times during the intro. Around 3.8–4.3 s the type fades to light grey and the artboard washes out to a full-white page, then at ≈4.45 s it cuts to the Works page: a 3D curved carousel of 17 project frames receding left and right in perspective (photo of a retro Mac on a sunset hill at far left, Meridian engraved-viaduct footer, dark Clasify panels at right), a centred tilted white "How this works" note card tucked into a pale envelope with a black "Got it" pill, a breadcrumb "Alim Joldaspayev / Works" top-left, and a white floating pill nav centred at the bottom ("Works" active in blue, About, Contact, ‹ 1/17 ›, ?). The Client cursor clicks "Got it" at ≈7.2 s; at ≈8.7–9.3 s the card drops away and the first frame "Offline / 404" swings out of perspective to face the viewer flat at 337,175 → 1363,815 with a blue selection outline and "View on X ↗" chip below; a video plays inside it (TV colour bars appear, clouds spell "404"). Every ≈1.3–1.5 s afterwards the carousel slides left one frame (10.5–11.4 s to Meridian / Footer 2/17, 11.9–12.6 s to Driftline / Integrations 3/17, and on through QED, desert, pixel-grid motion spheres), the counter incrementing, the Alim cursor riding the active frame's bottom-right handle. Around 21 s the page switches to About: a portrait card "Hi, I'm Alim.", a bio paragraph "I create modern digital experiences for startups, SaaS, AI, fintech, and personal brands.", stat cards "30+ / 62+ / $25M" and an experience card, which slide in and enlarge through the end.

1ilia9-dark-booking-calendar-modal.summary: A 960x720 clip of a dark booking modal floating over a blurred, near-white marketing page ("website, in six weeks." heading and grey paragraphs, all heavily blurred, #fcfcfd ground, a 4px near-black band along the bottom edge). The modal is one fixed card at [143,233,686,471], fill #141414, ~16px corner radius, with a 34px round grey close button holding a thin white × centred at the bottom (485,677). It has two states that swap inside the same card without the card moving. State A, "Book a call" (0–0.35s and from 20.3s on): left column with the 20px white title "Book a call", a grey pill with a globe icon "Central Time CST" (later "Eastern European Time EET"), two short white paragraphs and a "See pricing" pill; a middle month calendar "October 2026" with < > arrows, Mon–Sun headers, 6 rows of dates, past and unavailable dates dim grey, today "2" in a small yellow (#f9e148) circle, the selected "6" in a white rounded square with black type; a right column "Tue October 6" listing time slots with hairline dividers. State B, "Select your timezone" (0.6s–20.3s): left column with the white title, an underlined search field "Any city or time zone", a scrolling list of zones (name in white-grey, "ABBR · time" smaller and dimmer below, ~48px rows, hairline dividers, a fade at the bottom), the selected row on a #282828 rounded tile, then "Cancel" text and a 36px-tall pill button "Select CST" (grey #262626, turning yellow #f9e148 with black type once the user picks a different zone); a thin vertical divider at x≈382; the right side is a 378px wireframe globe drawn in thin grey lines (meridians and parallels) with continents as a dot grid, a lens-shaped meridian slice for the current zone drawn as a lighter translucent band with a thin light outline and brighter dots inside, and white city dots with leader lines to small white labels. Motion: at 0.4s the Book-a-call content clears to an empty card (0.5s), the timezone list appears at 0.6s and the globe fades up from faint (1.0s) to full (1.5s); hover puts a grey tile behind the hovered row; the list scrolls up (2.45–2.85s, ~99px, then ~14px more by 3.25s); the globe spins about its vertical axis when a zone is chosen (4.15–5.2s, 5.95–6.35s and on through the clip), carrying dots, labels and slice with it; at ~5.9s choosing Mountain Time flips the button to yellow "Select MST" instantly; the user then visits other zones (EET, BST, WET, ACST, PKT…) with the globe turning to each; at ~19.7s clicking "Select EET" swaps the card back to Book a call with the EET pill, a dimmed calendar and "Loading times..." for a moment (20.3s), then evening slots 4:00 PM–11:30 PM and newly bright dates 10, 17, 24 appear (20.4s).

x0hdfi-punched-boarding-pass.summary: A dark iPhone travel app ("Santorini" explore screen) sits centred on a soft, blurred blue-and-white cloudy sky (phone 300–782 x, 35–1045 y). The screen stacks: status bar (9:41 + moon, Dynamic Island, signal/wifi/battery), a full-width Santorini bell-tower photo (315–767 x, 49–547 y, rounded bottom corners) with a round dark map button at top-left, a bold condensed white "Santorini" title, a small-caps meta line "14 SEP · LANDING 17:30 · SUNSET 19:27", a row of four dark rounded quick-action tiles (Flights, Hotels, Cars, Activities) preceded at the screen's left edge by a tiny gold boarding-pass stub, a "Top destinations / View all" header over photo cards (Paris, Bali, Kyoto), and a floating dark glass tab bar (Explore active in purple, Saved, Trips, Profile). At ~0.4s the gold stub slides out of the left screen edge and unfolds into a full punched boarding pass (~338–745 x, 676–914 y): a main section with ELSEWHERE AIR, a BUSINESS pill, LHR→JTR with a dashed arc and plane, passenger/flight/gate/seat fields, and a stub section beyond a dotted tear line flanked by two semicircular punch notches, holding JTR, SEAT 14A, BOARDS 11:05 and a barcode. As it opens (0.4–0.8s) the quick-action row is pushed down under it and the photo, title and meta line dim to about half brightness. From ~0.9s to 7.2s the pass rests but rocks subtly in 3D (edges shifting by up to ~8px) while a soft metallic sheen drifts over the gold, as a Metal shader would. At 7.25–7.55s everything reverses: the pass shrinks back into the left-edge stub, the dim lifts, and the quick-action row and destinations slide back up. The background and phone frame never move.

1apkr1-ai-thinking-process-ui.summary: A single left-aligned 'thinking trace' sits on a flat #e9e9e9 page with no card or panel: a header row (grey chevron at x≈163, then 'Thinking' in near-black with a grey seconds counter), and below it a vertical timeline. The rail and its icons run down a column at x≈163; labels start at x=215; rows are 55 px apart; type is Inter-like, ~22 px. Completed steps are mid-grey with small grey dots. Sub-steps are indented to an icon column at x≈193 and drawn lighter, joined to the rail by thin curved branches: a dashed one to the 'Dead end' row (× icon), and a solid bracket around 'Ran 42 auth tests' / '4 tests touch session.ts' that rejoins at a hollow ring on 'Merged the test results'. Under the first step sits a row of white pill chips (radius about 21 px, 42 px tall): 'TS router.ts', 'TS auth.ts', a teal React-atom 'Button.tsx', a globe 'Routing – Next.js docs', then plain grey '+3 more'. The whole stack stays vertically centred in the frame. Each time a row is added (about every 1.3–1.5 s), the stack glides up about 27 px with a ~250 ms ease-out, and the new row fades in from a blur. The active row is near-black and carries a spinning open arc around a dot (a spinning arc around a magnifier for the search step). A light shimmer band sweeps across the active label and across 'Thinking'. Present-tense labels flip to past tense when a step completes ('Searching' → 'Searched', 'Reading 7 of 7 files' → 'Read 7 files about routing and auth'), and the counter ticks 0s → 14s. At about 14.2 s the header becomes 'Thought for 14s' and the last row becomes a blue filled check with 'Finished thinking' plus a faint '4 modules to deepen · 3 steps', which then holds to the end.

1b68k7-bee-garden-progress-slider.summary: A single, centred progress slider on a flat near-black page (#181818). Across the top of the 1030 px wide component sit two labels on one baseline (y≈213): "Garden" left-aligned at x≈209 in light grey and the percentage readout right-aligned to x≈1262 in a dimmer grey. At y≈440 runs the track from x=232 to x≈1238: the unfilled part is a barely visible 5 px #1c1c1c rail with rounded ends; the filled part is a 6–7 px sage-green bar (#6b9267) with rounded ends, growing from the left. Short grey-green grass blades stand along the filled length, and a meadow of flat vector flowers (yellow tulip, salmon poppies with dark centres, white daisies with yellow centres, lavender spikes, blue and lilac forget-me-not clusters, pink tulips, magenta poppies, a pink dahlia, a lilac aster) on thin green stems with leaf pairs fills the area above the green, heads reaching y≈285–390. A flat cartoon bee (yellow body, two dark stripes, pale grey translucent wing, curved antenna, dark eye) rides the track as the thumb. Motion: the user drags the cursor. Moving right (0–3.9s, 3%→68%), the fill and percentage follow the cursor, flowers sprout in order as the fill reaches them (stem first, then the head), and the bee trails behind with an eased lag, facing right. Dragging left (4.45–5.7s, 69%→24%) the fill shrinks, flowers past the edge burst into petals that drift up and to the right and fade while bare stems linger briefly, and the bee flips to face left, still lagging. A jump to 100% (~5.9–6.6s) grows a wave of tall stems across the right before their heads appear. Then a slow retreat to about 68% (~7.2–9.0s) and a slow advance to 98% by the end (9.3–12.4s), again shedding petals on the way back and regrowing on the way forward.

b0jj7f-gpu-pods-card-animation.summary: A centred 1080×1080 light composition: a #eeeeee backdrop with a faint 3×3 grid of hairlines (x≈234/847, y≈234/847). It holds one off-white card (#f9f9f9, ~16px radius, soft white rim and very soft shadow) at [293,286,494,509]. Inside the card's top is an inset illustration panel [302,295,476,291] with a barely visible 1px border. It shows a skeuomorphic grey GPU: a brushed-silver rounded board [370,382,237,100] with two dark 7-blade fans in grey rings, four dark corner screws, and white heatsink fin strips peeking above and below. A row of tiny tick dots runs above it, and a long soft drop shadow falls toward the lower right. A short black cable runs from the right side into a small square port plate with four screws and a dark round socket. Below, left-aligned at x=321, sit the black semibold title "GPU Pods", two lines of mid-grey body copy, and a dark near-black gradient "Deploy Pod" button (~8px radius, white label, soft drop shadow). Motion: at 0s the panel is empty. From ~0.1s to 0.3s a pale, flat, low-contrast GPU fades in with its tick rows. Around 0.3–0.5s a pale port plate and cable appear to the right. From ~0.5s to 1.0s the drawing gains depth: fans darken, screws, fins and shadow appear, the cable turns black, and the plate settles ~5px left to x≈645. From then to 7.8s the only motion is both fans spinning continuously. Card, text and button never move.

1lnwpl-krea-agent-onboarding-flow.summary: A Krea desktop app window (1460x900 at 90,90, ~16px radius, white #fcfcfc) sits centred on a flat #e8e8e8 page. For the first 22.5s the app behind is blurred and greyed and a centred onboarding modal (469,321, 703x439, ~24px radius, white) floats over it. The modal is split in two. The left half is a 345x428 image panel inset 6px with ~16px radius. The right half holds the copy, with a close × top-right, a secondary button bottom-left and a black primary button bottom-right. Step 0 'Welcome to Krea Agent' (0–8.55s): the left panel is a pale blue-mint gradient with a white pill prompt ('Design a campaign', black + button). Its text types itself and cycles ('Restyle this look' by 8.3s). Dozens of colourful artwork cards (paintings, toys, a red head, a pasta tin, a tennis racket) drift slowly over the blurred backdrop and across the panel. At 8.55s the modal cuts to step 1 '1 of 2 Connect your tools'. The floating art vanishes. The left panel becomes a soft blue-to-lilac gradient with small white app-icon tiles (Slack, Gmail, Notion, GitHub, YouTube, OneDrive) scattered in an arc around a pill that reads 'Use [G-Drive] G-Drive assets'. The right column lists Notion / Slack / G-drive rows with + buttons and a 'Browse apps' link. During ~12–17s the modal shows the expanded full-width app browser: a search field and a two-column grid of 8 apps (Linear checked). It then returns. Around 17.5s it moves to step 2 '2 of 2 Upload your assets' with a lilac-pink photo collage, an asset-check pill ('Check assets from 📁 SS26 Supreme') and a 'Let's go' button. At ~22.55s the modal disappears and the blur lifts within about 0.1s, leaving the sharp home screen. It has a left icon rail and a misty sea image, the heading 'What do you want to create this afternoon?', a large rounded composer, a right panel of Files/Generations/Skills/New side chat rows, and a 4-up Templates row. From 23.85s to 24.65s the page scrolls ~665px into a dense grid of template photos while the composer docks at the bottom (y 876–978). A hovered card shows a dark caption 'Bakery Rebrand'. From 25.0s to 26s the page scrolls back to the top.

14scng-flashnet-network-landing-page.summary: A light hero (#fcfcfc page, a #f7f7f7 band below y≈958) with a left text column at x≈288: a two-tone headline, "The network of networks." in near-black (#111) and "Flashnet unifies everything." in mid grey (#7a7a7a), both ≈62px; a 3-line grey body paragraph at y≈694–758 and a flat light-grey "Read the docs" button at (289,793). The right ~60% holds a radial network diagram in perspective: a hub at (1437,866), a white soft-shadowed oval holding the black Flashnet bolt mark, with thin pale-mint concentric ellipses and radial spokes drawn as pairs of hairlines, all fading towards the edges. Five glossy 3D isometric chain tiles (rounded squares with a darker extruded side and a soft drop shadow, white or gradient glyph on top) sit in slots along an arc: the lead slot at (888,540) is bigger, fully saturated, and has a white pill label above it ("Ethereum", then "Lightning", "Solana", "Tron"), and a brighter double green spoke connects it to the hub; the other slots are at ≈(1143,453), (1443,420), (1742,456). Motion: a carousel that steps every ~4s. In each step (1.75–2.15, 5.8–6.15, 9.8–10.1s) every tile slides one slot left/down along the arc. The old lead loses its label, fades to translucent grey and slides out down-left to ≈(800,608). The next tile grows and saturates into the lead slot, and a new tile slides in from the right edge. Between steps the tiles hold still while short mint comet streaks run along the spokes and a mint ellipse ring pulses outward from the hub. The headline, body and button never move.

1ucv5m-surprise-me-button-hover.summary: A quiet, near-white (#f9f9f9) portfolio footer. A card at the top is cut off by the frame's top edge (outer card x 207–596, bottom at y≈123): a pale grey frame, inside it a cream (#e5dec6) panel with rounded bottom corners, and down its middle a narrow strip of grainy sepia footage of a person walking down a corridor (x 353–451). Under the card the caption row reads "Daniel White" (black, left at x 214) and "danielwhite.uk" (grey, right at x 450), both at y≈160. In the centre at x≈609, y≈273 sits a white pill button, "Surprise me" (≈176×63 px), with a soft drop shadow. At y≈513 a footer row reads "curated by shawn" on the left ("curated by" grey; "shawn" black with a thin grey underline) and a monospaced grey clock "17:51:18" on the right that ticks once a second. A photographic band of clover, leaves and small lilac flowers fills the bottom ≈120 px across the full width. Its ragged top edge rises from about y 690 to about y 605 between 0 and 0.6 s, then the leaves keep swaying for the rest of the clip. Hover does two things at once. The pill blurs and fades away, and a large heavy sans "Surprise me" (≈512×95 px, centred on the button) blurs into focus. Its letters are filled with dense green foliage and carry a dark, soft drop shadow below. Each swap takes about 0.15–0.3 s, and moving off reverses it: the big text blurs out and the pill comes back sharp. The hovers fall at about 2.6–2.75 s, 4.55–4.7 s and 5.8–6.0 s, with exits at about 3.45–3.6 s, 5.25–5.4 s and 6.9–7.5 s. The pill also drifts a few px toward the cursor (magnetic), for example to x≈511 at 4.05 s.

ubbl4w-animated-booking-calendar.summary: A single centred booking card (598x702 at 386,190, ~40px radius, light grey #f2f2f2 shell with a soft wide drop shadow on a #fcfcfc page) holds a header row ("Trip Dates" bold left, a coloured pill badge right), a white inner panel (568x543, ~24px radius) with CHECK-IN / CHECK-OUT columns split by a thin vertical rule, a 50x3 coloured underline under the active field, a hairline divider, the heading "September 2026" (month black, year grey), a 7-column weekday header M T W T F S S and a 5-row day grid (column pitch 74px from x=462, row pitch 57px from y=533; Sep 1-3 greyed, a small grey dot under 4 marks today). Below the panel sit four outlined preset pills (Weekend, 3 nights, 1 week, 2 weeks) and a grey "Clear" link. A selected range shows two 50px solid-colour knobs with a white ring and soft shadow at check-in and check-out, joined by a pale tint band that is a rounded pill per week row; day numbers inside the band take the accent colour. The accent colour is themed by preset: Weekend orange (#f38b05 knobs, pale yellow band and pill), 3 nights green, 1 week and free picks blue, 2 weeks purple; badge, underline, knobs, band and the active preset pill all recolour together, crossfading. Motion: clicking a day springs the knob across the grid (e.g. 9 to 10, 74px in about 0.3s with overshoot), the band grows/shrinks with it, hovering previews the range in tint with a grey hover disc, the underline slides 276px between the CHECK-IN and CHECK-OUT fields, and field values and the badge text roll vertically (old text slides up and fades as the new text rises in). The clip loops: Clear (0.9s) resets to "Add date", then Weekend, 3 nights, manual picks, 1 week, 2 weeks, and back to 21 nights.

10qjw2-ai-node-based-workflow-canvas.summary: A dark node-graph canvas (#131516 with a faint dot grid about 37 px apart) shown wide: a Prompt node top-left (89,119, 310x236) with an inset text box, a "Random noise" node cut off by the left edge (0,318, 249x140), a Sampler node below (161,451, 309x139), and a Processing node on the right (609,105, 322x300) with three input ports (conditioning, noise, sampler) on its left edge and a grey "Awaiting inputs" status line. Cards are #1d1e20-ish, radius about 16 px, with a 1 px lighter border and a soft drop shadow. Type is a light-grey sans: titles white about 15 px semibold, labels grey about 13 px. Output ports are white dots 12 px across on each card's right edge. The clip is a cursor wiring sequence with camera cuts. At 0.4s it cuts to a 1.7x close-up of the Processing input column. A white cable is dragged from Prompt's conditioning port, and a yellow zig-zag lightning spark jumps from the cable tip to the target port, which shows a yellow ring. On release (~1.0s) the cable and both port dots turn yellow, the target gets a double ring, and a yellow glow sweeps along Processing's left edge. At ~1.55s it cuts back to wide, and a yellow check appears at the right of the conditioning row. The noise cable repeats this in pink (~2.65–2.95s, pink check), then the sampler cable in purple (~4.1–4.25s), after which the status reads "All inputs ready". At ~5.0s it cuts to the close-up again, and cables are re-dragged and re-snap in new colours: conditioning turns orange (~5.75–6.15, orange glow, "All inputs ready"), noise turns cyan (~6.45–7.75), then noise turns yellow (~7.95–8.75). While a cable is being dragged it is white and the status falls back to "Awaiting inputs". Each colour comes with a glow sweep around the Processing card edge.

qwvw1m-ai-thinking-animations.summary: A single centred loader on a flat light-grey page (#f7f7f7, a 1 px grey hairline at the very top and bottom edge of the frame). At the centre sits an isometric 5 x 5 grid of square columns (footprint diamond from x 553 to 1009, front corner at 782,660), each column a white top (#fdfdfd), a light-grey left face (~#e0e0e0) and a paler right face (~#ebebeb), drawn with 1 px mid-grey outlines and no shadow or gradient. The columns rise and sink smoothly and continuously in three patterns that each run about 5.2 s: 0–5.2 s a diagonal checker wave (neighbouring columns alternate high and low and the crest travels across the grid); 5.3–10.4 s a row wave (whole rows along the left-to-right axis rise together into terraces/steps that roll back and forth); 10.5–16.4 s a concentric ring pattern (the outer ring, inner ring and single centre column rise at different times, the centre popping up as a tower). Below the grid, centred at x≈781 and baseline ≈795, a single line of medium-grey sans-serif type (~28 px, Inter-like, regular weight) cycles through "Searching memories...", "Recalling previous context...", "Processing..." in each pattern. Each label carries a soft lighter shimmer band sweeping left to right across its letters; labels arrive and leave with a left-to-right blur wipe (the leading letters sharp, the trailing edge a horizontal motion blur), with roughly 0.3–0.5 s of empty space between labels.

15xcfn-toggle-animation.summary: A single oversized skeuomorphic toggle switch sits centred on a flat pale blue-grey canvas (#eff1f5), with nothing else on the page except the macOS arrow cursor. The track is a full pill, 325 x 174 px at x 555–879, y 451–625. It is recessed into the surface: a dark slate inner shadow (#8f8f9d) runs along its top and left rim and fades to a flat body of #d4d9e0 when off, or #85bd6f leaf green when on, and a soft lilac-grey drop shadow pools under its bottom edge. The knob is a raised white disc, ~151 px across, with an almost flat #f0f0f0 face and a thicker grey lip (#cfcfcf to #e6e6e6) along its lower-right edge, so it reads as a thick coin. It sits 11 px inside the track, at x 567 when off and x 717 when on. The cursor drifts in and clicks the switch four times: on at ~2.85s, off at ~5.05s, on at ~7.05s, off at ~9.45s. Between clicks the switch holds still. On each click the knob slides ~150 px across in about 150 ms with an ease. The track colour lags behind it, crossfading between grey and green over ~350 ms and passing through a washed-out pale sage (#b0c9ad) on the way. The clip ends at rest in the off state from ~9.8s to 12.67s.

1ad1ih-dither-effect-experiment.summary: A dark chat composer sits on a flat #202020 canvas: one near-black card (#0e0e0e, ~18 px left corner radius, soft dark drop shadow) starting at x 196, y 211 and running off the right edge, 249 px tall. Across its top is a 49 px status row: a 3x3 dot-grid icon and a ~16 px status line ("Looking at Workspace") tinted with the colour of the current mode. A thin divider sits under it at y ≈ 260. Below that is a grey 22 px placeholder, "Ask anything, or / for a command". Along the bottom is a '+' button, a rounded mode pill (Automate is green, Creative amber, Web blue: tinted fill, 1 px border in the same hue, icon, label, chevron) and the model picker (coral asterisk, 'Claude Opus 5' in light grey, a dimmer 'High', chevron). The signature effect is a dither: the status row carries an ordered-dither halftone wash of small square dots in the mode colour that fades out to the right. Where the cursor is, a looser cluster of bright white pixel dots appears and travels with it. It reads as a pixel-grid halftone, not a blur or a smooth gradient. The story: from 0 to 1.7 s the cursor hovers over the status row. At ~1.75–1.85 s the Automate pill is clicked and a dropdown fades/scales in above the pill (Web, Automate ✓, Creative), and the cursor hovers Creative. At ~2.4–2.55 s Creative is clicked: the menu fades and drifts down out of view, the pill becomes amber 'Creative' and narrows by ~12 px (the model picker slides left ~12 px), and the status line dithers over into amber 'Initiating Creative mode'. The status later falls back to 'Looking at Workspace' in amber. At ~4.75 s the menu opens again with Creative checked. At ~5.6 s Web is chosen: the pill turns blue 'Web' (narrower still, model picker at x ≈ 455), the status reads blue 'Initiating Web mode' and the menu fades out.

1yi26a-accordion-faq-interaction.summary: A centred FAQ section on a warm off-white page (#e5e1d9, lighter towards the top centre). It has a bold near-black title "Frequently asked questions" and a grey one-line subtitle, and below them a realistic red piano accordion about 773 px wide. The top red marbled panel holds a 15-white / 10-black key keyboard in a black rounded frame. The bellows are the FAQ itself: five white rounded question cards stacked at a 65 px pitch, with dark fold lines between them, taupe metallic chevron pleats on both sides and a silver pill stud on each fold. The bottom red marbled panel carries a cream parallelogram plate of 48 domed black bass buttons (4×12). Silver corner caps sit on all four corners, and a dark stitched leather strap with a soft shadow hangs underneath. The whole block stays vertically centred, so it re-centres as it grows. Motion: the clip opens on a squeezed accordion (cards are thin strips). It springs open from 0.37 to 0.72 s, overshooting to 587 px and settling at 572 px by 1.05 s, while the question text fades in from the top down. At 2.05 s the strap is dragged down, which stretches the bellows from the top (bottom panel +114 px, fold gaps widen). On release at 2.5 s it snaps back past rest to a compressed 400 px at 2.82 s, rebounds to 646 px and settles at ~578 px by 3.4 s. Items then open one at a time, each symmetric about the centre (title rises ~15 px per open): refunds at 3.8 s, cancel at 4.5 s, plan at 5.25 s. On each open the + rotates into a −, the grey answer fades in, chord keys tint on the keyboard, and for the third open an "E minor 7" pill appears. The state holds from 5.4 to 9.1 s, with only the red marble flowing. The items close in reverse order (9.15, 9.6, 10.1 s). The cursor plays keys (11–12 s). A second stretch runs from 13.25 to 13.8 s, then the accordion collapses fully to the squeezed state (14.0–14.25 s), holds until 14.8 s, and springs open again with overshoot to 609 px, settling at 574 px by 15.3 s.

zwq08-spotlight-signup-form.summary: A single dark signup card sits centred on a near-black (#0b0b0b) canvas ruled with a faint 152 px grid of thin grey lines and edge tick marks. The card [245,216,585,650] is a slightly lighter charcoal (#161616–#181818) with ~40 px corners and a soft 1 px lighter rim. Inside, left-aligned at x=301: the white semibold heading "Let's create your account" (~32 px), then three label+input pairs ("Full Name", "Work Email", "Password", grey ~15 px labels) with near-black 472x56 inputs of ~8 px radius and grey placeholders, and a full-width silver gradient "Sign Up" button (472x56) with dark semibold text. Two small outline stage-spotlight lamps hang from the card's top corners (about x 262–310 and 762–812, y 226–295), hung from a small bracket on a thin line. Motion: at ~1.05–1.25 s the cursor clicks Full Name; both lamps swing inward and switch on, throwing warm amber volumetric cones with drifting dust specks onto the focused input, which turns a warm gold-tan with a bright top edge highlight, while everything else (heading, other labels, inputs, the Sign Up button) dims to ~30–40% brightness and a brief warm horizontal flash line crosses the card at y≈277. "Tushti Sachdeva" is typed letter by letter (~2.2–5.3 s). At ~5.3–5.5 s focus jumps to Work Email: the lamps re-aim steeper, the cones now land on the email field, the name field returns to dark with dimmed text. "contact@tushti.fyi" is typed (~5.6–11.3 s). At ~11.5–11.65 s focus jumps to Password; the lamps aim almost straight down and the cones hit the password field; 10 dots are typed (~11.8–13.4 s). At ~13.45 s the Sign Up button snaps back to bright silver while the lights remain on. At ~14.75–14.9 s the lights fade out (cones turning a dimmer orange as they go), the password field goes dark, and every text and the heading return to full brightness; the lamps return to unlit outlines. The card itself never moves.

i61wwn-painterly-finance-app-onboarding.summary: A single mobile screen centred on a near-white (#fdfdfd) canvas: a rounded phone panel (656,200 → 970,883, corner radius ~40 px) filled edge to edge with an oil-painting landscape. It has a pale beige-teal sky at the top, a dark green tree mass on the right with a brown trunk running down the centre, purple hills on the left and yellow-green foliage at the lower left. Across the painting, concentric water-like ripples spread from one point at the spinner (~812,650). Each ring bends and offsets the painted strokes, with a faint bright crest along its leading edge and no drawn stroke. The rings travel outward continuously at about 60 px/s, ~100 px apart, so a new crest leaves the centre about every 1.7–1.9 s. This runs the whole 24 s, and the rest of the screen holds still. The foreground UI is static and centred on x≈812. A small translucent light disc (~68 px) sits at ~812,650 and holds a white 8-spoke spinner icon with a dark centre dot. The spinner does not rotate. Below it sits a translucent, slightly lightened rounded card (674,648, 277×158, radius ~22) whose top edge passes behind the spinner disc. The card holds three centred lines of ~13 px white body copy. At the bottom is a solid white pill button (674,824, 277×44) labelled "Get Started" in ~13 px dark medium-weight type. Type is a neutral grotesk (Inter-like).

xhfuwr-minimal-dark-render-sliders.summary: A single column of four render-setting sliders centred on a near-black #18181c page (998x1080), nothing else on screen. Each row is a grey sans label left-aligned at x≈225 (Exposure, Bloom, Field of view, Samples), a light monospace value right-aligned at x≈770, and below it a thin track from x≈235 to x≈760: a bright white 2px fill left of a ~18px light-grey round thumb, then a dim #313135 groove. The rows sit 106px apart (tracks at y≈393, 499, 605, 711). The interaction is a slingshot. A hand cursor grabs a thumb and pulls it off the track. The thumb becomes a solid violet (#5b4fe0-ish) ball tethered by two thin violet elastic bands to two anchor dots on the track, with small grey dots spaced along the bands. While the ball is pulled, the row's fill dims to grey and the value turns violet. A dotted grey parabolic arc rises from the anchor and lands on a short violet vertical tick, with a small violet monospace prediction label (e.g. "102°", "-2.8 EV") above the tick. On release the band and arc vanish. The thumb, now white with a violet ring, flies along the arc, lands on the tick with a small bounce, and the value turns back to light. The sequence runs four times in order: Field of view 72°→103° (pulled ~1.5–3.0s, lands ~3.3s), Bloom 35%→68% (~4.0–6.2s, lands ~6.7s), Exposure +0.4 EV→-2.8 EV (~7.5–9.0s, lands ~9.4s), Samples 64→242 (~10.5–14.8s, lands ~15.05s with a ~12px rebound). The last-landed Samples thumb keeps its violet ring to the end. Corners are fully round (thumbs, ball), and the lines are hairline-thin. The only accent colour is the violet.

1ho037-personal-site-book-page.summary: A pale blue-grey (#dfe4e5) personal hero page, 770x720, centred on a photographed open sketchbook. Top-right sits a small nav ("work •", "play", and "insp" clipped by the right edge, ~11px dark grey). At y≈88 a centred, wide-tracked grey uppercase role line reads "DESIGNER / ENGINEER / ARTIST / STUDENT @ STANFORD". Behind it a huge cornflower-blue (#6c84e4) "Matthew Yu" (~80px tall, x 112–652, y 125–210) is heavily gaussian-blurred, with no crisp edge, and the book overlaps its lower half. The book (≈415x355, centred on x≈385, y 175–533) is a real Moleskine-style spread: cream paper pages, a soft centre gutter at x≈383, gently curled corners, a slight 3D tilt, and a soft diffuse drop shadow beneath. Each spread is a scanned sketch or painting (blue-ink Taipei cityscape, watercolour streets, Stanford tower, Osaka castle collage…). Thin chevrons ‹ and › sit at mid-height near the left and right edges (x≈27 and x≈735, y≈360). A tiny letterspaced caption names the current spread at y≈580 ("TAIPEI", "ABANDONED CAR, TAIPEI STREET", "STANFORD"…), and a faint double-chevron scroll cue sits at y≈662. Motion: from 0.15–1.95s the book flips rapidly through several spreads, motion-blurred. It settles on TAIPEI at ~2.0s and holds until 3.65s. After that, about every 0.6–1.5s the right-hand page lifts and turns right-to-left over the spine in ~0.45s (3.7–4.15, 4.6–5.1, 6.35–6.8, 7.1–7.55 …). The curling leaf reveals the next spread, and the caption swaps to the new place name at the same moment. The whole time the nav, role line, blurred name, arrows and scroll cue stay perfectly still. The clip ends resting on OSAKA CASTLE from ~15.9s.

77izkq-frosted-glass-hero-wordmark.summary: A light, monochrome studio hero (1824x1080, page #fbfbfb) behind a full-screen pane of frosted glass. Top bar: "Northline Studio" left at x 43, a centred hint "WIPE THE GLASS" with a ringed-dot icon (x 830-993, y 47), and "Work / Studio / Contact" right-aligned to x 1782. The giant black grotesk wordmark "Northline" (about x 110-1745, cap top y 315, baseline y 600) sits behind the frost and reads as a soft grey blur sprinkled with condensation droplets, some dark and some bright-rimmed. Bottom left: a two-line headline "Websites and digital products, / designed around how people use them." (cap height about 40px, near-black, x 43, y 790-885) with a black pill "Start a project →" and an outlined pill "See the work". Bottom right: a dot plus "Taking projects for 2027" and a live clock "Mumbai 19:58:22 IST" that counts up in seconds. Bottom centre: a white floating pill switcher "01 Gather / 02 Frost / 03 Liquid / 04 Meridian" with "02 Frost" active in a black pill. Motion: from the start, water drips run slowly down the glass. One near x 800 leaves a clear trail, has a dark wet head over the word and reaches y about 590 by 4.95s. A second appears near x 1475 by about 5.5s. Neither has a stroke. At about 9.95s the cursor, drawn as a 64px thin grey ring, starts wiping. The top hint fades out (gone by about 10.3s). Wherever the cursor passes, the frost is erased in soft-edged blobs to pure white, and the wordmark shows crisp and solid black there. The clear area grows left to right: "No" by 10.2s, "Nor" by 10.9s, "Nort" by 11.4s, "North" by 11.95s, "Northl" by 12.25s, "Northlin" by 12.75s, and the whole word by about 14.9s. Everything else stays still.

dkolso-self-building-website-cursors.summary: A 30s light-surface (#f7f9fb) clip in two acts. Act one (0–3.4s): a flat pale-grey Swarm 'S' mark (80×93 at 920,491, #d7dae0) sits dead centre while 18 small solid-colour arrow cursors (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, cyan, blue, purple, pink, coral), each with a white outline and a faint soft shadow, drift around it in a loose ring about 400 px across. The ring keeps re-forming: at 0.5s it is an even circle, by 1.7s the cursors have bunched into small clusters. The logo itself never moves, and a black system cursor sits top-right. Act two (from about 3.45s): a hard cut to a design-tool canvas, with a dark charcoal ruler 27 px tall across the top and 27 px wide down the left, thin blue selection boxes carrying blue 'W × H' pills, red guide lines and red spacing badges. The swarm of coloured cursors builds a marketing site for 'Swarm' live. Grey placeholder boxes become real UI, text is typed out behind I-beam carets, elements are duplicated and then renamed (one 'Northwind' copied four times, then retyped into Halcyon, Parallax, Meridian and Kestrel), and boxes get resized. The page sits on a hairline grid with column lines at x 213, 1093, 1472 and 1706. When the hero is done (about 7.2s) the rulers and selection chrome vanish and the finished hero rests: nav, a two-line 80 px bold headline 'Run a thousand agents as one.' at left x 262, a grey subline, a black 'Start building' button and a white 'Read the docs' button, a dark 'swarm.dispatch(task)' card feeding a 2×2 tree of agent cards, a blue progress bar, and a five-logo row. The canvas then scrolls up (8.35–9.95s, 676 px) and the cursors build the next sections the same way: 'Built for running agents in production.' with a 3×2 grid of feature cells duplicated from 'Smart routing' and relabelled, then 'One file describes the whole swarm.' with a dark code window, a stats row (10k+, 38ms, 99.99%, 0), 'How a task moves through Swarm.' (Define, Dispatch, Converge) and 'Priced by the size of your swarm.' with a $0 tier. Type is a neutral grotesk for headings and body and a monospace for code and labels. Buttons and cards have radii of about 8–12 px.

ewfwo2-tooltip-hover-delay-comparison.summary: A light, quiet comparison demo on a #f4f4f4 page: two identical white cards stacked (top [48,48,1344,480], bottom [48,552,1344,480], ~40px corner radius). Each card has a handwritten-script title at top-left ("Delay on every hover" in magenta, "Delay once, then instant" in mint green), a grey "N.Ns waiting" counter at top-right, a centred floating white formatting toolbar (691x78, ~18px radius, soft drop shadow) holding Body▾ | B I U S | link code quote | a coloured dot (magenta on top, mint on bottom), and a full-width 10px grey timeline track near the card bottom. Only one card is active at a time; the other sits at ~30% opacity. 0–7.8s the top card runs: an arrow cursor enters, turns into a pointing hand, and hovers B, I, U, S, link, code, quote left to right (~0.9s per button). Each hover shows a light-grey hover square, a small blue spinner ring plus a light-blue pill counting down "500ms"→"0ms" beside the cursor, then a near-black tooltip ("Bold ⌘B", "Italic ⌘I", …) fades in above the button; the previous tooltip lingers grey as it fades out. The waiting counter climbs 0.5s per button to 3.5s and the timeline paints one ~83px blue segment per wait, leaving seven segments and a "6.9s" label that rides the timeline's end. At ~7.8s the top card dims and the bottom card wakes: the same sweep happens, but only the first hover (B) waits 500ms; every later tooltip appears instantly in solid black with "0ms". Its counter stops at 0.5s and its timeline holds one blue segment with the label ending at "3.7s". Around 13.4–14.2s the top card fades back to full, so the clip ends holding both cards side by side: 3.5s/6.9s vs 0.5s/3.7s.

y9mnpy-sheet-animation-keyframe-explorat.summary: A near-black (#0f100d) canvas split into two parts. On the left (x 78–975) is a borderless code editor: 18 numbered lines (numbers right-aligned at x≈108–140, code starting x≈192, rows ≈51 px apart from y≈108) in a monospace face about 26 px tall. On the right is a phone outline (1050,83, 329×922, radius ≈48, 1–2 px gray #383936 stroke) holding six dim gray content bars, two faint dotted guides at y≈447 and y≈468, and a thin vertical scale at x≈1008 (y 238–648, ticks at both ends and one at y≈443) with a short blue playhead tick. The idea is a scrubbed selection band. Two blue dotted horizontal rules, about 245 px apart, bracket a group of about 4 code lines, and a row-resize cursor (two outline triangles around a bar) drags the band up and down. Lines inside the band decode from scrambled dim gibberish into the real CSS through a character-scramble effect: random glyphs, some flashing blue, settle into bright text, and their line numbers turn blue. Lines outside the band scramble back to dim noise. The full code reads "@keyframes sheet-in { 0% { transform: translateY(100%); opacity: 0; } 60% { transform: translateY(-4%); opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: translateY(0%); } } .sheet { animation: sheet-in 500ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); }". Property names are bold off-white, values mid-gray, numbers and percents blue. The phone previews the keyframe under the band. Over the 0% block there is no sheet. Over 60% a bottom sheet (1060–1368 wide, radius ≈40, slightly lighter fill, lighter gray stroke, grabber, one bright title bar and two gray lines) has risen to top ≈447. Over 100% it settles 20 px lower to top ≈467. A small blue tick right of the phone (x≈1390) marks the sheet's top edge. The sheet slides up from the phone bottom at about 1.95–2.6 s, eases between the 447 and 467 rests as the band moves (about 4.8 s and 7.85–10.35 s), and slides back down out of view at about 13.2–13.75 s.

mr8l2d-mobile-access-key-product-page.summary: A dark product-page section recorded as a screen capture. A near-black rounded panel (#1b1b1e, about 90,90 to 1487,990, radius ~16) floats over a deep indigo wallpaper of soft curved folds with violet rim light. Two faint vertical hairlines run down the panel at x≈148 and x≈1418, and a dashed hairline runs across at y≈114. At the top centre are three text tabs: "Corporate ID" (active, white, 82px white underline above it at y≈113), "Multifamily" and "Hospitality" (grey). Below them is a large media stage (#28272e, 174,162 to 1392,763, slightly lighter than the panel), then a four-column row of feature blurbs: each has a small line icon at y≈815, a white bold lead-in and a grey body at 14–15px with 24px line height. The active blurb's body brightens to near white, and a small circular progress ring in its top-right corner fills as a timer. The stage content follows the active blurb. Card 1 (0–1.5s) shows a grey soft-plastic key fob with a slot and inset disc, with soft rings pulsing outward. At ~1.5s the cursor lands on card 4 "Biometrics on device", the fob cuts away and the stage goes empty. From 2.45–2.65s the recording zooms hard into the stage with motion blur until it fills the frame, and a halftone point-cloud head builds from scattered dots and slowly turns (2.6–7.3s). From 7.3–7.75s the camera zooms back out to the page while the dotted head fades out of the stage (gone by ~9.3s). At ~11.75s card 3 "Upgrade your keys" becomes active, and the stage fills with a three-column grid of dark rounded ID cards with scrambled monospace labels. The centre column scrolls vertically and the centred card lights up as a frosted grey glass card with a building line-drawing, a logo, an NFC glyph and "Finance / Maximilian Thompson". At ~14.2–14.65s it dims and the column scrolls one card, and the next card lights up as "Product / Emma Williams".

87b7ma-brain-effort-dial-knob.summary: A single skeuomorphic control knob centred slightly below the middle of a square 1080 canvas, on a near-black charcoal (#202022) page. A faint 1px grey grid with ~114px cells covers the top ~640px and fades out toward the bottom. The knob is a matte black disc ~410px across (centre ≈540,555). Around its top 270° runs a ring of about 48 short radial tick marks, with two small separate stop marks at about 7:30 and 4:30 o'clock beside the bottom label. Inside sits a recessed dark collar and a glossy black glass dome ~244px across. The dome has a soft white specular cap at its top and thin bright crescents on its left and right rims. Floating in the dome is a slowly turning 3D brain. A small bold all-caps grey label (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, X-HIGH, MAX, GALAXY, SMOOTH) sits at the bottom of the bezel at y≈723. Dragging with a grab-hand cursor sets the effort level, and every change happens in place. Ticks light orange-red (#ff4a1a with glow) clockwise from the bottom-left in proportion to the level: 1 tick at LOW, about half at HIGH, all of them at MAX. Each level also changes the brain and the dome. LOW is a dark-blue glassy brain on black. MEDIUM is a violet brain on a purple sparkly dome. HIGH is an electric-blue brain with white lightning bolts on navy. X-HIGH is a cyan holographic brain on a teal dome. MAX is a pale pink-white brain on a warm translucent-amber dome with rotating light shafts and drifting specks. Dragging past MAX gives GALAXY: a cyan brain, the bezel goes semi-transparent, and huge blurred teal light rays burst out to ~350px around the knob (4.65–6.1s and again ~15s). Dragging below LOW gives SMOOTH: an unlit tick ring, the left stop mark lit white, and a smooth glossy pink blob brain. Timeline: LOW 0–1.5s, sweep up through MEDIUM (~1.6s), HIGH (~2.2s), X-HIGH (~2.9s), MAX (~3.6s), GALAXY burst 4.65–6.1s, MAX 6.1–7.3s, drag down through X-HIGH and HIGH (7.3–7.65s) to SMOOTH (~8–9.5s), LOW ~9.6–14s with a brief SMOOTH flick ~12.4s, back up through MEDIUM and X-HIGH to GALAXY ~14.9–16.2s, then MAX, X-HIGH and HIGH (~17.1s on). HIGH holds with crackling lightning to 21.5s. The knob itself never moves or resizes.

1i1ab7-icon-swap-vs-morph.summary: A bare warm off-white canvas (#f9f7f4) holds two identical white rounded-square buttons (about 132 px, corner radius about 36 px, a 2 px pale-grey rim and a soft diffuse shadow falling about 40 px below), centred on y≈540 at x≈396 and x≈684 with about 156 px of empty canvas between them. Both start with the same dark-grey (#4b4c47) outlined download glyph: a down arrow over an open tray, stroke about 5 px with round caps. A macOS cursor (black arrow with white outline, a pointing hand over a button) clicks each button in turn, twice. The left button SWAPS: each state is a separate icon that slides vertically out of the button while blurring, clipped at the button's edge, as the next one slides in. The order is download, then an empty light-grey ring, then a dark progress arc that fills clockwise from 12 o'clock over the grey track (about 1.3–4.0 s), then a solid dark disc with a white check, then download again. The right button MORPHS: one continuous stroke shape changes. The download glyph contracts into a single dot, the dot grows into a lone dark arc (about a quarter to a third of a circle, no grey track) that spins clockwise, the arc bends into a bare stroked checkmark (no disc), and the checkmark melts back into the download glyph. Timing: left cycle 0.5–5.5 s, cursor travels right 5.5–7 s, right cycle 7–10.8 s, left again 12.5–19.8 s, right again 22.3–30 s, ending on the check.

39snga-dropdown-animation.summary: A light product canvas: a white page strip (y 0–107) above a pale grey-green canvas card (#ebf0ef, ~40 px top-right radius ending at x≈1330) printed with a faint dot grid (~41 px pitch). A "43%" progress ring sits at 1053–1123, 1008–1078. The clip is one open–hold–close cycle of a share dropdown. From about 0.35 s the canvas dims to mid grey (about #a9adac). The white strip and the toolbar are not dimmed. A dark frosted-glass panel fades in under the Invite button, between about 0.35 and 0.42 s. 7npk6z-x-subscription-modal-design.summary: A centred white modal (371,158 → 1233,922; ~24px radius, no visible border, soft shadow) sits over an X Premium settings page dimmed by a flat mid-grey scrim (#a2a2a2 over the page). The page underneath reads clearly through the scrim: X left nav (Home…More, bold 'Subscription', dark 'Post' pill), a centre column (Premium, 'Verified since February 2024', Quick access, Upgrade to unlock, rows) and a right column (Help Center / Get support / Manage your subscription, a colourful Grok-blob illustration card, a dark hero image card). The modal is centred on x≈802: close × at top right, a bold black 30px title 'Introducing the X Subscription', a grey subtitle, a hairline divider broken by the label 'The Ultimate AI Subscription', then three equal light-grey rounded preview cards (~256×268, ~20px radius) each holding a product mark at top-left and a cropped product mockup (X post with rocket photo and a 'Premium' chip; Grok agent list with a coffee photo; Cursor code diff 'hero.tsx' with a prompt box), with centred captions underneath. Nothing enters or exits: the modal, scrim and page are static for the whole 8.62s. 1ly956-interface-craft-onboarding.summary: A single portrait library card sits centred on a near-white (#fdfdfd) page above a thin black slot. The card is 259 x 333 px at x 274, y 90, a flat vermilion (#d73a12) rounded rectangle with a radius of about 14 px. Its top half holds a flow-field grid of short pale-orange dashes, about 20 columns by 11 rows, whose angles sweep from vertical on the left to horizontal on the right. Below the grid are a two-line serif title, "Interface Craft" in muted peach over "Library Card" in pale yellow. Under the title is a two-column meta row: small tracked caps "AUTHOR" over "Josh Puckett" on the left, and "ISSUED ON" over "01/12/26" on the right. A white hand-drawn signature (a hooked "J" shape with two diagonal strokes) crosses the meta row. A faint hairline rule sits near the card's bottom edge. A small grey chevron at (403, 517) hints "down", and a black slot bar about 296 x 6 px with tapered ends sits at y 608–614. Motion: from 0.08 to 0.85 s the card bobs down 22 px and back twice, a nudge. At about 1.45 s a hand cursor grabs it, the chevron fades, and the card drops about 300 px into the slot by 2.67 s. Everything below the slot line (y ≈ 613) is clipped, so the card reads as sliding into a reader. The user then tugs it up 21 px (2.92–3.27) and back down (3.43–3.98). Next they pull it up 53 px (4.0–4.42), revealing the name row, then push it down 142 px (4.58–4.9). It springs back up 50 px to rest with only the dash field and title showing (top ≈ 428, from 5.2 s). While it rests, the dash field animates: dashes rotate into new flow patterns between 6 s and 7 s. At 8.48 s the card shoots fully into the slot in about 0.23 s. Between 8.68 and 9.02 s the slot itself narrows toward its centre and disappears, leaving a blank page.

lf12ao-cloudy-slider.summary: A full-bleed sky: a vertical gradient from saturated blue (#4a8ad6) at the top corners to near-white (#e6f1fa) at the bottom edge, with a soft white sun glow centred near (930,110). Centred horizontally a little below the middle sits one wide slider, a dark slate frosted-glass track 1043x139 at (413,474) with corners of about 45px and a soft drop shadow beneath it. Inside, inset about 8px, a lighter translucent slate fill with a 1px pale hairline border and corners of about 38px grows from the left. A thin white rounded handle, about 6x62px, rides about 20px inside the fill's right edge. The white semibold label "Clouds" sits left at x=460 and the value ("7%" … "100%") is right-aligned to x≈1406, both about 32px tall and vertically centred at y≈543. The slider's value controls the sky: at 7% only two blurred clouds sit at top-left. As the value is dragged up, more soft-edged blurred white clouds fade in where they stand, until at 100% the sky is crowded with about ten of them. Throughout the clip every cloud drifts slowly right, about 30px/s. Timeline: idle at 7% to about 1.0s. Then a drag in stages: 13% at 1.5s, 28% at 2.25s, 53% at 3.45s, 89% at 5.4s, 100% by about 6.4s. It holds at 100% to about 8.3s, then drags back down: 76% at about 9.3s, 54% at 9.5s, 26% at 10s, settling at 25% by about 10.6s. Clouds fade out as the value falls. After release, about 11.0–11.4s, the whole track shrinks slightly, to about 1008px wide, and stays there to the end.

lja5x5-loading-state-animation.summary: A light documentation-style demo on a #f7f7fa page. The top row has a monospace grey index "01", a bold dark "Loading State" title and a grey caption "Pixel-grid loader with shimmer and elapsed time." Below it sits a large rounded panel (#eeeef0, radius ~16, x14–648, y53–337). In its top-right corner are two small white rounded-square icon buttons (copy and code "<>"). Centred at the bottom of the panel is a segmented control with four text tabs: "Drive", "Dots", "Orbit", "Surfer". The active tab sits on a white pill. The loader is one row: a 3×3 grid of small square pixels whose cells cycle between dark and light grey, a grey label with a darker shimmer band sweeping left to right across its letters, and a monospace elapsed-time counter that counts up in 0.1 s steps at real speed. From 0–1 s the "Drive" tab is active and the row "Churning 22.6s" is centred in the panel (y≈195). A hand cursor rests on "Surfer" and clicks at ~1.0 s. Within ~100 ms (1.05–1.15 s) the view switches: the active pill moves to "Surfer", the label becomes "Subway surfing", and the row sits higher (y≈126), left-aligned over a 233×132 rounded media card with a soft drop shadow. The card plays Subway Surfers gameplay footage (red arched walls, yellow and navy trains, brown tracks). From then until the end the pixel grid, shimmer and timer keep running (23.3s → 29.4s) and the footage plays continuously; nothing else in the layout moves. At ~7.2 s the cursor disappears.

1knz9n-hamster-cookie-consent-modal.summary: A single white rounded card (360x511 at x180,y104, ~28px radius, very soft wide grey shadow) is centred on a flat #efefef page. The card is centre-aligned on top: a bold black "Cookie settings" title (~24px) and a grey ~13px subtitle "Every cookie you accept goes to the hamster", then a painterly cartoon hamster illustration (~224x218 plate, x248,y192, near-white backing that barely differs from the card). Below sit three settings rows (Analytics, Marketing, Personalization) with 14px dark labels on the left at x209 and iOS-style toggles on the right (x472-511, ~39x23), separated by 1px hairlines at y426/464/502/540 spanning x209-511. The footer holds a black pill "Accept all" button (x209,y560,109x35, white bold text) and a grey text link "Reject all". Motion is a story driven by a pointer cursor: at ~1.1s the cursor clicks Analytics, its toggle slides on and turns green, a round chocolate-chip cookie (~52px) pops out beside the toggle and flies left/up into the hamster's paws (by ~1.43s), the hamster lifts it to its mouth and eats (1.7-2.6s) and ends with a timid smile and slightly fuller cheeks (3.15s). At ~3.55s Marketing is clicked: same toggle-on + cookie flight (3.65-3.98s), the hamster eats with eyes closed (4.63s) then bursts into an open-mouthed grin with big puffed cheeks and raised paws (5.3s) and yellow sparkle strokes flicker beside its head (5.6s). At ~6.25s Personalization is clicked: a third cookie flies to the belly (6.7s) and the hamster ends with huge balloon cheeks, sparkly eyes and yellow sparkles (7.6s). Around 8.6s the cursor hovers "Reject all" (its text darkens from grey to near-black), clicks at ~9.35s: all three toggles turn off together and the hamster deflates back to the original sad pose (9.35-9.75s). The card, text, rows and buttons never move; only the toggles, the cookie, the hamster artwork, the link colour and the cursor change.

ufn7sx-offset-path-marquee.summary: A light #f2f2f3 canvas (1164x720) teaching a CSS offset-path marquee in four steps. It opens (0–0.7s) on the finished marquee centred: about 27 square album-cover tiles (~44px, ~3px radius, soft grey drop shadow, no border) run left to right along a horizontal line (y≈450–497, x≈310–985), climb into a teardrop loop above it (loop x≈470–675, top y≈220) and come back down past the crossing at x≈575. The tiles at both ends fade to transparent. Tiles stream steadily rightward along the path at about 80–100 px/s. At ≈0.75–1.35s the marquee slides right and shrinks into the right column. A left column (x=71) then fades in from a blur: a dark ~26px medium-weight sans heading, a grey ~17px body line with light-grey inline code chips, and a #e9e9eb code panel (x 71–482, radius ~4px) in grey monospace. Step 1 "1. Draw a funky SVG path" (≈1.4–3.7s) shows only the path, a thin ~1.5px mid-grey stroke from (558,448) to (1124,448) with a loop spanning x 731–853, y 269–420. Step 2 (≈4.0–6.9s) shows one blue 36px tile riding the path left to right at about 100 px/s. Step 3 "3. Add more elements" (≈7.2–9.8s): the path line is gone and tiles fill in along it. Step 4 "4. Polish" (≈10.1–12.2s) makes the end tiles fade harder. Each step change is a ~0.3–0.4s blur crossfade of the left column only. At ≈12.3–13.0s the text blurs out and the marquee slides left and grows back to the centred layout (x≈275–995, loop top y≈220). It then keeps scrolling to the end. A hovering cursor slows it (the code comment says "spring velocity toward 0.3×").

1mevqv-byanat-classical-art-landing.summary: A full-bleed hero for "Byanat", filmed off a monitor (the macOS dock shows at the bottom). The whole 1306x746 frame is an AI-generated video built on Michelangelo's Creation of Adam. Adam reclines on a rocky ledge at left, God and the cherubs sit in a red mantle at right, and the sky is cloudy blue. A soft black scrim darkens the lower ~40% to near-black (#040306) from about y 560 down, with no hard edge. Over the video sits a static overlay, all aligned to a left edge at x≈94. At the top is a thin nav: a "Byanat" logo at x 122, y 30, then small grey "Products / Customers / Partners" links around x 286–494, y 39, and a pale translucent pill button at the top right (x 1190, y 34). Lower left is a white rounded "Backed by [Y] Combinator" badge (92,412, 165x37, radius ~8). Under it is a large white serif headline in two lines, "AI for infrastructure / that cannot fail." (~42px, y 472–558). Then comes a three-line white sans paragraph (~16px, y 580–650). Only the video moves; the overlay stays put through all 20s. The video runs as one continuous camera move. From 0–3s it pushes in on God, with his face filling the right half by 2.5s. Over 3–5.5s it passes his beard into blurred cherubs. Around 5.5–6s it dissolves into a photoreal rocky ledge where a hand reaches out. From 6–9.5s a photoreal Adam on the rocks reaches toward the camera. Over 10–13s the camera orbits behind his back as his arm stretches to the left over a landscape. From 13–16s it pulls back until the painted composition returns, with God re-entering at the right around 14–15s. From 16–20s it settles into the opening composition with only a slight drift, so 19s matches 0.15s and the clip loops seamlessly. A smeared band of stretched edge pixels runs down the left edge (x 0–90, y 170–590) as part of the video.

1rakfb-morphing-navigation-component.summary: A screen recording of a component-gallery page: a dark app window (toolbar with logo, "Inspo / Vault / MCP NEW" tabs, a "Morphing Navigation" address field, a white "Get Code" pill, "Invite & earn", bookmark and an orange-ringed "A" avatar) sits centred on a vivid orange-pink-magenta-to-blue-purple gradient desktop. The window holds a full-bleed photo of a terracotta building with wavy balconies against a cyan cloudy sky. A small dark pill nav at the bottom centre carries a white blob logo on the left and a white "Menu" pill button on the right. From 0.4 to 0.95s the camera zooms about 1.53x into the photo, so the window chrome leaves the frame and only a blue-purple desktop strip stays below y≈665. Clicking Menu morphs the pill up into a tall rounded dark panel (about 425x482, radius ≈22). It grows first as an empty dark slab (≈0.85–1.1s), then the text fades in: large light sans-serif links "Home / Explore / About / Contact", a thin hairline divider, small "LinkedIn / Instagram", the logo at bottom left and a white "Close" pill at bottom right. Hovering a link turns it bright white with an en-dash prefix and dims the others to grey. Close shrinks the panel back down into the pill (≈4.3–4.6s). The open/close cycle repeats at ≈5.5–6.0 / 6.5–6.8 and opens again ≈7.3–7.6, while the camera zooms back out (7.5–7.95). The clip ends at the framed view with the menu open. The panel material is a near-opaque warm black (#130d0d–#1f1715) with soft, faint lighter blooms of the photo behind it: a heavily frosted dark glass with no visible stroke.

Each row has a 5-cell time block on the left (x≈69–172) and, after a black gap of about 31px, a 15-cell destination block on the right (x≈203–518). Rows sit at y≈109, 147, 185, 223, each about 27px tall on a 38px pitch. Every cell is a 5×7 grid of small square dots at a pitch of about 3.5–3.8px. Lit dots are bright white (#fefefe to #cccccc). Unlit dots stay visible as dim grey (#303030 to #777777), so empty cells read as faint grey dot blocks on black. There is no panel, border, or glow, only dots on black. The rest text reads "19:45 NEW YORK CITY", "08:45 TOKYO", "13:45 HAWAII", "16:45 LOS ANGELES". Each colon takes a full cell, and the word spaces and trailing cells are unlit grey blocks. Motion: the board holds still until about 0.33s. Then a scramble wave sweeps left to right. Each cell flickers through random letters, digits and colons, then settles back to its original character. The time cells scramble first (0.35–1.5s), then the destination cells (0.75–2.5s). Empty trailing cells briefly show random characters before going dark again. The last stray glyphs at the right end of the rows clear at about 2.6s, and the board holds unchanged to 4.23s. Nothing translates or resizes; only which dots are lit changes.

14p39f-security-shield-hero-blur.summary: A product security page for "Interfere" shown in two themes, the same intro playing once in each. A two-row header runs across the top. Row 1 (0–82 px): the serif "Interfere" wordmark with a checkered pixel mark at the left, four centred nav links (Product, Resources, Company, Contact) at y≈40, and an "Open app" pill with an "O" key chip at the right. A hairline sits at y≈82. Row 2: the breadcrumb "Resources › Security and Privacy" on the left and "2026 SOC 2 Type II Report Available  Open ›" on the right, with a hairline at y≈159. The hero is centred on x≈836. Three nested rounded shield shapes are stacked on top of each other (outer 602–1070 × 325–920, middle 646–1026 × 379–866, inner 691–981 × 437–809). Each is a translucent frosted-glass slab with a faint 1 px lighter rim. Across them runs a ~76 px sans heading "Security and Privacy" (x 509–1163, y≈494–566). "Security and" is crisp. "Privacy" is seen through the frosted glass: "Pri" is heavily blurred, "va" is lightly blurred, and "acy" is crisp past the outer shield's right edge at x≈1070. A soft colour glow sits behind the heading: warm orange-red on the left, violet in the centre, pale blue on the right. Under it is a two-line grey subtitle at ~20 px. Motion: the clip opens on the finished dark state. At ~0.2 s it cuts to an empty dark hero. The outer shield fades in through a vertical streaky blur (0.2–0.6 s), then the middle and inner shields (to ~1.0 s). The heading resolves from blur to sharp left to right (1.0–1.6 s) while the glow blooms in (1.3–1.9 s). The subtitle de-blurs in last (1.6–2.1 s). Then it holds, and only a faint specular sheen slides down the shields' lower-right rims. At ~4.95 s a hard cut switches to the light theme (near-white #fdfdfd page, dark type, header inverted) with an empty hero, and the same sequence replays: shields 5.0–6.0 s, heading 5.7–6.4 s, subtitle 6.3–7.0 s, hold to 9.4 s. Nothing moves position: every entrance is opacity plus blur.

1o0bpd-loading-ui-animation.summary: A flat warm-grey (#ebebe9) square showcase of minimal monochrome loaders. Top-left at y≈376 sits a header row: a white outlined 8-lobed badge icon with a small star inside (≈48px, x 117), then "Token activity" in bright white (#f6f4f2, ~40px medium sans), then a mid-grey slash and a mid-grey mode word ("Daily" / "Weekly" / "Cumulative"), all left-aligned to the grid's left edge at x≈115. Below that is a GitHub-style contribution grid spanning x 115–1803, y 445–663: 53 week-columns × 7 day-rows of rounded squares (≈25px, 32px pitch, ~5px radius); the last column has only its top cell (365 cells). Empty cells are a dim warm grey (#221e1d), active cells ramp through dark browns to a bright coral (#e77059). Under the grid at y≈710 sit twelve very dim grey month labels (Jan…Dec, #434142) placed at the column where each month begins, so their gaps are uneven. The clip loops through three views of the same data, with the mode word changing by a per-glyph blur scramble each time: Daily (0–≈1.5s, scattered heat with a hot cluster in Jun–Aug, Sep–Dec empty) → Weekly (≈1.5–2.3s: the 7 cells of each column merge vertically into one full-height bar, sweeping left to right; held 2.3–3.3s, four bright coral bars in late Jul/Aug) → Cumulative (≈3.3–3.9s: a diagonal wave runs left to right, with cells ahead of it shrunk to tiny dots that regrow as full squares while the right-hand bars pull up into the top row; held 3.9–5.2s, dark brown Jan–Jun ramping to solid coral from Aug to the end) → back to Daily (≈5.2–5.6s: only the right half changes, the Aug–Dec coral fading to empty grey) and held to 6.53s, matching the opening frame. The header text, icon, grid footprint and month labels never move.

89svt1-dreamy-meadow-reading-hero.summary: A full-bleed 1912x1080 hero over a photoreal 3D render of rolling green grass hills under a pale blue sky with soft cumulus clouds at left (0-330, y 405-615) and right (1600-1912, y 370-550). The sky fades to near-white #eef2f7 at the top so the type reads. Top left: a two-line tight-tracked semibold heading "A quiet place for / a loud internet" (x 86, cap top ~100, about 62px type, dark slate in day), with a two-line grey subcopy at y 240-295 under it. Top right: a 3-column, 4-row link grid with columns at x 1318 / 1537 / 1757 and rows at y≈110/160/209/259, regular weight, ~19px, grey. Across the middle sits a giant white lowercase grotesk wordmark "meadow" (x 115-1812, the d ascender top at y 450, x-height top ~535). Its lower part is hidden behind the front hill, so the word sits inside the landscape. In the grass are four 3D objects: a large frosted pink-magenta crystal (230-535, y 845-1005), a small violet amethyst point (~758-833, y 870-950), a matte peach-orange sphere (1133-1258, y 835-935) and a tall frosted lavender crystal (1520-1690, y 800-990). Footer at y≈1028: "© 2026 Meadow" at left, "Privacy  Terms  Cookies" centred at x 823-1063, and four white social glyphs (X, Instagram, GitHub, RSS) at x≈1677/1722/1768/1813. Motion: from 0 to ~1.2s the whole scene goes from heavily blurred to sharp. The heading and nav fade in and rise ~13-16px, and the footer fades in and rises ~20px. The "meadow" letters rise up from behind the hill one after another, left to right: m first, w last and still ~60px low at 1s, all settled by ~2s. Moving the cursor over the grass (2-2.5s) leaves a trail of white daisies and small pink/purple wildflowers that sprout along its path and stay. A click switches day to night, and the night scene is revealed through a soft, feathered circle that grows out from the click point (4.05-4.45s). Night has a navy sky with the Milky Way and stars, dark grey clouds, and dark blue-green grass. The peach sphere glows warm, the pink crystal throws a red glow on the grass, and a yellow-green light with drifting firefly specks follows the cursor. The heading turns light grey/white. A second click at ~(650,970) wipes back to day (6.65-7.0s), and a third click at ~(1760,750) wipes to night again (8.05-8.5s). It stays night to the end, with the cursor light moving over the grass.

s9yg0m-hanging-team-profile-cards.summary: A light (#fcfcfc) careers/team section. Top-left: a tiny tracked uppercase eyebrow "OUR STUDIO · THE PEOPLE" with a violet dot, then a two-line large sans headline, "Meet the people" in near-black and "behind the work." in soft lavender (#a497dc-ish), ~60px type. Top-right: a two-line grey paragraph and a green-dot uppercase tag "04 PEOPLE, ONE TEAM". Across the middle a thin grey wire runs from x≈247 to x≈1310 and sags in a shallow curve (ends y≈303, middle y≈327). It has four small grey round pins at x≈282/613/944/1275. From each pin a hairline string drops to a grey ring-clip at the top centre of a hanging card. The four cards (~300×415, radius ~22, light grey #f2f2f2 with a soft drop shadow) each hang at a slight rest tilt (about −2°, +1°, −1°, +1.5°) and at staggered heights: card tops ≈362, 445, 402, 440. Each front has a small "PEOPLE · STUDIO" label and "#0n" number, a rounded square 3D-character avatar render on a tinted backdrop (pink, lilac, mustard, lilac), a large name, a grey role, a hairline divider, "VIEW PROFILE" and a black circle with a white ↗ arrow. Clicking a card flips it 180° on its vertical axis, a perspective rotateY of ~0.5–0.65s. The back is a holographic card: a soft iridescent pastel gradient (cyan, pink, mint-yellow, violet) that drifts with the pointer. It holds "PROFILE / 0n", a round avatar, name and role, location, a one-line bio, "SELECTED PROJECTS" with two ruled rows, "LET'S CONNECT" plus an email, and a QR code with "SCAN ME", with a round flip-back icon at top right. Only one card shows its back at a time: opening the next card flips the open one back to its front in the same moment (Maya at 0–0.5s, Leo at ~0.8–1.45s, Noah at ~1.8–2.4s, Noah back to front ~2.8–3.45s, Leo again ~6.05–6.65s, and so on). Hovering a card tilts it in 3D toward the pointer (up to ~8–10° tilt, the card skews in perspective) and lays the same iridescent shimmer over its front (3.6–5.9s on Noah and Amina). The wire, strings, header and footer never move, and cards that are not hovered or flipping hold still. The footer has two small tracked grey captions: "THE PEOPLE MAKE THE WORK." at left and "HOVER TO SHIMMER · CLICK / TAP TO FLIP" at right.
