1ln7hx-bento-grid-exploration.summary: A dark bento grid on a near-black page (#1e1d23) shows three columns of large rounded cards (radius ≈32px, fill ≈#26252c, 1px faint lighter border, soft drop shadow), cropped at both sides: a sliver of a left card (x 0–118) with dim cut-off text ("…vity", "…pace", "Bob", "= \"Bob\"", "Alvish"), a middle column of two square cards (136–602 wide; top 63–529, bottom 547–1013), and a tall right card (620–1086, 63–1013) that is clipped on its right by the frame edge content. Each card has copy at a fixed place: a white bold lead ("Automate.", "Wire your product.", "Connect to your Agent.") followed by grey body text at ≈19px with ≈31px line height. The top card holds a glossy dark chat bubble "Categorize incoming leads and update the correct columns."; the bottom card holds a circuit illustration (thin grey wires from a rounded bus down to a square bevelled chip with a dark three-stroke logo, a line continuing down, over a faint dot grid); the right card holds an "AGENT" window outline with two chat bubbles, the lower one faded. Motion is hover-driven by a visible cursor: at ≈2.8–3.15s the cursor enters the bottom card and the chip lifts ≈23px (y 666→643), a small "API" pill fades in below it, a teal underglow appears on the chip's bottom edge and blurred coloured glows (green, amber, red/pink) drift around the chip behind it; this holds and the glows slowly orbit until ≈9.2s. At ≈9.2–9.4s the cursor moves into the top card: the chip drops back and the API pill disappears, while the Categorize bubble slides up ≈61px (y 189→128) and a second bubble "Also something here..." appears beneath it, right-aligned; at ≈10s a "Thinking" label with blue→purple→pink gradient text and a small rotating 4-dot spinner appears at x≈170, y≈351 and stays, its spinner turning, until the clip ends at 14.52s. Nothing else on the page moves.

ayz7i4-discover-playlists-ui.summary: A single light page (#fdfdfd) with a large near-black "Discover" heading at top-left (x 276, cap top ~180) and two 54 px circular arrow buttons at top-right (centres 1558,215 and 1622,215; prev faint/disabled, next dark). Below, at y 300, a horizontal row of 255x255 playlist cards, radius ~22, 36 px gaps (x 276, 567, 858, 1149, 1440, 1731), the last one fading into white at the right edge. Each card is a soft blurred two-tone wave gradient with visible fine grain, and has white "Name" (~20 px medium) and "N Tracks" (~16 px, dimmer) at its bottom-left. Hovering a card shifts its wave art a little while the card box stays put. Clicking a card (2.15–2.45 s for Deep Focus) morphs it in place into a 493x604 light-grey (#f4f4f4) panel with a faint 1 px border and radius ~20: the artwork shrinks to a 104 px thumbnail at the panel's top-left, and the name and count slide right beside it. A track list fades in top to bottom with a blur (title over grey artist, duration right-aligned, 76 px row pitch) and fades out at the panel's bottom. The cards to the right slide right ~238 px to make room. Clicking another card collapses the open panel back into a card while the new one expands (Nostalgia ~4.9 s, Night Drive ~6.4 s, Rainy Day ~7.85 s). At ~9.7–11.2 s the next arrow scrolls the whole row left until the open Rainy Day panel sits at x 28. The prev arrow turns dark and the left edge gets a white fade. New cards then come into view: Workout, Calm Evening, Road Trip, Joy. Workout, Calm Evening and Road Trip open in turn (~12.85, ~14.3, ~15.7 s), a second scroll comes at ~21.5–22.25 s, and Joy opens near the end.

1oyxmy-connect-customer-data-cards.summary: A centred feature tile on an off-white (#fdfdfd) 1080x1080 page. The top of the composition is a 456x533 rounded panel (x312-768, y217-750, radius about 20px) filled with a heavily blurred landscape photo: pale grey sky on top, then a dark olive treeline band around y450, then olive-green and rust-brown blurred ground. Two white UI cards sit centred inside the panel. The first is a mac-style window, 276x208 at (401,330), radius about 10px, soft shadow. It has red, yellow and green traffic-light dots at y343 and a clipped list showing five customer rows 34.5px apart. Each row has a coloured brand logo, a name in 10px dark type, a company in 8px grey, a status (green "Healthy", amber "At risk" or crimson "Unhealthy") and a grey "5h ago". A grey dashed vertical connector at x539 runs from the window's bottom edge (y538) to a single 'incoming' notification card, 263x48 at (408,575). That card shows a logo, name, company and its own time ("3d ago", "5h ago", "1d ago", "2d ago"). Behind it, thinner white card edges peek out 4px apart: four at the start, then fewer each step, then none. Under the panel, left-aligned at x318, the heading "Connect" (about 22px, near-black) sits over a two-line grey 20px subline. The motion repeats every ~7.2s and runs in four steps, about 1.15s apart (0.65, 1.8, 2.95 and 4.1s). In each step the front card slides up about 25-35px and tucks under the window's bottom edge, where it joins the list. At the same time the list scrolls up by one 34.5px row, so the top row slides out under the title bar and the arrived company becomes the new bottom row reading "5h ago". The next card in the stack eases forward to the front position, widening to full size. After four arrivals the list reads Amelia Carter through Theo Morgan, and Marcus Chen (2d ago) is alone with no stack. At 6.2-6.55s the sequence rewinds: the list scrolls back down and the cards drop back out into a rebuilt stack. By 7.15s the start state has returned (Olivia Bennett on top, Maya Patel 3d ago in front, four edges behind), and the loop plays again from 7.85s. The panel, photo, heading and subline never move.

1uhs3o-linear-shortcut-gallery.summary: A single dark app window (1268x790, ~6px radius, soft large drop shadow) floats centred on a light-grey backdrop (#979797 top-left brightening to #b6b6b6 bottom-right). The window is near-black (#060608) with a cool charcoal sheen at the top (#3a3b3f at y=145 fading to black by y≈410). Top-left: a small white striped-circle logo, a thin vertical divider, and 'SHORTCUT / GALLERY' in tiny uppercase mono-ish type. The keyboard view centres a large white sans headline 'Breeze through Linear' (~34px, y≈355) above a full Mac keyboard drawn as faint outlined keycaps (≈990x275, slightly perspective-skewed, wider at the bottom) with grey italic labels. Bottom bar: '0 Toggle view ↓' at left and a centred tab row '1 Workspace · 2 Issues · 3 Projects · 4 Inbox · 5 Customers · 6 Documents & Code', each with a tiny square number badge, the active tab white, others grey. A static mouse cursor sits at (1212,833). Motion: the keyboard outlines fade in (0–1s), the headline resolves left-to-right out of a blur (0.6–1.6s), key labels appear (~1.5–2.5s); at 3–3.5s all keys dim except the shortcut keys (O, F, G, K, X, /, control, option, command ×2), which stay bright, and a small keycap hint appears under the headline. The headline then swaps to the shortcut being drilled ('Open workspace search' with '/', 'Search within current view' with ⌘ F, 'Open label' with O L) and back to 'Breeze through Linear'; pressed hint keycaps light up with a soft lavender glow that turns off key by key. At 16.65–17.25s the page toggles to the list view: the tab row travels from the bottom (y≈907) to the top (y≈170) and a reference list of shortcut rows (label left, keycaps right, rows 47px apart) rises; at 17.85–18.15 the columns slide left ~436px so 'Issues' is centred and active, neighbours fading at the edges; further slides step through the tabs until ~25.8–26.4s when it toggles back to the keyboard view.

nlrtq7-human-ai-responses.summary: A light chat screen (#f7f7f7) laid out in a centred column about 825 px wide (x 336–1161). At the top right sits the user's question in a light grey pill (#e9e9e9, fully rounded, 634,49 → 1161,101): "Can you compare NVIDIA and AMD stock performance?" in a dark 17 px sans. Below it on the left is a small grey "Worked for 2s ⌄". The AI answer is not typed. It is handwritten in a near-black marker script, three lines at baselines around y 232, 302 and 372, starting at x≈356, and it writes itself stroke by stroke from 0 to about 4.4 s. Each highlighted word gets a soft, rounded yellow marker swash (#f3e3a8) behind it right after it is written ("NVIDIA", "AMD", "doubled."). "+874%" gets a hand-drawn ellipse around it. A mistaken "Januar" is crossed out with a scribbled strike and rewritten as "January" on the next line. Then a hand-drawn chart builds under the text. The y-axis draws downward at x≈362 (4.4–4.95 s). The x-axis then draws left to right along y≈824 out to x≈1092 (4.95–5.5 s). Ticks and handwritten italic labels follow (2022/2024/2026, +500%/+1000%, 5.4–6.3 s). A green NVIDIA price line traces left to right (6.2–7.3 s) and is labelled "NVIDIA +874%" in green script (7.4–8.0 s). A blue AMD line then traces under it (8.0–8.8 s) and is labelled "AMD +453%" in blue script (8.6–9.2 s). The composer card stays put at the bottom the whole time (336,923 → 1161,1041): white, about 16 px radius, soft drop shadow, "Ask anything..." placeholder, plus and sliders icons, and a pale blue rounded-square send button with a white arrow. Nothing scrolls, slides or fades. Every change is ink being drawn in place. The mouse pointer rests at about (831,673) and jumps to about (888,725) between 7.4 and 8.0 s.

10maz0-button-layout-effects.summary: A screen recording of a portfolio site in a rounded browser-like window (x 195–1725, y 43–1037, ~28 px corner radius, black 34 px top bar) floating over a green rolling-hills wallpaper. 0–1.85 s: a black splash centred on "Art. ✱ Reimagined." in white bold sans (~30 px); around 1.2–1.45 s the white asterisk lifts ~55 px above the line while both words dim to grey. 1.9–2.6 s: a stepped staircase wipe. White bands come in from the left edge, the middle rows lead and the top and bottom rows trail in ~153 px steps, so the page shows as an arrowhead pointing right. The black is gone by ~2.65 s. The page: white (#fdfdfd) with hairline grey guides (horizontal at y 173 and 939, vertical at x 612 and 1308), tiny black square ticks where they cross (x 421, 612, 1308, 1499), and very faint large circle arcs at left and right. Top centre is a small grey pill button (#7a7a7a, 44×23, white minus bar) with a handwritten "Click here" note to its left; a thin red curved arrow draws itself from the note to the pill between ~3.7 and 4.8 s. Below: the headline "Lets Create ✱ Smt Together.." (light-grey sans words plus a black italic serif "Together"), a centred folder made of a frosted-glass front panel over three photo cards whose tops peek out above it, "Worked with" in black, a left-scrolling logo marquee with soft faded ends (invideo · SAMSUNG · sei ai studio · envato · LTX Studio), and a footer "📍 Frankfurt / Germany". 4.6–5.3 s the camera zooms ~1.5× onto the top centre. ~5.6 s the cursor clicks the pill and it morphs in place into a dark-grey (#747474) shell with three dots and a white inset card listing "Submit A Project / About Me / Newsletter". The headline behind is dimmed under its shadow. 7.45–7.65 s clicking "Submit A Project" grows the same shell, with its content blurred mid-morph, into a tall "Inquiry" form (radio cards Brand Collab / Project, Business Inquiry fields, dark Submit button). ~9.6–9.8 s back shrinks it to the menu. ~11.35–11.7 s "Newsletter" morphs it into a short "Newsletter" sign-up panel. Meanwhile the cursor is over the folder and four photo cards fan out of it (white-bordered, rotated about −15° to +15°), then slide back by ~12.6 s. ~13–14.5 s back to the menu, the camera zooms out to the full window, and the menu collapses into the pill. The end state matches the 3.65 s page.

1rj1vm-graphical-inline-icon-hero.summary: A centred hero on a flat white (#ffffff) 1648x1080 canvas. At the top, around y 237–388, sits a black outlined stadium badge [603,237,448,151]. Its stroke is about 14 px and it holds the word "Graphical" in a heavy, tightly tracked black grotesk. Below it, at y ≈ 552–841, is a three-line centred sentence in a regular grotesk of about 72 px, near-black #171716: "A tool to create visual [icon languages], / customize [icon motion], and build / interfaces with [icon ChatGPT]." Each line holds one inline pill, a full-radius light grey (#ededea) capsule about 87 px tall. The pill starts with a sticker-style icon (a colour glyph with a white die-cut border and a soft drop shadow, overlapping the pill's left end) and ends with a dark word. A small pointing-hand cursor hovers over a pill, and the hovered pill darkens to about #e2e4e1. The motion is a word-swap carousel. Every 0.45–0.6 s one pill morphs. The old icon pops out and the new icon springs in with a slight overshoot in scale and rotation. The word cross-fades letter by letter: incoming letters arrive grey and staggered, then settle to black. The pill width springs to fit the new word, and the whole line re-centres so its left and right edges move symmetrically. Line 3 cycles ChatGPT → Claude (~0.5 s) → Cursor (~1.1 s) → Grok (~1.7 s), then holds on Grok. Line 2 cycles motion → components (~2.45 s) → colors (~3.35 s) → type → spacing → icons → states → components → colors → effects → motion (~8.8 s). Line 1 swaps languages → themes (~2.9 s) → systems → languages (~4.1 s) → themes (~4.6 s). The final rest is "themes / motion / Grok" from about 9 s to 10.27 s. The badge never moves.

1u1wfj-article-share-card-modal.summary: Screen recording of an article page with a camera move. 0–0.85s: the camera is zoomed in on a light (#fafafa) app window with a rounded bottom-left corner. Behind it, an impressionist painted wallpaper shows in a strip at the left and bottom. On the left of the window is an action menu: "Share" (highlighted by a faint pill, hand cursor on it), "Ask AI", "Copy as Markdown", each with a thin line icon. On the right are large grey sans article text lines and two tilted black-and-white photo prints with white borders. After the click at ~0.85s, the view whips away with heavy motion blur (0.85–1.05s). The page becomes a soft, heavily blurred white-grey backdrop. A centred white modal (~718×792, radius ~24, soft shadow, hairline outline) scales/drifts into place and settles by ~1.5s. In the modal: a "Share article" title at top left and a close × at top right. Below that is a preview card of the article: a serif headline "Make your design system AI-ready" and a grey sans excerpt that fades out toward the bottom. The card text fades in ~1.2–1.4s, and two blank cards fan out behind it, slightly rotated, by ~1.9s. Below the card is a row of four light-grey circular share buttons (X, LinkedIn, Bluesky, mail). At the bottom is a pill URL field with a copy icon. From 2.5 to 3.65s the arrow cursor travels from the bottom-left to the copy button and becomes a hand. At ~4.25–4.4s the copy icon cross-fades (blurred) into a checkmark on a round hover tint. It holds to 6.18s.

1w2ew3-bottom-navbar-pill.summary: A single near-black (#0b0b0b) control sits bottom-centre on a flat #fcfcfc page, its bottom edge pinned at y=997 throughout. At rest it is a fully rounded pill (668–1256 x 863–997, 589x134) holding five light-grey line icons on a 114 px pitch (home, book, stacked bowl, @, up/down chevron) centred at y=930; hovering an icon puts a soft #191919 circle (~113 px) behind it (Playground at 1.4s, @ at 1.9s). Pressing the chevron at ~2.73s squishes the pill down to ~73 px tall, then at 2.83s it springs open upward into a rounded card (616–1308 x 367–997, radius ~56), overshooting to top 353 at 3.02s and settling at 367 by ~3.17s; contents arrive blurred and faded (2.92s shows a blank black card with a blurred switcher). The card holds a segmented theme switcher (#191919 track 636–1288 x 387–491, white 'Light' segment between grey 'Dark' and 'Auto') and four rows on a 114 px pitch – Home, About, Playground, Connect › – with medium-weight ~36 px off-white type and 42 px icons at x≈693. Hovered rows get a #191919 rounded band (Connect at 3.65s). Clicking Connect at ~4.22s drills down: the card grows upward from top 367 to 253 by 4.37s while the switcher rides up crisp and the row list cross-fades with blur into Back, Twitter / X, Cosmos, LinkedIn, Email. Clicking Back at ~5.95s reverses it (top 253→367 by 6.12s, rows blur-swap back). At ~7.63s the card collapses fast to a blank narrow pill (~530 wide, 74 tall at 7.70s), which springs back to the full 589x134 icon pill by ~7.92s. All type is a neutral grotesk; nothing has a stroke, shadow or gradient – flat fills only.

me9pu7-northwind-crm-activity-interface.summary: A light, monochrome CRM record page inside one large white rounded card (x72–1368, y90–900, radius ~24, 1px #e6e6e6 border) on a #f1f1f1 page. The card has a narrow left rail (x72–122) with a black 26px app square and five pale grey icon squares, a breadcrumb bar "Companies / Northwind" with a hairline under it at y133, then the record: a grey-tile logo glyph + "Northwind" in ~30px dark sans, a row of seven pill/round buttons on the right, a 22-row label/value Details column (x151–420) split by a vertical hairline at x421, and a tabbed Activity feed (x450–1339) with a filter row and 7 timeline rows separated by hairlines. The clip is a four-step UX critique told as a redesign. Each step runs the same cycle: the page dims to ~35% (except the subject, which stays crisp inside a thin grey outlined box), a numbered caption "0N TITLE" plus a black problem sentence appears under the card, a horizontal cyan scan line sweeps top to bottom and turns the page into a cyan wireframe blueprint (outlined boxes, cyan text, measurement brackets and labels in mono caps like "6 ACTIONS · SAME WEIGHT"), the blueprint morphs into the new layout, and then a second scan line sweeps down and reveals the redesigned page solid while a cyan solution sentence fades in at right. Step 1 (0–8s): seven action buttons collapse to "Compose email" + "…". Step 2 (8.5–16s): the Details column disappears and the record centres into a 685px column with a fact line "B2B SaaS · 240 people · Berlin · Customer since Mar 2024 $48k ARR · All details ›" and a green CUSTOMER chip. Step 3 (~17–24s): a bordered "Needs you 3" card with three task rows (black "Send proposal" primary) is inserted above the tabs, pushing the feed down. Step 4 (~25–30s): the six tabs and two filters become a "Timeline" heading with a "Relationship" dropdown and a people/deals feed with chevrons.

19rfcz-infinite-liquid-carousel.summary: A full-bleed, near-black (#000001) field holds an endless brick-pattern wall of thick liquid-glass tiles. Each tile is about 712 x 536 px at the centre, landscape, with corners rounded to about 70 px. The tiles are laid on a curved surface like the inside of a sphere: tiles near the frame edges bow, lean and shrink, and the gaps between them read as black seams about 15 to 30 px wide. Rows alternate by about half a tile horizontally. Every tile is a photo (mountain sunset, storm clouds, snowy peak in fog, sunlit forest, night city, blue-sky cumulus, starry ridge) behind a bevelled glass slab. The slab has a bright smeared highlight along its top edge and down its left side, refractive magnification at the rim, and no drawn stroke. Each tile carries the same editorial layout: top-left a monospace caption ("ILG-18" in mint green plus a category such as "WAYFINDING"), top-right "SELECTED WORK • 2026", a thin hairline divider at about 63% of the height, a huge white tight-tracked grotesque title ("Superlocal"), a small white subtitle bottom-left, and "ENTER" plus a small circled arrow bottom-right. A small hollow cursor ring (about 22 px) floats over the wall. Motion: the whole wall is dragged and pans continuously in 2D. From 0.05 to 2.1s it swings right and down, then back up-left. It nearly holds from 2.15 to 3.2s with the Superlocal tile centred. Then it pans fast: right by about 470 px by 3.67s, then on through 4 to 14s, revealing new titles (Common Sky, Useful Noise, Tender Machines, Drift State, Hard Light, Infinite City, Blue Hour, Parallel, Glass House, Near Future, Echo Chamber, Deep Surface…) and wrapping round infinitely, with the same photos reused under different titles. While it moves, the tiles toward the edges smear with a wavy, liquid displacement and RGB chromatic fringing. The centred tile stays almost clean.

bpjxl6-x-money-landing-page.summary: A light macOS-style browser window (rounded ~20px, soft drop shadow, #f3f3f3 title bar with red/yellow/green lights and a grey #e3e3e3 pill URL bar) floats on a near-white #fdfdfd stage. Inside, a fixed left sidebar (logo + "Money" switcher, then Overview/Features/Updates/Help/Legal in 12px type, Overview dark, the rest grey) sits beside a 985px content column (x 422–1407) whose sections are split by 1px #e8e8e8 hairlines. The hero is a centred two-line ~44px headline "Your money, on the world's / most powerful network." over a rendered matte-black envelope with a debossed X. Motion: from 0 to ~0.9s the headline words fade/blur in one by one, rising and darkening from grey to black; the closed envelope spins on its vertical axis (edge-on at 0.95s), then its flaps fold open (half open at 1.85s, fully open at 2.35s) to reveal a brushed-silver X card. From 2.35s the page scrolls (only the content column moves; the chrome and sidebar stay fixed) through "Built to earn" with a phone screenshot, "Industry-leading interest" whose grey panel resolves from heavy blur to a sharp "Up to 6.00% APY¹" surrounded by floating white savings tiles that drift at different parallax rates and sit at different depths of focus, then the "One app / Everything money can do" grid of numbered feature tiles 01–06 where the hovered tile stays full contrast and the others wash out to pale grey. The scroll continues through FDIC, FAQ and footer, then returns to the top by ~14.5s and rests on the opened hero with "Rolling out to select users in the United States." and a black pill "Follow for updates" button to the end (18.05s).

ef41k3-aging-ui-toggle-switch.summary: A single oversized iOS-style toggle sits dead centre on a near-white (#fdfdfd) canvas with nothing else in the frame. The track is a pill 290x178 px at [573,459] with fully round ends (radius 89). Off, it is flat light grey (#d2d2d2). On, it is a saturated royal blue (#2f5ce8 to #4a74e6). A circular knob about 150 px across sits inset about 14 px from the track's top and bottom edges. A mouse cursor starts as a black arrow near (885,628), becomes a white hand pointer resting at about (735,620) over the bottom of the knob, and clicks the switch again and again. Each click snaps the knob about 96 px between left (centre x≈662) and right (centre x≈758 to 775). The track crossfades grey↔blue in roughly 50 to 100 ms, passing through a pale periwinkle (#a0b4e0) on the way. The idea is that the switch ages as it is used. At 0.45s the knob is a crisp flat white disc with a thin mid-grey rim. By 2.6s it is off-white and scuffed, and 4 faint grey speed lines trail to its right. From about 5.9s it turns grey with a fine dot-matrix/halftone texture and a darker centre vignette. Its rim becomes a doubled, worn metal-like ring with a dashed light inner line, and it squashes into a wide ellipse (about 180x150) mid-travel. The trailing speed lines grow into 8 or more heavy, blurred horizontal streaks, grey on the off side (x 735 to 775) and dark blue on the on side (x 660 to 705). The on-colour also loses saturation in some transitions (a pale lavender-grey #c8cbd8 at 6.68s and 7.8s). Toggles land at about 1.0, 1.9, 3.3, 4.15, then a burst at 4.5 to 5.95. A slow, washed-out transition runs from 6.1 to 6.9, followed by 7.7 (off), 8.55 (on) and 10.0 (off), and the clip ends on the worn knob at rest on the left over a grey track.

132a6s-butterflies-thinking-animation.summary: A near-white (#fdfdfd) 1160x720 canvas with one huge black line of type, "Thinking..." in a neutral grotesque sans (Inter/SF-like, regular-medium weight, cap height ~120px), spanning x 218-934, baseline ~y405, with the g descender to ~y435. Top-right sits a small pill button "GIF" with a download-arrow icon (box ~1055,18,86,44), white fill, 1px very light grey border, fully rounded. The text and button never move. The motion is a looping swarm of small flat-illustrated butterflies (~15-35px), each with two-tone wings (upper and lower wings in different saturated colours: purple, pink, orange, yellow, teal, mint, sky blue), a white highlight dot on each wing lobe, a thin dark body and two antennae. A cycle runs ~4.3s and plays twice (0.3-3.15s and 4.7-7.6s): butterflies enter from the left of the word, flock onto the letters left to right until the glyphs are densely covered (peak ~1.0-1.7s and ~5.3-6.0s, with "Thinking" heavily covered and the dots partly), then lift off and drift up and to the right, fading and blurring as they recede (distant ones are translucent and soft), leaving the screen empty by ~3.2s and ~7.6s. Between swarms (3.2-4.65s) the frame holds plain text only; the butterflies flap (wings change silhouette frame to frame) and sit on top of the type.

mlzkeu-staggered-animation-technique.summary: A single left-aligned text column on a flat pure-black (#000) 1088x1080 frame, left edge at x=147, no card, no border. From the top: a small grey monospace uppercase letter-spaced eyebrow "PHYSICAL KEY, DIGITAL ACCESS" (y≈144). Below it, the heading "Music you can feel" in a white semibold sans of about 30px (y≈185). Then three light-grey body paragraphs at about 18px with roughly 29.7px line spacing: 4 lines, 6 lines and 2 lines, starting at y≈247, 387 and 586, wrapping near x≈915. Below the paragraphs sits a 3x3 grid of white chart-company logos (Billboard, Official Charts, Circle Chart / TurnTable Charts, ARIA, SNEP / Offizielle Deutsche Charts, Billboard Japan, GfK), spanning x≈146–535 and y≈703–893. Last comes a link, "Partner with us >", at y≈966. The motion is a staggered text reveal that plays three times. Each text line reveals left to right, and each line shows three zones. On the left, finished text is crisp. Behind the moving front, glyphs are smeared horizontally into repeated, stretched copies with a violet/magenta tint and red and blue colour fringes. Ahead of the front, text is dim grey and fades to nothing on the right. The eyebrow and heading lead. Paragraph 1 follows, then paragraph 2, then paragraph 3. Paragraphs further down run behind the ones above. The CTA finishes last. The logos do not smear. All nine fade in together as one group, from dim grey to white. Cycle 1 is already under way at 0s and is fully settled by about 2.7s. The page then holds perfectly still until about 5.5s, when it hard-cuts to black. The reveal restarts at about 5.9s (settled by about 8.8s), holds, cuts to black at about 9.8s, and restarts at about 10.1s. The settled layout never moves or resizes.

14asp6-koi-pond-portfolio-hero.summary: A single centred column on a #fafafa page. At the top (y≈33–100) sits a small segmented nav: a white circular home button (solid black house icon) fused to a smaller light-grey circle holding a grey briefcase icon, the two joined like a metaball pill. Below it the hero is a wide koi-pond picture, x≈195–920, y≈155–635, whose edges are not a hard rounded rectangle but a soft feathered vignette (~30 px fade to the page white, corners heavily rounded). Inside: dark green pond floor under a live water-caustic net (bright, soft, grainy light veins around dark cells) that shifts constantly; three smooth river stones (a dark one top-right, a small dark one right, an olive one lower-left); dark-green grass blades at the left, top and bottom-right; and four painted koi (orange, white-and-orange kohaku, yellow-and-black, red) that swim slowly the whole clip, leaving through the feathered edge and coming back in. A click in the water makes a soft refractive ripple, the picture bending in concentric bands with faint bright crests and no stroke. It grows from ~130 px to ~230 px across between 14.6 s and 15.0 s and has faded by 15.4 s. iy5mx6-hearth-life-os-dashboard.summary: A light Life OS dashboard on a pale blue-grey page (#e5e9ec). The app window is a flat off-white rectangle with square corners, x 85–1265, y 144–936. A 206 px sidebar on the left (#f3f3f3, hairline right border at x≈291) holds the black square 'Hearth' logo with 'Life OS' under it, a grey search field ('Search ...', 'F⌘'), a 'Main' nav list (Chat, Goals as a black active pill, Calendar 8, Tasks 2, Memory, Files), a 'Today' list of seven short prompts, Setting/Help Center rows, a 'RahMan' user card and a Light/Dark/System segmented switch with Light active in black. The main column, which starts at x≈317, has a breadcrumb '< Goals' and, at top right, a bell button, a black 'New' button and a menu button. Below that is a hero card (y 214–401) with a blue mono kicker 'WELCOME BACK', 'Life Goals' in large bold monospace, a grey subline, a black 'New Goal' button and a white 'Vision Board' button. A painted watercolour landscape of green hills, a blue mountain and a silhouetted person fills the right 60% of the card and fades into the card's light grey on the left. Next come a 4-tab segmented control (All Goals active), a 'Q3 2026' date picker, and 'Active Targets' with two metric cards: Health & Longevity 78%, which has a thin line chart, a dashed marker and W1/W2/W3 chips, and Financial Freedom 45%, which has a dense grey bar histogram with a darker middle band. Then come a 'Vision Board' row of three cards with grey monochrome illustrations, and a right column with 'Life Pillars' (4 rows) and a 2x2 'Quick Stats' grid. All type is monospace, apart from the sans 'Hearth'/'Q3 2026' and a few small labels. Cards use about 10–12 px radii, 1 px light borders and very soft shadows. Motion: the sidebar and top bar are present from frame 0. The main content fades in a section at a time while rising about 4 px: the hero first (about 0.1–0.4 s), then the tabs and section headings (about 0.4 s), then the Health card (about 1.0–1.5 s, its line chart drawing in after the marker), then the Financial card (about 1.7–2.0 s), the three Vision Board cards staggered left to right (about 2.4–3.2 s), the Life Pillars rows top to bottom (about 3.0–3.8 s) and the Quick Stats tiles (about 3.5–4.3 s). After that the layout holds. Only two things keep moving: the hero painting drifts slowly, and the New Goal button pulses its scale by about 1–2 px.

4qsva1-radial-dropdown-interaction.summary: A single white select field sits centred on a near-white (#fefefe) page: a 317x77 px pill at (201,322) with about 16 px corner radius, a 1 px pale-grey hairline, and a soft grey drop shadow that falls about 10 to 20 px below it. It holds the current value left-aligned in near-black, about 26 px regular sans ("In Review" at 0.45s), and a dark-grey up/down chevron pair at the right (x≈469-491). A macOS arrow cursor wanders the frame. When the field opens, the five status options ("To Do", "In Progress", "In Review", "Shipped", "Blocked") appear in mid-grey (#8a8a8a-ish, ~22 px) as plain floating text with no list surface. They sit on the left rim of a large invisible wheel whose centre is far to the right, so every label is rotated to match its angle: To Do about -15°, In Progress about -8°, Shipped about +8°, Blocked about +18°. The rows are spaced about 70 px apart and lean further left the further they are from the field. The current value occupies the field's slot. Choosing the neighbour turns the whole wheel by one slot in about 250 ms (1.9-2.15s): every label slides about 70-76 px along the arc and re-rotates. The new value glides into the field and darkens to near-black, drawn above the pill, so it overlaps the pill's edge mid-move. The old value leaves the field, turns grey and tilts. Closing (from ~2.4s) fades the labels out while they keep drifting clockwise about 20-40 px with a slight blur, and they are gone by ~2.9s. Opening (~0.75-0.85s) is a quick ~100 ms fade in at the rest positions. The cycle repeats: open, rotate, close about every 2 s. The value alternates In Review → In Progress (2.0s) → In Review (4.0s) → In Progress (6.0s) → In Review (8.1s) → In Progress (10.0s) → In Review (12.0s). The pill itself never moves.

1ld66j-axonometric-floor-plan-stepper.summary: A light #f3f3f3 page holds one left-aligned demo card that shows four isometric diagrams one after another, with no change to the page chrome. At the top left is a small, widely tracked monospace eyebrow, "AXONOMETRIC PLAN · OPTIONAL MOTION" or "EXPLODED AXONOMETRIC · OPTIONAL MOTION". Below it is a large condensed serif title in near-black, "<Subject> · <tagline>". The middle holds a crisp line-drawn axonometric diagram: white extruded volumes with 1px dark-grey strokes. One focal zone is tinted a pale salmon (#f7e8e8) and its label is set in a coral-red accent. Under the diagram are a tiny mono caption ("FOCAL ZONE", "FOCAL ROOM" or "FOCAL LAYER") and an italic one-line note. A thin hairline separates the diagram from the control bar: five outlined buttons with radius ~3px (Previous, Play, Pause, Next, Replay), a keyboard hint "←/→ step · Space play/pause · R replay · Home/End jump", and a right-aligned mono "Step n of N". The disabled button (Previous at step 0, Next at the last step) is greyed. Motion is stepwise. Each step fades in the next group of parts (racks, stations, furniture, seats) with their white label chips, and the step counter advances. In the exploded diagrams (keyboard, agent stack), the next layer starts nested in the base and rises up to its own level. Its leader line and label fade in from ~20% to full opacity in about 0.4s. The demos cycle: Fulfillment floor (0–3.85s, steps 0→3), Corner coffee shop (3.9–8.1s), Mechanical keyboard (8.15–13.0s, steps 1→5), AI agent stack (13.05s–end, steps 1→5).

1r58ef-dithered-charts-library.summary: A dark product-page section (#141417 ground) cropped from a wider layout: one line of grey body copy runs across the top left ("pull requests, and comments across your organization.", y≈38–56). Below it is a row of three stat cards whose tops sit at y≈106, and the frame cuts off two of them. On the left only the bottom right of a red card shows (its chart is x 0–105). The middle card is complete ("Resolved today", "38", green "▲ 12", a blue chart from x 126 to 429). On the right is "Automod · 24h", "126", green "▼ 8", and a violet chart running off the right edge at 644. Each card has a grey 15px label at y≈131, a large white number of about 30px at y≈166–192 with a small green delta beside it, and an area chart at y≈215–275. Every chart is drawn as pixel art. Its top edge is a stair-stepped silhouette on a grid of about 3px, with a 1–2px pale highlight along the crest. The fill is an ordered (Bayer-style) dither that is nearly solid colour just under the crest and breaks up into a sparser square-dot checker towards the bottom, fading into the background. The fill is not a smooth gradient. A few single white pixels twinkle inside and just under the fills. The blue chart rises steadily from left to right, while the red and violet charts are mountain-shaped. Motion is driven by hover. As the pointer (a hand cursor) moves over a card, a 1px dark-grey rounded outline (radius ≈14px) fades in around the whole card (for the blue card, about x 122–429, y 106–277), and that card's chart brightens: its blue goes from about #3479d3 to #3b99f5, and the solid band under the crest thickens from about 3px to about 10px. When the pointer leaves, both changes reverse. The hover goes to blue (≈1.35–2.2s and ≈3.35–4.35s), then violet (≈5.3–6.25s and from ≈7.2s through ≈8.2s), then red (≈9.0s, and again ≈10.9–11.3s), then back to blue near 12s. Text, numbers and chart shapes never move. The only constant motion is the twinkle of sparkle pixels.

1d5ivc-elemental-glow-cards.summary: A dark, nearly black stage (#070707–#080a09 with a fine film grain) holds a horizontal carousel of four tall pill-shaped cards (fully rounded ends, ~230 x 370 px), three visible at once on one baseline: left card centred x≈263, active card centred x≈720, right card centred x≈1178 (≈457 px pitch), all spanning y≈335–710. The cycle is 01 Ember (fire), 02 Solar (sun), 03 Breeze (air), 04 Bloom (heart). Each card carries a tiny monospace index at top ("01"…), a thin white line icon in the middle (campfire flame over crossed logs; sun with 8 rays; three wind lines with curls; six-petal flower with a ring centre), a bold grotesk title (~28 px) and a letter-spaced monospace caption ("FIRE · COURAGE", "SUN · VITALITY", "AIR · CLARITY", "HEART · WARMTH"). Inactive cards are black-to-deep-red (Breeze black-to-green) with a faint 1 px grey rim, grey type and no glow. The active centre card turns into a soft glossy mesh gradient (Ember magenta→orange, Solar salmon/orange/lime, Breeze mint/green/blue, Bloom violet→magenta), its type goes pure white, and it wears an element effect: painterly flames with sparks and little outline triangles rising off its top (Ember), a gold rim with a radial sunburst of fine rays and small floating rings (Solar), a halo of curved mint streak lines flowing around it like wind through a tunnel (Breeze), or a large glowing pink lotus of painted petals behind it (Bloom). The page background, a horizontal glow strip on the floor at y≈850 and a blurred mirror reflection of the cards at the bottom edge (y≈960–1080) all tint to the active element's colour. Clicking a side card slides the whole row ~457 px in ~0.35–0.4 s (e.g. 0.93–1.3 s) so that card lands in the centre; its effect then blooms in over ~0.3–0.5 s while the outgoing card's effect breaks up into drifting particles and fades as it slides to the side, and a fourth card fades in/out at the frame edge. Between clicks the active effect keeps animating in place (flames flicker, rays and rings drift, wind streaks flow, petals glow) while the cards themselves stay still.

kolbk2-hero-section-concept.summary: A law-firm hero ("MERIDIAN") on a cream card [72,135,1296,810] with square corners, set inside a painterly anime-style landscape (blue sky with brushy clouds, a castle spire peeking above the card's top edge at x≈655, golden fields and a small figure at bottom right). The painting fills the frame and does not move. The card's top 55 px is a nav bar: a quill icon and the serif wordmark "MERIDIAN" on the left, four sans links in the middle, and a dark maroon "Book Now" button on the right. A hairline sits under the nav at y≈190. Faint vertical rulers run down both card edges: a tick strip plus rotated numbers 0, 10, 20 … 210. The left column starts at x=162: a small maroon round badge icon with the serif eyebrow "Trusted Corporate Consultant Specialist", a two-line maroon serif headline about 52 px tall ("Legal precision for / ambitious business"), a two-line sans paragraph, a maroon "Take Consultation >" button with a soft drop shadow next to a beige "Learn More" pill, and lower down three grey laurel-wreath award badges, each with three maroon stars. The right half shows a grey marble Lady Justice statue (blindfold, raised scales, sword held low, billowing drapery) on a hazy cloud wash; its lower part fades into the cream. The motion is a single staggered intro from 0 to about 1.5 s. The nav and the painting are there from frame 0. The statue first shows as a coarse maroon halftone of square dots (about 7 px pitch) that fills in and then crossfades into the smooth grey render by about 0.9 s. Over the same span the text blur-fades in from top to bottom, each item rising about 12 px from heavy blur and low opacity to sharp: eyebrow at about 0.1 s, headline line 1 at 0.2–0.45 s, line 2 at 0.3–0.55 s, paragraph at 0.6–1.0 s, buttons at 0.95–1.25 s, badges at 1.15–1.5 s. After about 1.6 s the frame holds still.

6wu9tt-minimal-portfolio-with-ai-imagery.summary: A browser window (Safari-style toolbar, 38px tall, URL "daniasyrofi.com" centred) shows a light, near-white (#fdfdfd) single-column portfolio. The content column is 600 CSS px wide, from x≈544 to x≈1176 in frame px. Top row: "Jakarta / 20:08" in small grey on the left; a translate icon, "EN ⌄", a thin divider and a sun icon on the right (y≈111). Below that: a 104px circular-vignette portrait at top-left (x 556–660, y 165–277). On the right of the same band, a two-line grey tagline "Shaping future design, / pixel by pixel." and, under it, a small pill toggle and an outlined "Send message ↗" button. Both controls sit inside thin square selection frames with corner handles (grey for the toggle, green for the button). Then a large bold grotesk name "Dani Asyrofi" (≈44px), a grey subtitle "Product designer, building in code." (≈26px), and three 16px grey body paragraphs with underlined brand links and small brand glyphs. Then "Built to be used" with a "Loading" project row (a grey 84px tile with a spinner of 8 strokes, a title, a description, the meta line "Design & development", and an ↗ button in a handle frame), and "Writing" with an "All articles ↗" button. Three magazine covers peek in at the bottom edge: white "LOGO GRID", yellow "DESIGNERS", pale cyan "TRAINING". The clip has two states. At rest (0–1.4s and 11.4s–end) the toggle is grey and off, and the page is bare. The cursor hovers the toggle at ~0.9s and a dark "Creative mode" tooltip appears above it. At ~1.43s the toggle switches on: the knob slides right and the track fills royal blue (#3b4fc4-ish). By ~1.5s a design-annotation overlay appears all at once. It has a dotted outline around the 600px column with a blue "600 px" label at its top, hairline dividers above "Built to be used" (y≈702) and "Writing" (y≈923), a thin box around the Loading row, and four handwritten blue notes with curved arrows in the margins ("01 / A little eye contact…", "02 / Room to read…", "03 / Ideas, made tangible…", "04 / A closer look…"). A black "Style ⌃" pill rises from below the frame bottom to rest at the bottom-right (top 1009) between 1.43s and 1.65s, easing out. While the overlay is on, the portrait swaps between AI-generated variants as the cursor moves: a greyscale photo, a colour photo and a flat cartoon, each facing a different direction. At ~11.2s the toggle is switched off. The Style pill slides down off-frame (11.2–11.4s), the notes and guides vanish, and the toggle returns to grey. From then on the portrait shows the cartoon variant.

1a1cj5-hover-draggable-carousel.summary: A Raindrop careers page shown inside a floating browser-window card (light #faf9f8 surface, ~16px radius, wide soft grey shadow on a near-white backdrop). A thin top nav: drop-glyph "raindrop" wordmark at left, five centred grey links (Product, Docs, Blog, Careers, Enterprise), "Log in" and a black square-cornered "Get started" button at right. Content is a single left-aligned column starting at x=471: a tiny letter-spaced mono eyebrow "CAREERS", a two-line ~64px regular-weight headline "Help us solve humanity's last problem.", then a fan of 13 polaroid photo cards (cream frames with a deep bottom lip, soft drop shadows) arranged on an arc: the centre card upright and in front, the others rotating progressively outward to about ±15° and tucking behind each other. Below sits a grey 18px body paragraph, then a stats row (San Francisco / <20 / 200+ with mono caption labels, split by hairline dividers), "Open roles" with grouped job rows and outlined APPLY buttons, "The team" with a typewriter line, "Our values" in a 2-column grid with dot-matrix pixel icons, and finally "In the news". Motion: hovering a card lifts it, straightens it and pushes its neighbours apart (0.5→1.1→1.6s, the lift travels card to card with the cursor); cards can be dragged out of the fan and dropped anywhere on the page, where they stay tilted ~8–20° with a larger shadow (≈2.5–6.8s and 8–9.9s; by 10.45s cards sit loose at the left and right edges). From ~10.15s the page scrolls; the dropped cards scroll with the page and pass under the nav, which is frosted glass and blurs them. At 12.1→12.6s the page scrolls ~328px and "The team" line types out character by character with a caret ("We sc" → "We scaled fraud detectio"), later completing "We scaled fraud detection at Square... in 2013." and cycling to "We pioneered Pinterest's recommender system." The recording camera itself zooms in and out (2.2–3.15s, 8–9.85s, 14.7–15.5s) with motion blur; that is the screen recorder, not the design.

1fut80-minimal-tooltip-thinking-mode.summary: A plain light canvas (#fdfdfd) built like an AI chat transcript. A near-black pill message bubble (#101010, fully rounded, about 383x85 px) sits top-right at x 607–990, y 108–193 and reads "Get us live in Sweden." in white sans (~28 px). It blurs and fades in between 0.3 s and 0.7 s. Under it, a left-aligned agent log starts at x 104 (icons) and x 149 (text), top row at y 283. From about 1.5 s a spinner and a shimmering grey "Start thinking…" header with a running seconds counter appear. Below them, grey reasoning text (~26 px, 44 px line height) streams in word by word with a blur fade. The text scrolls upward behind a top fade mask: two paragraphs, then the numbered list "1. Read Swedish order history … 5. Write the launch report", then "Orders first. They set the baseline for everything else." At about 6 s the whole thinking block blurs away and the header rolls from "Start thinking…" to "Working", led by a chevron. A thin grey vertical timeline at x 115 then grows down the left as steps arrive in 63 px rows, each with a spinner that turns into a grey dot when it finishes. The steps are: "Done thinking"; "Reading → Read 🛍 Shopify Swedish orders" with a bordered, rounded two-row subtask card (spinners become black check discs); "Start searching N sources → Searched 46 sources" with grey chips (acedesign.io, LinkedIn – Ace Design Io…, X – Ace Design Io News, AI Search, 20+ more); "Delegating to Brand Researcher" with a second subtask card; "Preparing the report" with a file-preview card labelled "sweden-insight PDF" and a blue cursor. That card collapses to "Report is ready 📄 Sweden Insight", and "Finished working" with a blue check disc blurs in at about 28.5 s. The bubble never moves. All motion is appearance in place: blur and fade, spinner rotation, counter ticks, and rows pushing content down.

1scbmv-blueprint-contact-page-details.summary: The whole frame is a vivid blue (#2e5ff6) canvas styled as a design-tool blueprint sheet. A full-width horizontal ruler sits at y≈250–270. It has thin pale-blue ticks and tiny mono labels from -300 to 1400; 0 sits at x≈413 and the spacing is about 112 px per 100 units. A hairline at y≈288 runs under it. A vertical ruler with labels 100–500 runs down the left edge (x≈0–20). Two thin vertical guides run from y≈250 to 828: one at x≈368, and one at x≈1640 that edges a 50 px band of diagonal hatching (x≈1640–1690). Above y≈250 and below y≈828 there is only plain blue. Left column, aligned at x=439: a mono eyebrow "SHEET 05 · CONTACT" with a diamond, a large bold white sans headline "Say hello." (y≈462–515), a light white subline, and a white rounded "Get in touch" button (≈138×48, radius ≈6, soft drop shadow, blue label). Right column: a mono caption "LAST VISITOR · CUPERTINO, US · JUST NOW" above a dotted pixel world map (≈1070–1565 × 418–622). The map is made of small pale square dots with about 40 brighter white square visitor markers. A square-in-square marker over Cupertino (≈1133,473) pulses a faint outer square. A hairline divider at y≈725 spans x 439–1568. The footer row at y≈766 holds "imdaryl.com", "London" (dotted underline), a mono "REV. 2026.09 · BUILT FROM PERSONAL TASTE", and at the right "Email" with an envelope icon and an X logo. The layout never moves; all motion follows the cursor. The top ruler shows a bright tick and a numeric readout of the cursor's x (e.g. 544 at 1s, 893 at 7.4s), and the left ruler shows its y (e.g. 181). At 0.5s the hovered button shows measurement annotations: a highlighted 0–124 span on the ruler, a "124" dimension line under the button and "43" at its right. From about 2s to 14s the cursor glides over the map. Over each visitor marker it shows a white mono tooltip ("City, CC · N min ago", ≈190×24, radius ≈3, blue text) just above the marker. Tooltips swap instantly: Gwynn Oak 2.5s, Almaty 7.4s, Magnitogorsk 7.9s.

x963s1-shader-range.summary: On a near-white page (#fcfcfc) three identical dark rounded cards (700x178 px, radius about 50 px, fill #1f1f21) are stacked and centred: x 625-1324 at y 222-399, 451-628 and 681-857, with 52 px gaps. Each card is a progress range. On the left is a bold white uppercase label ending in an asterisk ("MODEL TRAINING*", "AGENT MIGRATION*", "VISUAL TRAINING*"), cap height about 21 px, at x 675. Under it is a smaller, letter-spaced grey caption. A large white percentage in a medium weight (cap height about 42 px) is right-aligned so it ends at about x 1272. Each card is filled from its left edge to a vertical front at card-left + percent x 700 px. The fill is a shader. The card's left end carries a dark tint (plum on the top card, navy in the middle, violet at the bottom). This brightens toward the front into a saturated hue band: orange-pink-magenta on the top card, cyan-blue on the middle, green-purple on the bottom. The band ends in a thin, bright, almost white glowing rim. While a bar moves, its front ripples into a wavy, liquid profile (3-5 bumps over its height), and soft, blurred concentric dark arcs spread leftward through the colour like water rings. When the bar comes to rest the front settles into a straight vertical line. The bars move independently and almost all clip long, with brief holds near 0-1.05 s, 1.85-2.25 s, 3.05-3.55 s and 3.65-4.05 s. Each percentage counts up or down in step with its front (top 64→44→49→58→62→35→34; middle 37→34→50→52→38→49→52; bottom 73→59→28→21→28→37→30). The glowing front is drawn over the label and caption type as it passes. Nothing else moves: the cards, labels and page stay fixed.

A centred nav strip (x 186–902, bounded by thin vertical hairlines and a hairline at y 56) holds the blue Switchyard logo left, five grey links in the middle (Product, docs, Deploy, Security, Pricing) and an outlined "Book a demo" pill right. A glossy blue rounded-square hub chip (79 px, white S mark) sits at the centre with small grey pin pads on its top, left and right sides. Four thin vertical wires rise from the top pins. Raised pale pill labels "MCP", a blank one, and "Data" sit above the hub, and small grey captions "Requested MCP" and "Controlled Access" sit by the inner tiles. The layout never moves. The only motion is short soft glowing light streaks, mostly blue with an occasional red one, that slide along the traces at different points through the 6 s loop. The tiles and hub stay fixed.

x3v0ch-food-joints-scroll-carousel.summary: A minimal, centred single-page showcase on a white (#ffffff) surface. Top-left a pale grey pill button "Dark" (≈30,27,68x40, radius full, 14px grey type); bottom centre a muted grey hint "Scroll to browse · click a restaurant" at y≈1038. The middle band (y≈335–730) is a horizontal carousel of isometric low-poly 3D storefront renders (Starbucks, KFC, Domino's, Taco Bell, McDonald's, Burger King, Subway, Pizza Hut…), one per column on a ≈431px pitch; each column stacks a small grey "Since YYYY" line at y≈343, a ≈310x260 render (y≈370–630), a dark 16px name at y≈694 and a lighter grey category at y≈718. The column nearest the centre is fully opaque with near-black name; neighbours are faded (lighter text, washed-out render) and the outermost columns fade into white at the screen edges. Motion: 0–1.9s rest with KFC centred (x≈876); 1.95–2.35s the strip glides left ≈422px (KFC to x≈454), then continues to ≈2.5s so Taco Bell is centred (x≈948) and McDonald's sits at x≈1379; ≈3.6–4.3s the user clicks McDonald's: the carousel fades out and a detail view fades in with the McDonald's render enlarged and centred (≈655–1265 x 130–595), a 36px near-black title "McDonald's" at y≈740, grey "Burgers", a bold 18px quote line, a two-line grey description (centred, max ≈550px) and a small grey "Founded 1940 …" line, "Drag to rotate" hint at the bottom and a "Back" pill top-right (≈1818,27,72x40). From ≈5.5–7.5s the model is dragged and orbits about its vertical axis (rear view at ≈6.2s), then returns to front. ≈8.65–9.05s the "Dark" pill is clicked: the whole page cross-fades through mid grey (#5f5f5f at 8.85s) to near-black #0d0d0f, the pill reads "Light", type turns white/grey, and the 3D scene is relit as night—the golden arches glow with a soft bloom, windows glow warm, a lamp post casts a warm pool on the lot. The model is rotated again ≈9.5–11.5s. At ≈12.5s "Back" is clicked and the dark-mode carousel returns (≈13.2s) with McDonald's/Burger King centred, then scrolls left to Subway and Pizza Hut by 14.9s.

1ig0k2-task-app-reward-motion.summary: A black-bezelled iPhone, cropped so only its lower two-thirds shows, sits centred on a flat #c1c1c1 grey field; the screen is a pale #f2f2f2. On the screen sit two stacked cards, both 719–724 px wide and centred at x≈702. The first is a white rounded card (radius ≈40) with a header row, "Every 8 hours", and a grey count "3" on the right. Under the header, hairline dividers split three task rows. Each row has a black glyph on the left (a 2×2 rounded-square grid, a filled check circle, a lightning bolt), a small grey label over a larger dark title, and a 72 px control on the right: a black "+" button, a purple progress ring about 40% full around a pale lilac disc holding a purple gem, and a full red ring around a pink disc holding a flame. Below that is a lilac (#ecbdfc) "Earned a Badge / Challenger" banner. Its right end holds a rendered 3D reward tile: a dark purple card with a gold crown hexagon and the word "Challenger", in front of fanned blue, white, green and magenta shapes. The type is a clean geometric sans (SF Pro–like), medium weight for titles, regular grey for labels. The motion is a reveal loop. The resting UI (0–0.25 s) fades to a blank screen by about 0.45 s, stays empty until about 0.55 s, then rebuilds from 0.55 to 1.3 s. Content fades in staggered top to bottom ("Every 8 hours" first, then each row, the banner last) while drifting about 12 px upward (the banner about 28 px). Text goes from washed grey to full black, and the rings draw on from 12 o'clock: the purple one counter-clockwise to about 40%, the red one clockwise to a full circle. The gem and flame and the badge's fanned art come in last, at about 1.2 s. From about 1.3 s to 4.2 s everything holds still, apart from sub-pixel video noise.

7sqapa-onboarding-photo-selection.summary: A light lavender-grey (#f1f0f5) onboarding screen of a calendar app, filmed as a phone mock-up with camera moves. The clip opens on a blank, blurred view that comes into focus by ~1.0s. A centred grey two-line subtitle reads "These would look great, but the choice is yours." Below it sits a white rounded panel holding a large hero cover card (about 760x400 px at 1.3s, radius ~28 px). The card is a full-bleed photo of a woman in white seated before the Dolomites, overlaid with a translucent coral blob (two overlapping soft circles). The card also carries white type: "20 September 2026" top-left, a big "Sun 20" bottom-left and a mono row of seven tiny circles over the numbers 14–20 bottom-right. In the top-right corner is a frosted-glass circular button with two short white lines. A narrower neighbour card peeks in at the right edge. Below the card: a red "Today" label, grey skeleton bars, a thin divider, "7 June · Saturday" (black and grey) and a right-hand month rail showing "Jun", a red pill dash, grey dashes and "May". Between 2.6s and 3.3s the camera tilts the scene into a 3D-angled phone with a black bezel and a silver side rail at right. The hero then swipes horizontally through covers: at ~3.9–4.35s the coral shape morphs into one big disc and the photo crossfades; at ~5.75–6.25s it slides to a snowy-forest card; at ~6.9–7.3s to a monk in saffron on a hillside. More swipes follow at ~8.15–9.0s and ~9.7–10.0s (monk on a rock by the sea). Each time the outgoing card shrinks to a side thumbnail and the incoming one grows into the centre. From ~12.1s the camera pulls back and straightens, and a serif headline ending "cover?" shows above the subtitle. Around 14–15.5s a grey caption "That's a nice one." fades in near the bottom, then the screen fades to blank.

pw5p26-next-js-site-redesign.summary: A Next.js marketing homepage shown inside a 1482x988 black browser-like panel (46,46) with a 1px #202020 rounded border on a pure #000 canvas. A fixed 77px top nav holds the white triangle logo, a grey slash, the 'NEXT.js' wordmark, six grey links (Docs, Learn, Showcase, Blog, Templates ↗, Deploy ↗) and on the right a dark 'Search… ⌘K' field, an outlined 'Ask AI' button and a GitHub icon. The hero is centred: a giant outlined 'NEXT' wordmark (~965x230, 2px blue #255acd strokes, no fill) whose strokes fade to near-black navy toward the bottom, overlapped by a tight, bold white two-line headline 'The React Framework / for the Web' (~70px), a grey subline with bold white phrases, and a pill-shaped monospace 'npx create-next-app@latest' chip with a copy icon. The clip is a vertical page scroll in bursts, the nav staying fixed: 0.8–1.35s the hero scrolls up ~660px (a 1px nav bottom divider and a right-edge scrollbar thumb appear); by 3.05s 'Everything you need to build great products on the web' sits under the nav (scroll ~917) above three 455px feature cards with line-art illustrations (dotted mountains with ORIGINAL/1440PX/375PX frames, a grid with a browser mock, a 6-node tree); 4.65–5.35s it scrolls ~816px into a 3x3 text feature grid ending in a solid #0a66ff 'Next.js 16 →' card; 6.05–6.65s ~730px to 'Built on a foundation of fast, production-grade tooling' with React/Turbopack/Speedy Web Compiler cards; 7.55–8.05s ~484px more, revealing 'The framework of choice when it matters' with greyscale site screenshots; later bursts (8.65–9.35, 9.9–10.55, 11.3–11.85) move through the showcase, Sonos/Notion testimonial quotes and 'Get started in seconds' templates. Type is a tight geometric grotesk, white headlines, #a8a8a8 body; the mouse cursor stays parked in the frame.

1t0kma-casting-strength-radio-group.summary: A single white card (617x433, ~36px radius, 1px light-grey border, faint soft shadow beneath) sits slightly above centre on a flat #f9f9f9 page. Inside, a small grey label "Casting strength" heads a vertical radio group of three rows on a 111px pitch: Whisper / Chant / Invocation, each a 40px radio at x≈449 followed by a dark title and a grey one-line spell description at x≈515. The selected radio is a solid blue disc with a diagonal gradient (deeper #1f6de3 top-left to brighter #1b89e6 bottom-right) and a 12px white centre; unselected radios are 2px grey (#c9c9c9) rings. A hand cursor moves between rows; the hovered row gets a #f2f2f2 rounded (≈18px) pill 572x107 that fades in/out over ~0.2s, and hovered/selected titles darken to near-black. The signature move: on each click the selected blue disc disintegrates into square pixel particles (4–8px, mixed blues from #1f6de3 to pale sky blue) that stream along a curved arc — at times bulging outside the card's left edge — to the newly chosen radio, where they reassemble into the gradient disc; each transfer takes ≈0.5s. The selection hops Whisper→Chant (~1.0–1.5s), Chant→Invocation (~2.2–2.8s), Invocation→Whisper (~3.7–4.3s), Whisper→Chant (~4.9–5.3s), Chant→Invocation (~6.2–6.7s), Invocation→Whisper (~7.3–7.9s), Whisper→Invocation (~8.3–8.9s), Invocation→Whisper (~9.9–10.2s); the clip opens and closes with Whisper selected and an arrow cursor outside the card. The card, text and radios never move.

10fobt-morphing-svg-icon.summary: A screen recording of the "morphicons" landing page in a dark Chrome window (Incognito, URL morphicons.com) floating over a photo of a mountain lake at dusk, with a fragment of the macOS dock (Finder, Figma, Chrome) at bottom right. The browser window sits at x67–817, y68–1012 on the 882x1080 frame. The page is light grey (#fafafa). A top nav has the "morphicons" logo at left and the links Playground, Showcase, How it works, Roadmap, GitHub and X at right. Below it is a centred, black, bold two-line headline, "Morph any SVG / icon into any other.", then a two-line grey subtitle and a white `$ npm install morphicons` pill with a copy icon. Next comes a white stage card about 714 px wide. Behind it are four large blurred colour blobs (blue top-left, mint top-right, pink bottom-right, lilac bottom-left). In its centre is one big black round-capped stroke icon (about 75 px). Under the icon are three lines of tiny monospace caption (for example "arrow-down → check", "θ [52° -23°] res 0.337", "coordinate morph aligned frame cell division"), then a thin slider with a black knob and "t=1.00", then a row of eight small icon toggles (x, plus, arrow-right, arrow-down, check, chevron-down, heart, star). The active toggle carries a 1 px dark rounded-square outline, and a round white pause/play button sits after the row. Below the card are a filter tab row (All in a black pill, Lucide, Heroicons, Tabler) with a "Search icons" field, then a grid of thin-line icons, 19 per row, some on light-grey rounded cells. Motion: from 0 to about 5.9 s the big icon autoplays through x→plus→arrow-right→arrow-down→check→chevron-down→heart, about 1 s each. Each change is a quick (~0.3 s) stroke morph that rotates and bends the strokes, never a crossfade. The caption text and the outlined toggle follow each step. Between 5.9 and 6.6 s the recording zooms in about 1.7x on the stage with motion blur, and the pause button turns into a play button. From 6.6 to 8.35 s the cursor drags the slider knob back and forth. The icon sits as a wobbly half-heart/half-star at t=0.49 (label "heart → star", "θ [33°] res 0.219", "rotation + residual"). From 8.4 to 9.2 s it zooms back out to the full window. From 9.3 to 11.2 s it scrubs and settles on a clean star at t=1.00.

1j9utf-confidential-file-animation.summary: A single blue file folder sits centred on a flat warm cream page (#f4e8df). Closed, it is a portrait rounded rectangle [486,321,394,493] with about a 20px corner radius and a soft vertical gradient from #305ed1 at the top to #284db5 at the bottom. A white six-petal pinwheel mark sits top-left at (514–557, 357–396). At the bottom-left, the monospace uppercase "CONFIDENTIAL FILES" (white, ~20px) sits over a smaller sans line, "Internal use only", in pale blue-white at reduced opacity. A screen-recording arrow cursor floats below and to the right. On hover, the front cover swings open in 3D perspective on its left edge: the left edge stays at x≈488, the right edge pulls in to x≈837, its top corner rises to y≈270 and its bottom corner drops to y≈864. This reveals a darker blue back panel (#2f50a3) on the right, x 837–880, and a white paper peeking out to x≈915, tilted a few degrees, with "DO NOT OPEN" set vertically in dark monospace. On click, the paper slides fully out to the right (≈[715,348,351,438] at 8.75s). It then swings across in a rotateY flip over the folder, which has flattened back to its closed shape. It lands on top as a white document card ≈[480,326,405,483], rotated ≈6° counter-clockwise, with a soft shadow. The card holds three paragraphs of dark sans text, a small animated sticker of two cartoon cats that keeps wiggling during the hold, and a closing line. After about 1.5–2.5s the card flips back to its blank "DO NOT OPEN" back face, slides out to the right, tucks back into the folder, and the cover closes. The loop runs twice: hover 0.2s, slide-out ~1.6s, flip 1.75–2.35s, document hold 2.5–3.95s, flip back 4.0–4.45s, slide out 4.6–4.9s, closed ~5.9s; then hover ~7.45s, slide out ~8.0–8.75s, flip 8.65–9.25s, hold 9.4–11.95s, flip back 12.0–13.15s, closed ~14.65s. Two quick hover open/close peeks follow (≈15.95–16.75s and again from ≈17.4s).

mpkbov-creative-404-page.summary: A full-bleed 1760x1080 404 page set over an anime-style painting: a ruined, vine-covered stone aqueduct with tall arches comes in from the upper left and breaks off at frame centre, a broken stub picks up again on the right, a towering white cumulus fills the upper right, and blue mountains and a lake sit low in the gap. The UI is one centred column at x≈880: a small white logo (a two-block quote-mark glyph plus "Metricra" in a clean sans, ~22px) at y≈104; a huge monospace "404" with a slashed zero (≈240px tall, x 603–1158, y 333–573) filled translucent white that gets more opaque from left to right, so the bridge shows through the left "4" and the right "4" reads nearly solid white; a 1px hairline divider at y≈625 (x 619–1143); and two centred lines of white monospace body copy (~26px) at y≈697 and 729: "The path may be broken, but the / journey isn't. Let's get you back." There are no buttons. A macOS arrow cursor sits still at (1443,775). The only motion is in the painting itself, a living-wallpaper loop: the UI never moves. The big cloud mass drifts right and billows (its left edge at y≈300 goes from x≈1155 at 0s to x≈1220 at 4.03s, about 16px/s). Glowing yellow petals/sparks float up and to the right (one goes from (707,244) at 0s to (865,181) at 4.03s, about 40px/s right and 15px/s up). Firefly dots twinkle and drift among the foliage at the bottom. A bird flock streams across the sky to the right of the 404. A soft sun glint appears over the mountains near (887,932) by 3.6s and sits at (950,912) by 4.03s. The motion is continuous and linear, with no phases and no easing beats.

10w0ls-tidemind-hero-section.summary: A light cream (#faf4e4, faint paper grain) hero at 1916x1080. Top bar: lowercase wordmark "tidemind" at left (x150, y95), and at right two plain nav links "Agents" and "About" followed by a dark green (#17362d) rectangular "Get started ↗" button (1562,68,205x49) with cream text and near-square corners. Left column, left-aligned on x≈130: a very large two-line geometric sans headline "Beyond the / unknown." in near-black (cap ≈ 75px, block 128..616 x 415..590), a two-line grey subtitle "AI agents that turn curiosity / into clarity." (~26px) and a dark green "Launch your crew ↗" button (131,722,276x56). The right half is a soft-edged watercolor painting with no frame: a brass-and-glass domed greenhouse/observatory on a floating wooden platform with ivy, a glowing lantern-lit interior, a crane arm on the right, and a small wooden rowboat with a lantern and barrels tied to it by a rope, all over pale teal water whose edges fade into the paper. All UI is static for the whole 5s. The painting is a living clip: the rowboat drifts steadily left and slightly down (hull left edge ≈980px at 0.15s → ≈876px at 4.55s, ≈24px/s) with the rope stretching behind it and concentric ripples trailing it, the water reflections shimmer continuously, ivy leaves and the crane's hanging hook sway slightly; the observatory itself stays put.

1yvpis-light-dark-theme-comparison-slide.summary: A full-bleed painted sky (orange-pink nebula clouds upper left, dark teal starfield upper right, sunlit cloud sea at the bottom) sits inside a 23px black frame with ~24px rounded corners. Centred on it is one square rounded card (radius ~40px) split by a hard vertical seam into a light half (#e7e7e7) and a dark half (#1e1e1e): the same chat-app mock is drawn in both themes and the seam reveals one or the other. Card content, top to bottom: a white 'Light' pill top-left and a grey 'Dark' pill top-right; a browser-window card with three dots and a blue-to-orange gradient glow along its top-left rim, holding a message card ('C' avatar, grey skeleton lines, two small face photos) and a row of three round buttons (the middle one a blue sparkle button); to its right a list in monospace (B Business 24 chats, W Work 32 chats, C Clients 48 chats highlighted, D Design 64 chats, D Dev 80 chats); faint ghost panels clipped at both card edges; a pill toggle on thin connector lines; and a bottom card split into 'Create link / https://ui8.net' (smiley icon) and 'Meeting / 2 joined' (blue calendar icon). A white 56px circular handle with ‹ › chevrons, ringed by a faint concentric circle, rides the seam at the card's vertical centre. A screen-recording mouse cursor drives it. Motion: the card holds at 552px wide (0–1.6s), scales down about its centre to ~392px (1.6–1.95s), then scales up to 716px (2.3–2.65s). From ~3.4s the cursor drags the seam left and right many times (x≈548 → 451 → 237 → 471 → 823 → 548…). The half being newly revealed near the seam dissolves in: blurred, with tiny particles (blue + and × marks on the light side, white star specks on the dark side), then sharpens. Around 10.5–10.75s the card scales down again and grows back by ~11.55s. The background stays still throughout.

12484b-ai-tone-gradient-card-ui.summary: A light grey (#eeeeee) stage holds a horizontal 3D carousel of four portrait gradient cards, one rest card facing the viewer dead centre (about 470-478 x 598 px, top ~241, radius ~22 px) with two side cards flanking it at x 0-331 and 1014-1350. The side cards show mirrored text (seen from behind) and their outer halves smear: the pixels stretch horizontally toward the frame edge and the silhouette flares into a bell shape (≈400 px tall at the card, ≈630 px tall at the frame edge) with a cyan-to-violet chromatic rim; their inner edge stays a clean rounded corner. A soft banded elliptical glow is clipped at the top and bottom centre of the frame (cyan when the blue card faces front, faint pink/lavender when the orange card does). The four cards: orange/yellow/green "Access to advanced intelligence" with a tick-ring dial and "95 fh"; deep navy-to-electric-blue "Artificial intelligence vs Human Tone" with "25 %" and an AI-Human slider; magenta/black "Weekly Credit hours / Image generation" "720" with a plus button and a tick ruler; violet "Expand limits with Sora video creation" "v2.0" with a "Beta version" pill. Type is a light grotesk, white/near-white at reduced opacity for labels. Motion: four rests (0-0.95 orange, 2.9-4.6 blue, 6.5-8.3 orange, 10.25-11.95 blue) each with a gentle few-pixel sway, separated by ~1.8 s spins (1-2.85, 4.65-6.45, 8.35-10.2, 12-13.7) where the ring rotates right-to-left past two cards: orange slides off left, the red 720 card sweeps through the front (≈1.4 s), cards turn edge-on (≈1.9 s), and the blue card swings in from the right and settles; the next spin passes the purple v2.0 card (front ≈5.2 s) and lands on orange again. Cards tilt in perspective while moving and the side smears and glows re-colour with the card they belong to.

1u0ife-shader-blocks.summary: A 61.67 s showreel of seven full-bleed hero/footer sections, each shown inside one browser-like card: a rounded window (radius ~16 px) at [25,43,1875,993] floating on a flat light-grey backdrop (#b0b0b0–#bbbbbb) with a soft dark drop shadow. Each section has its own shader background, and sections change with a hard cut, no transition: 0–11.35 s "Parallax" (black page, blue/cyan point-cloud ribbons, a white dot-matrix word "inference" whose dots get pulled into a sweeping arc stream and reform, plus thin corner-bracket detection boxes with tiny % tags that jump around); 11.35–22.55 s "Moonpool Games / UNDERTOW" (black page, a heavily blurred violet/indigo/orange ink-fluid ribbon that keeps curling, with a fine halftone dot screen inside its warm parts, a huge extended-heavy white wordmark, and an email field plus orange pill); 22.55–28.3 s "Stratus" (aqua/mint drifting cloud field seen through reeded glass: about 10 fixed vertical flutes ~200 px wide with straight seams, a light-weight dark-teal headline with "sky" in bold); 28.3–33.95 s "Facet." (near-black indigo page, a large faceted crystal with a violet rim glow and a milky white inner light that turns slowly, a white bold two-line headline whose last word "brilliance." is outline type); 33.95–45.3 s "Graphite" (white page with black particle dust streaming along a large arc, a footer with hairlines, and a giant condensed black "GO WITH THE FLOW" clipped by the card's bottom edge); 45.3–53.75 s "Averill" (warm off-white paper with wavy horizontal grain, a light serif headline, a three-column footer, and graphite pencil arcs on the right that draw themselves and fade); 53.75–61.67 s a therapy page (soft blurred magenta-to-peach gradient that keeps flowing, a big white serif headline, a white pill, and three numbered steps over hairlines). All type sits on a 76 px left margin; nav rows sit at y≈90 with a pill CTA right-aligned to x=1847.

Later section changes land at about 22.55s (Stratus), 28.3s (Facet), 33.95s (Graphite), 45.3s (Averill) and 53.75s (Feeling better), each a hard cut.

The dot ribbons show visible rows of dots that follow the surface like contour lines, with brighter cyan dots on ridges, and no solid stroke outline around any ribbon.

19aisf-swiftui-magnetic-metal-effect.summary: A filmed, slightly handheld top-down shot: the bottom half of a black iPhone (titanium-grey rim, rounded bottom corners) lies on a cream travertine table, a blurred green plant leaf fills the left edge and bottom-left foreground, and the curved table edge drops to a dark floor at the bottom. On the near-black screen sit two controls on one row ~y 378: a long pill text field (≈283×62, full radius) reading "Your email" in small light-grey type, made of smoky translucent grey with a thin bright 1px metal rim and a soft specular sheen pooled inside its right cap; and to its right a 56px circular button that is only a thin bright white metal ring around a white right arrow, carrying a brighter glint and a faint violet-white glow on the side nearest the magnet. A hand brings a black magnet puck (~165px) in from the right; as it nears (0.5–1.75s, again 4.0–5.05s and later), the ring stretches like soft metal into an egg/teardrop pointing at the puck, bulging ~8–12px toward it with the glint brightening on that side, and wobbles as the puck slides past (2.22s); when the puck leaves (2.5–3.8s) the ring springs back to a true circle. The pill itself barely changes; the phone and table stay put apart from a few px of camera drift.

1pfmjh-camellia-bloom-timeline.summary: A centred, single-column editorial page on a flat light surface (#ebedec in Winter; it turns to a pale blush #f3e8e7 when Spring is chosen). Header: at top left a condensed serif wordmark "Camellia" (~40px, near black), then "INNER STRENGTH" in tracked uppercase grey sans and a small pink outlined five-petal flower icon. At top right is a segmented season control: a rounded capsule (1023,29,394x50) with a light fill and a hairline border, holding Winter / Spring / Summer / Autumn, with the active season in a solid near-black pill with white text. Centre stage: a cut-out botanical photograph of a camellia stem (x≈540–900, y≈85–595), floated on the background with no frame or shadow. Under it are an italic grey serif stage name ("Dormant bud", "Swelling bud", "Half open", "Spent"…) and a black capsule badge "Day N" (≈82x37, fully rounded, white text). Below that sits a ruler-style scrub timeline from x=320 to x=1121 (baseline y≈853): thin light-grey ticks with a taller tick every 7 days (43 ticks over 42 days in Winter, 22 over 21 days in Spring). The ticks near the playhead grow taller and darker, like a magnifying dock. The playhead is a black vertical line with a round knob on top, about 60px tall. Labels BUD / "42 DAYS" / WILTED sit beneath it in small tracked caps. Below the timeline are a light pill button "▶ Play the whole life" with a grey border, a "Winter · 42 days" caption, and a two-line centred grey paragraph. Motion: from about 0.6s to 7.0s the user drags the playhead from Day 1 to Day 42. The day badge counts up, the stage name changes, and the plant photo cross-fades through growth stages (bud → bloom → wilt → spent, with fallen petals). At about 8.1s a click on Spring moves the black pill 90px right in one step. In the same moment the page tint changes to blush, the ruler rebuilds to 21 days, the badge goes Day 42 → Day 21 and the caption and paragraph swap. From about 10.3s to 18.2s the user scrubs Spring from Day 1 to Day 21, with the same photo cross-fades. A ring-shaped ◀▶ drag cursor (≈70px circle) follows the pointer over the scrubber.

7x7iai-resizable-sidebar.summary: A single macOS-style app window sits on a saturated magenta backdrop of extruded isometric pixel blocks (diagonal stripes of raised squares, darker toward the lower left, with a few loose squares in the top band). The window's left edge is at x=138 and its top at y=104, with a ~22 px rounded top-left corner and a soft dark-purple drop shadow on the backdrop. It runs off the right and bottom of the frame. Inside, a pale lilac sidebar (#f6eef7, a very soft lighter wash near its top) holds three traffic-light dots (red, yellow, green, 21 px, centred on y=138) and a grey outlined sidebar-toggle icon. A 1 px lilac-grey divider (#e5e0e6) separates the sidebar from a near-white content pane (#fdfdfd). The pane is empty: there is no text anywhere. The only things that move are the divider, which carries the sidebar width, and the system cursor. The cursor becomes a col-resize ◂|▸ cursor over the divider. At rest the divider sits at x≈499. Dragging right stretches it past its 617 px maximum to about 650–653, with heavy rubber-band resistance: the cursor goes about 170 px further, the divider only about 36 px. On release it springs back to 617 in about 0.15 s with a 2 px wobble. Dragging left stretches it below its 377 minimum to about 343, and on release it springs back to 377. Dragging further left snaps the sidebar fully closed in about 0.15 s (7.4–7.55 s, 12.1–12.2 s, 13.15–13.2 s). When it is closed the content pane fills the window, and the toggle icon shows a › chevron. Clicking the toggle (cursor on it, grey rounded hover square behind it) reopens the sidebar in about 0.2 s, at minimum width the first time (8.55–8.75 s). Later, closing it by the toggle at 15.05 s and reopening it at 15.75 s restores the previous width of about 486. The sequence of drags repeats until 20.6 s; the backdrop never moves.
