10b532-gooey-morphing-select.summary: A single dark select sits centred on a flat light-grey (#e9e9e9) canvas: a near-black (#0d0d0d) full-pill trigger, 149 x 27 px at (213,167), with a light-grey label left at x 224 ("All disciplines", later "Track", then "Tennis") and a small chevron at x 347. When it opens, a gooey liquid shape grows down out of the trigger. For the first ~0.15 s the trigger and the new panel are one continuous black blob, with concave fillet necks pinching in on both sides at y≈195–205. The blob stretches down, overshoots to y≈345 and settles back to y≈333. It then splits into the pill and a separate rounded panel (213,201,149,133, ~10 px radius) with a ~7 px light gap between them. The chevron flips to point up. Six list rows (All disciplines, Track, Alpine, Velodrome, Tennis, Trail) fade in at a 21 px pitch, and the hovered row gets a #262626 rounded highlight. Picking a row collapses the panel up into the pill in ~0.3 s. The labels briefly ghost out below the shrinking shape, and the trigger label swaps to the chosen item. Sequence: open at 0.40–0.70 s, hover Track, close at 1.60–1.93 s → "Track". Open at 2.45–2.7 s, close at 3.40–3.6 s → "Tennis". A blank open-and-close at 4.08–4.87 s, where the panel reaches 345 and retracts at once with no list. A partial open to y≈271 at 5.28–5.38 s retracts by 5.85 s. The left, right and top edges never move; only the bottom edge travels.

1ohpgw-open-sourced-carousel.summary: A light #f6f6f6 page, no chrome. 0–1.5 s, loading: one small rounded photo thumb (Matchday, soccer) sits at centre [799,504,103,69] and a three-digit counter at the bottom centre counts up ("065" at 0.5 s, "097" at 1 s). Between 1.9 s and about 2.5 s the thumb slides right to the 3 o'clock point of a ring. Around 3–4 s the other 17 cards pour out of it as one gooey chain. The chain wraps around a circle of radius about 390 px centred near (850,540), with cards fused by liquid necks, then pinches apart into 18 separate rounded cards tilted along the ring. "Works '26" sits at the centre, and an 18-row project list appears top right. The active row is black; the other rows are pale grey. At 5–5.5 s the last gooey strands on the left of the ring snap. From 5.95 to 7.95 s the ring unwinds into a vertical column that whips past, on top of the title, and settles at 8 s. The focused card [585,363,496,332] sits at the centre, and the top and bottom neighbours are cut off by the frame edges. They are joined to it by liquid necks filled with the stretched image colours. The side labels read "01 Matchday" on the left and "Motion 2025" on the right. While held, the card outlines wobble softly. At 14.75 s the card tilts and rises, the necks thin to threads, and the column flings down the list (passing Prestige Equine and Blue Room) to Iris by 17.3 s. The list highlight tracks this live, but the side labels change only after the move ends ("11 Iris … Photography 2023"). On the card, a frosted "↗ View" pill follows the cursor. From 26.4 to 27.55 s the column moves again, to Favor. The labels still read Iris at 28.5 s and switch to "15 Favor … E-commerce 2025" at about 29.5 s.

104rht-menubar-ac-control.summary: A portrait 824x1080 crop of a macOS desktop. A mountain-slope photo wallpaper fills the frame under a pale sky, and a translucent light menu bar runs along the top. From left to right the menu bar holds a purple rounded pill with a screen-and-person icon, a small dot, an AC-unit glyph reading "16°", volume, battery, control centre with a purple dot, and "Mon 12". At 0.15s the AC item is highlighted with a grey pill and the cursor clicks it. Between 0.35s and 0.5s a dark navy popover (about [82,77,679,948], radius about 40, with a small caret notch under the AC item) fades in and grows slightly from about 97% scale. The popover has a vertical gradient from deep blue at the top to near-black at the bottom. Its contents, top to bottom: a row reading "Room 25°C" with a thermometer icon and a green status dot; a round blue glowing power button at the top right; a glossy white wall-AC unit showing "16 •" in blue; a fan of thin blue curved airflow lines with drifting white dashes and a row of 10 slanted ticks; a large light-grey "16" with a blue "°C"; an "Eco Mode" pill with a leaf icon and a toggle; a black inset slider track flanked by round − and + buttons, labelled "16°" and "30°"; and four rounded tile cards: Mode/Cool, Fan speed/Low, Sleep/Off, Airflow/L1. Type is SF-like sans, light on dark. Motion sequence: the slider is dragged from 16 to 30 (about 1.4–2.5s). The track fills with a blue-to-orange gradient, the big number rolls with a vertical blur, and the AC readout turns orange "30". The panel then washes to a warm brown-red (about 2.6–4.4s) while the airflow lines turn orange and the menu bar reads "30°". Next the thumb is dragged back to 16 (about 3.9–4.7s) and the panel returns to blue. Eco Mode is switched on (green leaf, blue toggle, about 6.3–8.3s) and then off. The Airflow tile is clicked (about 9.3s): it gets a blue outline and opens a dark rounded list (Swing, L1 ✓ highlighted, L2–L5, Off). Swing is chosen and the list fades out (about 10.9–11.3s); the tile then reads "Swing" and the room reading changes to "24°C". Throughout, the airflow dashes stream continuously, the fan icon spins and the status dot pulses between green and blue.

1wgoe2-ui-skeleton-loading-effect.summary: A near-white (#fcfcfc) canvas runs four short acts, each one a 'skeleton build' that resolves into a finished mobile UI card. In Act 1 (0–2.2s), three cards sit side by side on one 176px top line: Heart rate [80,176,436,453], Token spend [572,176,420,728] and the Deep Current music player [1048,176,472,553]. Each starts as a grey dotted wireframe on a dot grid. The wireframe has dotted rounded outlines, small square corner handles, monospace dimension labels ('332 × 345 t+2.45s') and dotted placeholder lines with dark dot end-caps. Each card fills in with a soft blur-to-sharp wipe that moves downward, left card first. The bpm number changes 72 → 77. From 2.2 to 2.45s everything blurs out and the canvas goes blank. Act 2 (2.6–5.5s) is one large centred Heart rate card [421,147,758,787]. Its skeleton is flanked by two monospace code panels: 'AGENT.LOG // PARTS 00/18' on the left, whose rows tick from [#####.] to [ ok ], and 'MOTION.CSS // 03 RECIPES' on the right, which types more CSS recipes. The card resolves top-down (72 bpm, red ECG trace, grid chart), and its digits roll before the card blurs away. Act 3 (5.95–9.6s) is a tall centred Token spend card [545,98,510,883] with the same log and CSS panels (PARTS 00/61 → 61/61). It resolves to a chart with 7 stacked bars in blue/purple/orange/green. A hand cursor then clicks 'Month' at ~8.7s: the pill slides, the totals change 1.7M → 6.9M, the x-axis changes to 1–30 and the legend values change. The cursor then hovers 'Year', and the card blurs out. Act 4 (9.9–15.33s) is a centred music player [460,144,672,790]. It builds from a skeleton (PARTS 00/28 → 28/28), resolves to 'Deep Current / Arlo Finch' with a pastel sneaker cover, and the play button is pressed and turns to pause. At ~14.2s the next button is clicked, the track crossfades to 'Slow Tides / Juno Vale' (purple–blue gradient cover, 3:24, 24 likes) and the card background tints lilac/blue. The type is a neutral grotesk (Inter-like) in near-black #161719. The annotation type is grey monospace. Cards are white with about 28px radius and a very soft, wide drop shadow.

j2t2cc-jelly-segmented-control.summary: A screen recording of the ElevenLabs v4 launch page on an off-white (#fbfbfb) canvas. At rest (0–0.2s and again from about 5.5s) the page shows a grey announcement bar at the top. Below it is a white nav card with the "IIElevenLabs" wordmark, a "Contact sales" outline pill and a black "Log in" pill. On the left is a hero: an eyebrow line, a two-line headline "Meet Eleven v4 / and v4 Turbo" and a black "Try Eleven v4 for free" pill. On the right is a huge "V4" set in heavy letterforms filled with a grainy, blurred red, green and black streaked texture. A white "Play Eleven v4 samples" pill with a black play disc sits over the V4, and a "Voice chat" pill with a blue-green orb sits bottom right. From 0.25s to 0.8s the camera zooms about 2x into the V4 with motion blur and holds there (0.85–1.7s). The cursor clicks the play pill at about 1.7s. The pill squishes like jelly: it shrinks, its label greys, and a grey second layer peeks from its right end. Between 1.75s and 2.45s the scene blurs into a sample player. r3hi1h-kinetic-typography-study.summary: Despite the title, there is no type anywhere in the clip. It is a looping sequence of eight soft 3D "creature-flower" sculptures, each shown alone and roughly centred (x≈450) on a pure black #000000 904x1080 canvas with no floor, shadow, frame or UI. Each form has a matte, clay-like body with smooth gradient shading: colour shifts across the volume (pink to red at the hubs, violet to deep indigo in the crevices, pink to yellow down the stems). There are no outlines and almost no specular highlights. The forms in order: (1) a pink scalloped cushion with a red centre on five indigo-violet lobes, 0–0.8s; (2) a six-lobed pink star on a pink-to-yellow teardrop stem, 1.6–2.7s; (3) a blue-violet six-lobed star with six yellow ball-tipped red stalks on a wide blue dome, 3.7–4.7s; (4) a stack of lime-green nested bowls on a lilac four-lobed base, 5.35–6.6s; (5) a flat salmon-orange ellipsoid on a crimson six-armed splat, 7.2–8.5s; (6) a violet petal bloom crowned by nine pink spheres on pink stalks, 9.3–10.3s; (7) a royal-blue petal flower over peach curling tentacles, 11–12.2s; (8) a red-orange spiky anemone on a pale-blue teardrop stem, 13.2–14.0s. During each hold nothing moves at all. Each change takes about 0.5–1s and is a crossfade plus morph with motion blur: the old form fades and blurs out while the new one fades in semi-transparent, overlapping it, and settles with a slight scale overshoot (the blue dome shrinks from about 400 to 304 px wide). The last transition, about 14.5–15.15s, morphs the anemone (whose stem first swells into a blue dome) back into form 1, so the clip loops.

1skvap-thinking-orbs-library.summary: A filmed hand holds a phone in front of a blurred warm room (olive-brown wall, green plant at lower left). The phone screen fills roughly x 430–1170, y 0–830. Its wallpaper is a pale pinkish-grey abstract of large soft curved planes with fine grain. The page contains one control: a black capsule "thinking" pill centred low on the screen at about 624,600 383×130. A second, lighter grey capsule sits about 25–30 px higher, peeking out behind it like a stacked toast. Inside the pill, on the left, a small round orb about 65 px wide is drawn from white dots. To its right, in white SF-style text, is a status word ending in four dots: "Working....", "Searching....", "Solving....", "Listening....", "Connecting....", "Weaving....", "Composing....", "Shaping....", "Thinking....". The word and the orb style change together every ~0.8 s. Each orb is its own dot drawing: a scattered dot cloud, a dotted sphere, dotted latitude rings, a sparse constellation, dotted vertical meridians, a dotted ring/torus, a dotted soft blob outline, or a thin dotted circle. On a change the old and new words roll past each other vertically with motion blur. Three times (about 2.6 s, 6.2 s and 10.1 s, and again at ~16.6 s and ~24.7 s) the thumb taps the pill and it morphs into a large black rounded card, about 650×680 with ~45 px corners and a short grey grabber bar at the top centre. The card shows the orb enlarged to ~200 px as a 3D sphere of dots: the near dots are larger and brighter, the far ones smaller and dim. Under it sit the status word and a two-line grey caption, "Agent is processing your request. Please wait, it might take a few seconds." After about 0.7–1 s the card shrinks back into the pill. The orb dots keep rotating and drifting the whole time. The hand and phone sway a few px throughout because the clip is handheld.

1nkoz6-gooey-ui-effect.summary: A light-grey (#f4f4f4) showcase page for a React "Liquid gooey" effect. A fixed header sits top-centre: a 102px white rounded-square app tile (radius ~28, soft drop shadow) with a debossed grey two-blob "metaball" mark, then "Liquid gooey" in near-black ~32px Inter-like type centred at x≈693, y≈200, and the grey subtitle "Liquid effects for React UI" below it at y≈246. The header never moves. Below it, two demo scenes play in turn, each built from white pill/circle surfaces with soft wide shadows that merge like liquid (metaballs: where two shapes come close a smooth concave neck grows between them; no hard seam). Scene 1 (0–3.95s and again from ~9.1s): on the left a 131px white "+" circle button; clicking it (≈0.5–0.85s, again ≈2.05–2.6s) turns the + into an × and three icon circles (image above, document left, folder right) squeeze out of it as one goo blob that splits into separate bubbles, springing slightly; clicking × (≈1.3–1.6s, ≈2.9–3.2s) melts them back into one blob that shrinks into the button. On the right a white "Share" pill (x 767–1245, y 588–766) holds three overlapping round portrait avatars; a fourth avatar (a man in glasses) is dragged by a grab cursor around the pill's rim (left end ≈1.0s, top ≈1.45–1.9s, top-right ≈2.4s, right end ≈3.45s, bottom-right ≈3.8s); its white halo stays joined to the pill by a stretching goo neck, the pill bulges toward it, and the photo itself smears/melts with a directional motion streak trailing behind it. At ≈3.95–4.4s the whole scene slides left with heavy horizontal motion blur and scene 2 slides in from the right: an "Enter your email" pill input (198–757 × 488–631) with a separate 124px arrow circle to its right, which buds out of the input's right end as a goo blob and detaches; below, a thin grey slider track (663–1268, y≈882–904) with a white circular thumb that stretches into a teardrop toward its direction of travel while dragged. At ≈9.1–9.75s scene 2 slides out left with motion blur and scene 1 returns with the menu open. A system cursor (hand, grab-hand, I-beam, arrow) is visible throughout.

1pa0up-aquarium-404-error-page.summary: A full-bleed dark 404 page (#151413 near-black with a faint dot grid and a soft diagonal light shaft from top-right) for "Living UI": logo + wordmark top-left, "Catalog" / "Pricing" grey links and a cream pill "Sign in" top-right, a centred large white headline "This page sank" (~y 200–280) over a two-line grey subline. The bottom third is an aquarium: a teal water body whose surface is a thin bright crest line spanning full width, with flat-illustrated seaweed fronds, red cartoon crabs, small fish (blue tang, clownfish, grey-green fish) and a sandy mound at the bottom; a dark pill "Hear the water" (muted speaker icon) sits bottom-right. Motion: at ~0.8s the water level rises ~76 px (crest y≈748 → ≈672) and fish appear while the pill flips to "Mute the water"; between 0.85–1.35s three big extruded cream 3D digits "4 0 4" drop in from above the frame, splash into the water at ~1.4–1.6s (droplets fly, surface bulges) and float half-submerged, the underwater parts tinted teal by the water. From ~1.8s the camera zooms out (with motion blur) to reveal the page in a Chrome window over a night-city desktop; 3–7s the window is shaken and the water sloshes in large refractive waves across the whole page, flinging droplets and tumbling the digits. ~7.5s it zooms back in to full page and through 19s the cursor (grab hand) fishes digits out and tosses them, so they bob and drift (reading "0 4 4" for a while) on a wavy surface, and the clip ends with the digits back near "4 0 4" floating at the waterline.

1629oc-open-source-floating-nav-dock.summary: On a near-white page (#fcfcfc), one near-black (#0b0b0b) element sits centred at x≈524 with its bottom edge fixed at y≈899 for the whole clip. At rest it is a pill-shaped dock, 480×109 px ([284,791]), with fully rounded ends, a soft light shadow and five light-grey (#e9e9e9) icons spaced 93 px apart at y≈846: a filled house, a search lens, an outline heart, a stacked notebook, and a vertical up/down chevron for More. Hovering an icon puts a slightly lighter (#1c1c1c) circle about 92 px wide behind it, and that circle slides from icon to icon. Above the hovered icon, about 16 px over the dock, a white rounded tooltip with a hairline grey border and dark ~26 px text appears: "Home", "Discover", "Favorites", "Notebooks", "More". The cursor moves left to right between 0.4 and 2.0 s. Clicking More at about 2.3 s squashes the pill into a blurred bar about 425×60 px. The bar then springs up into a 566 px wide panel with a radius of about 60 px. Its top rises from 841 to 434 between 2.40 and 2.58 s, overshoots, and settles at 444 by 2.73 s. The rows fade in from blur: Home, Discover, Favorites, Notebooks ›, Settings ›, each 84.5 px tall, with ~30 px light type at x=343 and icons at x≈304. The hovered row gets a full-rounded #1b1b1b highlight inset 17 px. Clicking Notebooks (3.60–3.73 s) blurs and slides the old rows down while the panel top springs from 444 to 528 and a four-row submenu fades in: Back, Personal, Work, Ideas. The row highlight follows the cursor from Work to Back (4.25–4.75 s). Back (4.82–4.98 s) grows the panel to 444 and brings back the main list. Settings (5.82–5.97 s) grows it to 360 for six rows: Back, Profile, Appearance, Upgrade, Invite a friend, Sign out. These rows fade in top to bottom from blur. At 7.18 s the panel collapses in about 70 ms to a ~60 px blurred bar, and the dock springs back to 790–899 by 7.48 s.

1r2vit-generative-ui-map-card.summary: A light chat transcript on a near-white page (#fafaf9/#fcfcfc), with a 1 px grey window edge on the top and left. It holds one centred column about 896 px wide (x 286 to 1182). The user's grey message bubble sits top right at [501,92,682,92], radius about 24, with a soft shadow and 20 px dark Inter-style text. Below it is the assistant reply, left-aligned at x 286, with 'Linden Park.' and 'The Boathouse' in bold. Under the reply is a generated map card at [286,311,896,538], radius about 22. It is a flat vector city map: a light-grey block grid with white streets on a slight rotation, and a green park rectangle holding a blue oval 'Linden Lake', a small pond, blob-shaped tree clusters and white paths. Pill labels sit on the map ('Fern & Fig 4 min', 'Lumen Coffee 9 min', 'The Boathouse 5 min'). The selected label is a dark pill; the others are white. A blue walking route with a haloed blue start dot runs to the selected pin. A white place card at the bottom of the map shows a photo thumbnail, name, star rating, subtitle, three icon features, a '‹ n / 3 ›' pager and a pale-blue 'Send to iPhone' pill. A second paragraph sits below the card. Motion: from 0.8 to 2.4 s the reply text streams in word by word as a blur fade. At about 1.8 to 2.5 s the map fades in, then at 2.5 to 3 s the labels, the route and the place card fade in. At 5.0 to 5.15 s the camera zooms in by about 1.15x, with motion blur. The cursor pages the place card from The Boathouse (1/3) to Fern & Fig (2/3) to Lumen Coffee (3/3), then taps the Fern & Fig pin. Each change swaps the dark selected pill and redraws the route. At 9.45 to 9.55 s the camera zooms back out. A round theme button at the map's top right opens a 5-swatch picker pill (Vivid, Earth, Autumn, Paper, Night). Each choice recolours the whole map, the route and the send pill. Night turns the ground near-black. Returning to Vivid at about 16.5 s spreads back as a soft-edged circular reveal. The picker closes. The camera zooms in again at 18.3 to 18.5 s. 'Send to iPhone' is clicked and goes to 'Sending...' with a spinner, then to '✓ Sent to iPhone'. The camera zooms out at 20.4 to 20.6 s.

1ip5at-ai-model-router-dashboard.summary: A single light dashboard card, "Model router", sits centred on a pale lavender-grey (#f0f0f5) canvas. The canvas has faint diagonal hairline stripes, two dashed vertical guides at x≈538 and x≈1183 that frame the card, and two solid hairlines at x≈169 and x≈1553. The card (≈543,163 → 1180,916, ~20px radius, soft drop shadow) has four parts. The header row holds the 18px title with an info icon, then a "chat-prod" select pill, a sliders icon and a close X. Below it is a white inset panel with the mono caption "BLENDED COST · LIVE POLICY", a big ~40px price "$0.0046" with "/ 1K tokens", a mono stats line, and a three-way COST / BALANCED / QUALITY segmented control. Under those, a flow graph: from a hollow GATEWAY node at the left, four soft-glow lines fan out on S-curves to Opus 5.5 (blue), GPT-6.1 Sol (green), Haiku 4.5 (violet) and Qwen3.5 9B (magenta), each ending in a dot, a label and a mono req/s rate. The second inset panel is a "Routes" table: four rows, each with a coloured dot, the model name, a mono provider tag, a mini share bar, then share, P50/P95, $/1K and errors. Under the table, a Fallback row has an orange toggle and two model selects. The footer has a kebab menu, a mono "POLICY V14 · LIVE ON CHAT-PROD" and a pale salmon "Deploy policy" pill. The layout never moves. Throughout the clip, small coloured dots stream left to right along every route line. A cursor drives the states. At ~2s it clicks COST: the white pill slides to COST, the price counts down to $0.0026, the caption turns green "▼ 44% VS LIVE", rates and shares change, the footer reads "UNSAVED CHANGES" and Deploy turns saturated orange. At ~4.5s it clicks QUALITY: the price climbs to $0.0089, a red "▲ 92% VS LIVE" appears, and the Opus line swells into a thick glow band. At ~6s BALANCED restores $0.0046 and the pale Deploy. From ~7 to 11s it hovers each graph label in turn; the hovered route stays vivid while the other lines and table rows fade to ~35%. At ~12s the Fallback toggle switches off (grey knob, faded selects). At ~14–15s and ~16–17s the fallback selects open a dropdown, "IF THIS MODEL FAILS", that lists four models with prices and a check mark.

89kmeb-perfolios-curated-directory.summary: A quiet, light editorial hero on a flat #f9f9f9 page. At top centre a pill toggle (#eeeeee, 134x72, fully rounded) holds a white raised knob with a black sun on the left and a grey outline moon on the right; it never changes in the clip. Below it, centred around x≈693, a fanned stack of five rounded, white-framed website screenshots (left to right: Christie Chang cream serif "Hi, I'm Christie." page, Xchyler Drenth dark-grey PSP line drawing, Royden So white page with a red/yellow/pink colour grid in the centre and frontmost, Sasidharan black chat page, Tolis C black "STALA" waveform page), each tilted a few degrees outward like a hand of cards, sitting on a soft wide grey drop shadow. When the cursor hovers a card it straightens to 0°, lifts ~30 px and slides clear of the stack while the other cards squeeze together to one side, and the person's name fades in centred under the fan at y≈553 (dark sans, ~22 px); switching cards crossfades the label with a short blur. The hover passes Royden So (≈1.1s), Christie Chang (≈2.3s), Xchyler Drenth (≈4.3s), Royden So / Sasidharan (≈5.0–5.7s), Tolis C (≈6.2s), returns to the resting fan at ≈7.1s and repeats similar hovers until 17s; each swap takes ≈0.2–0.3 s with an ease-out. Below the fan, left-aligned at x=233, grey sans body copy: "Hey,", then "This is [sprouting paper-clip p logo]erfolios, a hand-picked directory of the most beautiful / personal sites on the internet." with "erfolios" in black, and at y≈1000 "155 portfolios and counting. Know one that belongs here?" with "155" in black and a light grey rounded "submit it" chip. Nothing in the text block moves.

lazv1l-accessgrid-reliability-stats-sect.summary: A light, static landing-page stats section framed by thin grey vertical guide lines at x≈78 and x≈1840. A pale grey band (#f4f4f6) fills the top 157 px, with a row of tiny light-grey dots at y≈21. Below it, on near-white (#fdfdfd), sits a three-part hero row. On the left is a two-line headline, right-aligned to x≈602: "Built for reliability" in near-black and "at any scale" in mid-grey, same size and weight. In the centre is a large dotted globe about 700 px wide, made of hundreds of small grey dots laid along latitude/longitude. Land dots are darker, and the sphere fades to almost nothing toward its lower half and back side. Its bottom is cut off by a faint dashed divider at y≈717. On the right is a three-line grey paragraph about AccessGrid. Under the divider, four centred stats in light-weight large numerals ("1,000,000", "100%", "4", "11+") each sit over a small grey caption. A solid hairline at y≈907 closes the section, and the top of a footer peeks in below with three column heads (Developers, Pricing, Company) and their first links. The only motion is the globe: it turns slowly and continuously for the whole 25 s, so its continent patterns of darker dots slide across the sphere. Now and then a thin grey arc line with a node dot is briefly drawn just above its surface (seen at 0.5s). The text, lines, dot row and stats never move.

1kuu9x-animated-sign-in-button.summary: A close-up of the lower half of an iPhone (black glossy frame, rounded bottom corners, side buttons at top left/right) centred on a flat #f2f2f2 backdrop with a soft grey drop shadow beneath the phone. The screen is a pale grey (#ececec–#f4f4f4) onboarding page with all type centred on x≈738: a two-line headline 'Your recent ___ deserves / to be remembered.' (~38px regular SF-style, near-black), a single line 'Let’s get you started.' at y≈390, a wide white 'Continue with Apple' pill-rectangle button (~572×94, radius ~14, soft grey shadow) with a black Apple logo, then 'This is a beta version of Someday.' in dark grey and a two-line light-grey legal footer with underlined 'Terms of Service' and 'Privacy Policy'. Behind the button a soft, heavily blurred warm glow (orange core, peach/pink fringes, pale cream halo) breathes and drifts, its intensity rising and falling. Two motions run the whole 16.6s: (1) the headline's third word cycles roughly every 2s – walk → trip → call → run → talk → kiss → climb → hike → lunch – each swap done letter by letter with the outgoing letters blurring/smearing into the new ones over ~0.3s while the rest of the line stays sharp; (2) a slow continuous camera push-in scales the whole phone up about 6% (phone bottom edge in column 380 goes from ~1003 at 0.5s to ~1026 at 16.5s, phone left edge from ~360 to ~330), linear with no easing steps.

uswizi-dither-ascii-stock-cards.summary: Two equal portrait cards sit side by side on a flat charcoal (#404040) ground: the left at x 90–690, the right at x 750–1350, both running y 78–1001 with square corners and a 60 px gutter. Each card has a white artwork panel on top (y 78–669, 600×591) and a solid footer below (y 669–1001). Left card: the footer is forest green #355f3a and holds the white sans label "Stock Card", the white serif title "NYC Exchange", a muted three-line description, a pin icon with "NYC, United States", three overlapping avatars with a dim "+30 more are watching", a white "Add Card" pill at the top right and a lighter green "Expand" button with a soft drop shadow at the bottom right. Right card: the footer is lavender #cecfe6 with indigo type: uppercase "MY CARD", the serif "Shanghai Stock Exchange", a grey description, an indigo "Shanghai, China", avatars with grey "+35 more are participating", the same white "Add Card" pill and a solid indigo #4e50cf "Expand" button. The left artwork is an ordered-dither field of green square dots on roughly a 6 px grid that forms a right-pointing chevron or arrow. The right artwork is a column-aligned ASCII rendering in blue-violet 0/1 glyphs of a person's silhouette in profile, laid over a faint blurred lavender haze. Both footers stay perfectly still for the whole 17.67 s. Only the two artworks move, and they move constantly. The green dither chevron breathes in a loop of about 2 s: it is a narrow arrow at 0 s and 2.05 s, swells to fill the panel with a white V-shaped crease at about 0.55 s and 2.5 s, then splits into a small left arrowhead and a large right crescent at about 1.5 s and 3.75 s. The ASCII figure shifts and re-renders as live video, and its glyphs flicker frame to frame. Nothing translates, scales or fades in the UI chrome.

1bjvs6-linkstore-404-page.summary: A white, centred 404 page for "Linkstore" on a 1024x720 frame with a 1px light-grey frame edge. Top: a 38px rounded-square blue gradient app tile (four soft white squares, the top-right one replaced by a north-east arrow) beside the bold dark wordmark "Linkstore" (centre x≈492, y≈105). Middle: a search pill that animates on a loop. Lower block, all centred on x≈492: a bold near-black headline "We couldn't find that page" (~30px, y≈422), two lines of mid-grey body copy (~18px, y≈471 and 504), and a pair of actions at y≈590: a solid royal-blue (#1937da) fully rounded "Search the store" button with white text and a borderless black text link "Go to the homepage". The headline, body and buttons never move. The motion is all in the search pill. At 0s it is absent. By about 0.35s a small empty pill (≈292x45 at y≈207) has faded in: white, a thin light-grey rim, a soft drop shadow and a small grey magnifier. Typing starts about 0.5s. From about 0.8s to 1.2s the pill zooms toward the viewer to about 1.6x height (≈78px tall, top ≈228, left edge ≈338) while "nothing here" types out. Its right end dissolves into white under a horizontal fade mask, so the right cap is never seen. A faint dashed light-grey ghost outline of a second pill sits beneath it (y≈322–350), also fading out to the right and at the bottom. That pose holds from about 1.2s to 4.05s. At about 4.1s the big pill vanishes and the small empty pill reappears. The cycle repeats: the zoom lands about 4.9–5.25s, and the pose then holds until the recording ends at about 8.85s. A static system arrow cursor sits at (822,437) throughout.

jlxjg2-dialkit-update.summary: A single onboarding screen with a tweak panel docked over it. The page background starts warm beige (#E6DFD7, set as #EDE6DC). A huge black-weight geometric sans headline, "Your" and "Feed", sits across the middle (y≈465–590, colour #170B41) with a 300 px word gap. In that gap stands a periwinkle (#92A8FA) clover/figure-8 mask (x 525–1042, y 230–802) made of four overlapping circles, with V-notches top and bottom at x≈783. The mask covers the inner letters ("r", "F"). A centred column of 345×345 rounded cards (x 611–956, radius ≈40, gap ≈74) scrolls downward through the mask at a constant ≈68 px/s. The cards are a white poster card ".ORGNC.MOD**.", black cards with blue light streaks, and a "Flame in a glass" capsule card. Cards pass freely over the top of the mask and are cut off by its lower scalloped edge. A white pill "Continue" button with a soft warm shadow sits at x 551–1015, y 935–1029. At top right a 47 px dark circle with a sliders icon opens the "DialKit" panel at ≈1.95 s. The panel is dark charcoal, x 1202–1552, y 16–677, radius ≈20, and holds an Onboarding group (Version 1 select, Page Background hex + swatch, Headline Size 150 slider, Foreground #170B41) and a Step One group (Card Width 300, Feed Speed 36, Word Gap 300, Mask Scale 1.20, Mask Color). Slider rows show a lighter fill up to their value. The panel covers the right end of "Feed". Edits apply instantly. At ≈4.0 s the page background snaps to pink #F586C1 (#E968B9 on screen). At ≈8.15 s the mask snaps to yellow #EEFF72. At ≈10.6–10.85 s Continue is clicked and the page becomes step two: a huge faint "Name?" placeholder (Foreground at opacity 0.33, reads #A04A8E) with a text caret through it, plus a white circular back-arrow button left of a shifted Continue pill. The panel's second group becomes "Step Two" (Placeholder "Name?", Opacity). Opacity is dragged 0.33→0.44, so the placeholder darkens. At ≈15.95–16.3 s a native white colour picker opens beside the panel and the background changes to hot pink #FB46A7. At ≈18.85 s the back button returns to the feed, which keeps the hot pink background and yellow mask while the cards keep scrolling.

1066bx-empty-state-exploration.summary: A single white rounded card (radius ~48 px, no stroke) sits centred on a flat #eeeeee page and cycles through three empty states: "Create your first Workspace" (browser-window illustration with a mint-circled black C logo), "Create your first folder" (a pale grey outlined folder with a small +), and "Create your first Artifact" (three stacked skeleton rows). Rest states: Workspace card [360,228,720,623] around 1.25 s, Folder card the same box around 3.25 s, Artifact card [322,331,796,418] from ~5.0 s to the end; the clip opens on the Workspace card already fading out, so it loops.

1cu5w2-carousel-hover-effect.summary: A full-bleed warm linen page (#e0d3ba with visible woven canvas grain) carries a one-slide-at-a-time destination carousel. Top bar: wordmark "Budarina" at x118, mono nav "Home · Destinations · Community" (active item dark, others faded), and a dark-brown "Configure" button at top right (1613,22,113x37) set in a serif. Left and right at y295–380 sit two thin-outlined square thumbnails (86x86) naming the previous and next destination with a tiny roof icon. Centre stage: a photographic roof (China: double-eaved golden-tiled palace roof, 512–1306 x 128–408) under which hangs a curtain of monospaced CJK glyphs (~35 columns x ~39 rows on ~15.5px pitch, 652–1195 x 408–1005, dark brown, slightly translucent) that casts a large soft diagonal shadow down-right onto the linen. Left column: a small mono kicker ("缘分 (Yuánfèn) A destined meeting" at y535) above a huge tight-leaded dark serif headline (x118–450, y585–1000); bottom right a 3-line mono caption at x1426,y930. A short grey pill scroll indicator sits at bottom centre (855–990, y1058). Motion: the cursor dragging through the curtain makes the glyph columns behave like hanging strands — they bend, swing and bunch along the cursor path with springy follow-through, pinned at the top under the roof, then settle back into the straight grid (0.3–5s). Clicking the next thumbnail (~5.0s) slides the roof+curtain left and dissolves it while the headline blurs out; Japan's red roof with kana curtain arrives from the right and settles centred by ~7.1s with the new headline blurring in word by word; thumbnails update to China / Kazakhstan. The same transition repeats ~11–12.6s into Kazakhstan (white felt yurt with ornamental band, Cyrillic glyph curtain). Around 15–16s the view zooms out into an overview row of smaller roofs (Vietnam boat, China, Japan, Kazakhstan, Russia), nav switches to "Destinations", and the row pans left 17–20s while hovered curtains still swing.

439fbk-date-picker-design.summary: A single "Bills" widget floats centred on a full-bleed sunrise photo of rolling grass hills under a pale blue-to-gold sky (live footage: the grass sways the whole clip, the sky barely moves). The widget is an opaque white card (686x549, ~40px radius, soft faint shadow) holding: a bold "Bills" title top-left with two light-grey circular icon buttons (help "?" and gear) top-right; a segmented control ("Upcoming Bills" active as a white pill with a hairline border, "All Bills" grey) and a white bordered "Sort ⌄" button; a grey sentence "You have 3 bills due within the next 7 days" with "3 bills" bold black; and a light-grey rounded tray holding a 7-day week strip, M T W T F S S over white capsule pills 9–15. Each pill shows its number over a small marker: a dashed grey empty circle for days without a bill, or a coloured icon disc (green Spotify on 10, blue cloud on 11, purple wifi on 15). The selected day becomes a near-black capsule with a white number and its weekday letter turns black. Below the card, separated by a ~25px gap, sits a white bill card (681x116, same radius) with a coloured rounded-square app tile, bill name, date, price and category. A black arrow cursor clicks a new day about once a second: 10 (start) → 9 at ~1.15s → 11 at ~2.15s → 13 at ~3.15s → 14 at ~4.15s → 15 at ~5.15s → 10 at ~6.15s. The highlight does not slide; the old capsule turns white and the new one turns dark in place, with a slight press swell. When a bill-less day is chosen the bill card tucks up behind the main card and the whole stack re-centres, the main card moving 72px down (top 188→260) over ~0.3s with ease-out (1.18–1.5s, 3.18–3.5s); when a day with a bill is chosen the card slides out from underneath and the stack moves 72px back up (2.18–2.5s, 5.18–5.5s). Going 15→10 at 6.2s the main card stays put while the bill card retracts in ~0.05s and drops back out with the new Spotify content by ~6.48s. Clicking 13→14 (no bill either way) moves nothing but the two capsules.

ad92jv-ascii-magic-effect-gallery.summary: A dark product clip in two acts. Act one (0–0.55s) shows the "Ascii Magic" web app at rest. It sits in a black window with rounded corners (~16px radius) at [48,47,1710,985], over a grey-to-dark gradient backdrop. A 48px header holds a sparkle logo, "Ascii Magic", Studio/Flow tabs, a "998" credits pill and an avatar. The left sidebar (~317px) holds Styles, a Realtime/Generative segmented control, LOOK/IMAGE/GENERATE steps and a "Select an effect" card. The main column shows the eyebrow "GENERATIVE", the title "Pick a look", a search box, a row of 11 category chips with mono counts, PREVIEW ON person chips, and a 4-column grid of 318×198 effect thumbnails. Each thumbnail is the same woman's profile re-rendered in a style (Bit Press, Terminal Print, Heat Signature…), with a mono number badge top-left and a white name bottom-left. From 0.6–1.15s a virtual camera zooms ~1.6× toward the top right with motion blur. The cursor clicks the 998 pill at ~2.15s, and a "Buy credits" modal fades in over a dimmed, blurred page. The camera pans and blurs (2.7–3.6s) to a tight close-up of the modal, which fills the frame height between x≈366 and 1450 (4–7.4s). Several 3D chrome coins with an embossed monogram tumble behind the title in the modal's top half. They are lit as hard thresholded white/black reflection bands with RGB chromatic-aberration fringes on the rims, and they spin the whole time the modal is open. The modal shows: a big mono credit count ("50 credits"), a mono price ("$11.25") with "$0.23 each" and a "Save 10%" chip, a tick-ruler slider (20–300) with an amber square thumb, four preset buttons (20/50/100/200), a white full-width CTA ("Buy 50 credits • $11.25") and a footer. The camera then pulls out (7.5–8.5s) and pushes in on the slider. From 9.6 to 11s the thumb is dragged right, and the value and price count up to 300 / $52.50 / Save 30%. The camera zooms out to the full window (11.3–11.8s), with the modal centred at [628,183,555,713]. The thumb keeps being dragged, so values and price update live, until the end at 18s.

1ulujs-border-beam.summary: A centred, light showcase on an off-white (#f4f4f5) page with a soft lilac-and-white silky ribbon backdrop sweeping across the lower half (static). Top centre: a small 73 px frosted rounded-square app icon with a faint rainbow beam on its top-right rim and a soft drop shadow; under it the black title "Border beam" (~32 px, regular) and the grey subtitle "Animated border beam component" (~22 px). The lower third holds one demo component at a time, each a milky frosted-glass surface whose border carries a blurred, multicolour (pink, cyan, green, blue, violet) glow that drifts continuously around the inner rim, never a hard stroke. Three demos rotate as a horizontal carousel: (1) 0–2.9 s a 618×125 fully rounded "Search or ask" pill with a faint round send button holding a dark ↑ arrow; (2) 3.35–8.05 s a 580×121 "Planning next moves" pill with a small coloured glow running along its bottom edge and a dark shimmer sweeping left to right through the grey text; (3) 8.5–13.2 s a 745×173 card (radius ~24) with "Build anything...", two chip buttons "Agent ⌄" and "Auto ⌄", and a faded round ↑ button at right. Each change is a fast slide (~0.45 s, ease-out): the current component exits to the left while the next enters from the right edge. At 13.2–13.6 s the search pill slides back in, so the clip loops. The header, icon and backdrop never move.

kvgsql-broken-select-dropdown.summary: A single dark-mode select sits a little below centre on a near-black #14131a page: a 474 x 82 px rounded field (radius about 14 px, fill #1e1f27, 1 px border about #34333c) at x 267, y 490. It holds the placeholder "Select a size" in light grey sans-serif (about 26 px, left edge x 296), and a white stroked chevron (about 32 x 20 px, about 3 px stroke, round caps) sits at its right end, centred near x 700, y 531. A pointer moves in at about 0.8s and turns into a hand over the chevron. Each click opens or closes a panel below the field: a 474 x 228 px panel at y 581 with the same fill, border and radius, a 10 px gap above it, and three rows ("Small", "Medium", "Large") at a 69 px pitch. The panel fades in and out over about 0.15 to 0.3 s with no slide. The chevron does not rotate cleanly. It squashes, bends into a curve, flattens to a line and flips between v and ^ as the clicks repeat (1.1s, 2.2s, 3.0s, 3.65s, then rapid clicks from 4.1 to 4.75s). At about 4.7s the chevron breaks loose from the field. It rises out of the box and travels upward, drifting slightly right (x about 700 to 775) and wobbling into a flattened wavy stroke, and leaves through the top of the frame by about 5.9s. The list closes at about 5.1s. The field stays with no chevron at all, the cursor wanders off to the right as an arrow, and from about 7.3s the frame holds still on the empty, chevron-less select.

1o59x5-dark-integrations-settings-panel.summary: A centred dark settings panel on a flat #2e2e2e canvas. The near-black (#0b0b0b) outer panel (149,180 → 931,900, ~28px radius) has a header at the top left: "Integrations" in white (~28px) and "Manage connected apps" in mid-grey (~22px). Below it sit two inset cards in #1b1b1b with ~16px radii, split by a 6px black seam at y≈482. The ACCOUNT card holds one row (Google). The APPS card holds three rows (Aave, Claude Code, Jupiter). Each card opens with a small, widely letter-spaced grey caps label, and hairline dividers separate the rows. Every row has a 54px rounded app tile at x=189, a white name (~24px) at x=264, and a grey meta line below it: "<OS> · <status>". An amber pill toggle (62×35) sits at x=830. When on, the track is amber (#f5c04f) with a black knob on the right holding an amber centre dot. When off, the track is dark charcoal with a faint lighter rim and a dark-grey knob on the left. Motion: from 0 to ~0.6s the panel unfolds downward from its header. The top stays fixed, the bottom grows from ~300 to 900, and rows fade up as they are uncovered. After that, a mouse cursor clicks through the toggles in sequence. At ~0.8–1.8s it turns Google off and back on. At ~2.0–2.7s it turns Jupiter on. At ~3.0–4.3s it turns Claude Code off and back on. At ~4.4–5.6s it turns Aave off and back on. At ~5.9–6.2s it turns Jupiter off, and Jupiter stays off to the end. Each click slides the knob ~27px, cross-fades the track between amber and charcoal, and steps the status text through "Disconnected" → "Connecting..." → "Connected just now". While a row is "Connecting...", an 8-spoke grey spinner appears before the meta line and pushes that text ~35px right. When the spinner leaves, the text slides back.

ctwik3-segmented-navigation-component.summary: A single dark capsule nav bar centred on a pure black (#000000) frame, with nothing else on screen except a macOS-style cursor (black arrow, white outline). At rest the bar fills #181818 with a faint lighter top inner rim (#222–#272727), fully rounded ends (radius = half its height). It holds 10 slots: inactive slots are small vertical capsule ticks (dim #333), and the active slot is a white (#fdfdfd) rounded-rectangle pill (radius ~22 px) with a near-black uppercase label "LINK N" in a medium sans at ~36 px cap height. Ticks on either side of the active pill step down: the nearest one is tall and bright (#a0a0a0, ~25x75), the next is medium (#626262, ~20x62), and the rest are dim (#333, ~17x50). Motion: at 0–0.3s a smaller, centred bar (≈433–1012 x 480–597) shows 10 equal dim ticks and no active pill. Between 0.35 and 0.8s the camera zooms in about 1.6x around the centre, so the bar grows to ≈252–1192 x 453–623, and "LINK 4" pops in as the cursor lands on slot 4. The cursor then clicks through LINK 10 (rest ~2.0–2.45s), LINK 1 (~3.45–4.4s), LINK 8 (~5.25–5.65s) and LINK 5 (~6.15–6.9s). In each transition (~0.45–0.9s) the label disappears, the white pill shrinks into a rounded square, and the ticks between origin and destination swell into light-grey rounded squares in a travelling wave that follows the motion-blurred cursor. The destination then grows into the white labelled pill and the neighbour ticks re-grade. The bar's outer width changes by up to ~40 px depending on which slot is active. From 6.9 to 7.4s the camera zooms back out to the small starting bar, the pill collapses, and all 10 ticks return to equal dim capsules, holding to 8.3s with the cursor resting below the bar.

lcclyy-instant-drop-menu.summary: A macOS desktop recorded close up, with a slow camera that drifts and zooms. A pale pearly wallpaper (warm cream at top left, cool white at right) sits behind a light menu bar. From left to right the bar holds: a violet pill for the screen-share app, an asterisk, an ID badge, "25°C" weather, Bluetooth, a row of four round portrait avatars (Tanya, a dark-skinned man, Mark, Emily), a grey dot, a link glyph, a "100" battery, a toggle glyph and "Tue 28. 7.". Below the bar is a near-black (#121212) app window with a ~40 px top-right radius, a dim "Chat" button, a blue-grey abstract blob image at the left and a magenta/orange gradient artwork in the middle. Desktop file icons "cosmos-1/2/3" sit at the right edge. Hovering an avatar shows a dark grey pill tooltip under it ("Emily · 1d ago" at 0.5 s, "Mark ●" with a green dot at 1 s). Clicking Tanya's avatar gives it a 4 px black ring. A stack then drops straight down under it, all left-aligned at x≈416: first a translucent grey pill bubble "ok, Hoy for Mac is so much fun!", then a large black rounded composer (radius ~70 px) with "Note to Tanya...", four line icons (waveform, paperclip, video, record dot) and a muted "Drop ↵" pill. Each new message makes the composer slide down by one bubble's height. Tanya's reply bubble arrives at about 3 s, and the composer drops about 170 px. The composer is frosted dark glass: once it sits over the pink artwork, it takes on that artwork's colour as a blurred magenta/crimson wash with a thin pink rim light. Typing turns Drop solid blue. Sending at about 5.5 s adds a right-aligned black bubble "exactly, just your iCloud." and the composer drops another ~128 px. A grey heart badge appears beside Tanya's bubble on hover. Hovering the waveform icon shows "⌘1". From about 8.2 s the camera zooms in. Voice recording then shows "En", live waveform bars, a growing transcript and a "Recording 0:03" timer with an orange blinking dot and "Stop ↵". Later the voice note is sent as a "▶ 0:06" bubble, three cosmos files are dragged in as thumbnail chips, and the chat continues.

hl0uds-colorful-text-notes-concept.summary: An iPhone (dark graphite bezel, ~75px corner radius, dynamic island) sits centred on a near-black #080b0c stage with a faint radial vignette. The screen is a redesigned Apple Notes in dark mode, background #121315. The nav bar reads "< Notes" / "Next week plans" (semibold, centred) / "Done", and below it is a note of short paragraphs in SF-style 22px type with a 30px line height, left edge at x=262. Only the paragraph in focus is bright white. The others are dimmed to a dark grey, and paragraphs further from the focus are also progressively blurred (the top line and the bottom paragraph are soft). Inline words carry coloured text: "bigger" ochre, "smaller" teal, "Frame 2847" purple, "Rent" red, "Dentist" rose. Story: a cursor selects "nobody reads the case study." at ~1.8s (grey rounded selection bar, white drag handles). A dark, translucent rounded popover with a downward tail appears above the selection: a 3x3 grid of glossy colour orbs (white, red, yellow / green, teal, blue / violet, pink, a rainbow ring) and a list of recent highlights, each with a small coloured bar. Hovering the swatches tints the selection teal, then pink. The popover closes and the phrase stays pink (5.5s). The whole paragraph is then selected and cycled through purple, teal and green before returning to white (6–11s). At 11.05–11.4s focus moves to the "Ideas I'll never ship" paragraph: the text scrolls down ~120px and the bright/dim states swap. At 11.8–12.4s the camera zooms ~2x into the screen. "Frame 2847" is selected and the popover tints it red, then yellow; the highlight is a gradient bar fading to the right. The popover closes at ~15.6s, leaving "Frame 2847" yellow (16.2s). At 16.75–17.55s the camera zooms back out to the full phone, which holds to the end.

f7tq6g-bento-grid-exploration.summary: A dark feature section (#151515) centred on a 1080-wide column, with diagonal-hatched gutters left of x≈108 and right of x≈1188. At the top sit a monospace pill "Our amazing features", a large white sans headline "Everything you need to build." and a two-line grey subtitle. Below is a 2×2 bento grid of borderless cells. Each cell has an illustration in its upper part and, at y≈527–604, a centred uppercase white title and a two-line grey description. A violet-white specular light runs clockwise around the shield's rim, and the blurred code behind it drifts and flickers.

1ebgeo-minimal-portfolio-with-games.summary: A screen recording of a minimal, single-column typographic portfolio on pure white (#ffffff), seen through a recorder camera that zooms and pans to follow the cursor. Content column is left-aligned (~464–1445 px at the 0.5s overview): black name "Nexvyn", grey "Design Engineer", three grey Inter paragraphs with black inline links (reverse-engineer has a dashed yellow underline, the email is underlined grey), a faint "See more of my work on GitHub." line, then a handwritten "projects" heading with list/grid toggles. Fixed top-right chrome: a light-grey muted speaker icon and a solid black theme dot. Handwritten blue margin notes ("feel free to reach out" with a hand-drawn bracket, "← psst, it's a game" with a sheep sticker) appear beside the paragraphs. The story is a run of hover easter eggs: 0–1s the text fades in line by line; ~2–3.5s hovering the name shows a smoky-edged anime avatar to its left; ~4–7.5s hovering "Design" turns it into a green handwritten word whose stem grows into an embroidered-looking bouquet that blooms more flowers (4.85→5.35); ~8.5–9.5s hovering "Engineer" turns it blue and pins a textured blueprint card with a wrench; ~9.7–9.9 the camera pulls back; ~10.8–11.5 hovering GitHub scribbles the word out and pops a white rounded card with a 12×7 green contribution grid and "@nexvyn · 2,341 contributions this year"; ~12–13.6 that card grows into a teal-framed preview and then a full-frame pixel-art top-down game (knight "NEXVYN", towers, river, sheep, "Pat the sheep" prompt) that plays until ~15.85 and cross-dissolves back to the page by ~16.05. The projects list follows: "runeicons ★660" with a heavily blurred preview card and a blue app icon, which on hover (~19–20s) sharpens to a product screenshot; "nexvyn/ui ★225"; "rynix studio" card; a handwritten "mind" section whose row gets a light grey pill on hover (22.5→23). At ~24.5s clicking the black dot floods the page dark (#0b0b0b) with a circle from the dot, a tooltip "Nexvyn prefers light mode" shows, and at ~26.8s a white circle grows back from the dot to restore light; from ~27.8s the page scrolls to an illustrated lotus pond that fades up from white at the bottom.

q6117m-drawing-app-toolbar-blur.summary: Four product shots of a drawing app's tools on an off-white #fbfbfa ground, filmed by a tilted 3D camera with heavy depth-of-field blur: only a narrow band is sharp and everything nearer or farther melts into soft blur. Hard cuts at about 3.0s, 6.4s and 8.85s split the clip into four scenes, and the camera drifts slowly in every one. Scene 1 (0–3s): a long white pill toolbar crosses the frame at y≈360–830 with a grey grabber at top centre (≈878–990, y≈380). It holds blurred round icon buttons at both ends, three 3D marker pens (white barrels with a coloured tip and band, labelled 58), and a 3×2 grid of colour dots: brown, blue, green on top; yellow, red and a conic hue wheel below. A hand cursor clicks yellow, so the selection ring moves from brown to yellow and the pens' tips and bands turn from brown to yellow (0.5–1.5s). The cursor then hovers the third pen, which rises about 50px (2.5s). Scene 2 (3–6.4s): a paper-textured note card seen at a steep angle holds the handwritten quote "Trying to define yourself is like trying to bite your own teeth" – Alan Watts, with a style strip below it reading Highlight / Underline / Overline. A dark stroke indicator moves from Underline to Overline, and the pale yellow line jumps from under line 2 to above the words. Scene 3 (6.4–8.85s): the same card from below holds "There's advertisements on my eyelids, free trials in the air I breathe" – Maxwell Davis, with taupe highlight blocks and an Opacity slider drawn as a dark zig-zag spring. The spring stretches across as the value climbs to 1.00 (rightmost at 8.15). Scene 4 (8.85–11.42s): "Hatred is too strong of an emotion to waste on someone you don't like" – Sixto Rodriguez, with pink highlight blocks above a row of six crayon-scribble swatches (yellow, orange, pink, cyan, green, blue). A hand-drawn brown circle marks the selected one. The cursor picks pink, then cyan (≈10.65s), and the highlight blocks turn from pink to light blue. Corners are fully round on the pill; the card has a small radius and a soft drop shadow.

brxk6p-ultrahuman-workout-view.summary: A tilted iPhone mockup (titanium frame visible down the left edge, light grey #f1f1f1 studio backdrop at top right and left) shot with shallow depth of field: the top map area and the bottom of the chart are blurred, the middle readout is sharp. The screen is black. The top ~300 px are a darkened, blurred Apple Maps screenshot (navy roads, orange 'STAGE' pin, teal 'Infinite Change Fitness' label, yellow pin label, a 'Maps Legal' credit) with a glassy pill timer reading 00:00:NN, outlined in purple, and a location marker that starts as a small blue dot and becomes a pale outlined ellipse ring. Below, centred, are a small grey monospace 'HEART RATE' caption, an outline heart icon and a big white monospace BPM number (dotted zeros) with a small 'BPM' unit, then a zone line ('ZONE 1 | LIGHT ACTIVITY ZONE' in glowing indigo, later 'ZONE 2 | FAT BURNING ZONE' in glowing mint, with the descriptor in grey). Under that sits a wide pill-shaped zone bar, about 684x86 px, with a soft cloudy rainbow fill (indigo, teal, green, yellow, orange, coral red), a thin light rim, a coloured outer glow, 9 thin white tick lines and a thick white rounded marker. Under the bar are the scale labels 92 / 105 / 118 / 142 / 160. At the bottom is a line chart with two dashed guide lines: a glowing line that goes from indigo to mint, a dark violet fill below it, and a glowing mint end dot at the right. Motion: the timer counts up one second per second (00:00:22 at 0.5s, 00:00:39 at 17.1s). The heart outline spins continuously in 3D. The BPM number rolls digit by digit as heart rate changes (104→102→98→…→116→…→105). The marker slides along the bar to match: x≈313 at 0.5s, ≈290 at 2.5s, ≈372 at 8.65s, ≈394 at 10.35s, ≈420 at 12.8s, ≈441 at 16.6s. The zone label switches from ZONE 1 indigo to ZONE 2 mint at about 3.8–4.0s. The cloudy texture inside the bar drifts all the time. The map ring pulses. The chart gains points over time, its big step shifts left, and the line's tail turns mint.

1s5qn0-minimal-ai-chat-composer.summary: A single wide AI chat composer sits centred on a flat #f7f7f7 page. It is two layers: a light grey tray (#ececec, about 1456x421 at x107 y333, corners about 48px) and, on top of it, a near-white input card (#fdfdfd, 1452x320, corners about 48px, 1px #dedede hairline and a soft drop shadow). The card holds a light grey 36px placeholder, "Start by typing...", at top left. Its bottom row has a thin "+", a "Request approval" chip with a hand icon, and on the right a model selector "Auto ⌄", a mic outline and a 65px grey circular send button with a white up-arrow. Below the card the tray shows three small brand marks (Gmail M, Slack, ClickUp) and grey "Connect apps". The type is a neutral grotesk (Inter-like). The motion is a cursor-driven demo. The white card slides down about 97px (top 335 to 432) while the tray's outer box stays at 333 to 753. (7) About 12.35s send is clicked. The text clears back to the placeholder and the send circle goes back to grey.

1y239p-organic-growth-portfolio-modal.summary: A light (#f9f9f9) directory page is cut off on the left. In view are the end of an intro paragraph in mid-grey ("…cked directory of the most beautiful / …et."), a line ending "…Know one that belongs here?" followed by a pill button "submit it" (~406,480,145,52, radius ~12), a "components ↗" link, a 1px hairline at y≈805, a search bar with a "/" key chip, a list/grid view toggle (grid active, white tile), and tilted dark screenshot cards at the top and bottom edges. The right half of the frame is empty. The cursor comes in at about 0.15s and rests on "submit it", which turns a darker grey on hover. At about 1.0s the click starts a black fill that sweeps left to right across the button, which is fully black with white text by 1.1s. In the same moment a white modal card (633,320,549×372, radius ~16, soft shadow) resolves from a heavy blur and fade into sharp focus by about 1.2s. Behind the card, a frame of real foliage (dense green leaves, grass blades and small lilac/violet flowers, photographic, ragged cut-out edge) grows outward from patches at the card's edges. It fills the full ring (≈578,265 to 1233,748) by about 1.65s, with its outer edge still creeping a few px until then. While the modal is open (1.65 to 3.15s) the foliage keeps moving: leaves sway and flicker. The card itself is static. The card holds the grey title "Suggest a portfolio", a close ×, a grey field group with two rows (person icon "Their name" and globe icon "their-site.com") split by a hairline, and a two-line grey note "Yours or someone else's. Every one is reviewed." At about 3.2s the modal and foliage blur out, fade and shrink slightly, and are gone by about 3.35s. The button's black fill retracts and it returns to the hover grey by about 3.5s. The cursor leaves at about 4.6s and the button fades back to its pale rest grey by about 5.0s. Type is a neutral grotesque sans throughout.

l9y2vy-expanding-search-interaction.summary: A single control sits alone on a flat warm off-white page (#f4f3ef), centred horizontally near the top third. At rest it is a 112 px circular search button: a white rim with a hairline grey edge and a soft diffuse drop shadow, holding a 90 px warm-grey disc (#ebe9e4) with a dark magnifier glyph. On click (0.45–1.0 s) the circle stretches symmetrically left and right into a 542 px pill search bar (x 237–779, top fixed at y 137) whose inner grey field shows the magnifier at left, a blue text caret, placeholder 'Search components' in light grey and a grey × at right; at the same time a white results panel (radius ~40 px, same width, soft shadow) drops from a thin pill under the bar down to y 610, and its four rows ('Action Button', 'Toast', 'Code Input', 'Segmented Control', ~27 px dark sans, 81 px pitch) slide/blur into place in a stagger, the first row covered by a fully rounded warm-grey highlight pill. From 1.6 to 3.2 s the cursor hovers down the list and the highlight pill glides (not jumps) between rows: Toast, Code Input, Segmented Control, then back to Action Button. At ~4.2 s typing 't' re-filters the list with a blurred cross-fade: matching letters turn bold black while the rest of each name goes mid-grey, and the panel grows to five rows (Toast, Tab Bar, Action Button, Quantity Stepper, Invite Field, bottom ~698); typing 'o' (~4.5 s) narrows it to three rows (Toast, Hold to Confirm, Action Button) and the panel shrinks to y ~528. Hovering the × shows a small round grey hover disc; clicking it (~6.0 s) clears the field and the original four rows blur back in (panel bottom back to 610). At ~7.05–7.25 s the panel retracts upward into the bar and the bar contracts back into the 112 px circle, ending where it began.

1dts93-neumorphic-rich-text-editor.summary: A light, soft neumorphic editor on a near-white canvas (#eeeeef, faintly lighter at top). At rest (0–0.8 s and again from 20.3 s) a long raised toolbar pill (114,160 → 846,240, radius ~24, no border, soft grey drop shadow below and a bright top rim) sits in the upper third. Inside it, on the left, is a raised 'Body 2' style dropdown chip with a chevron. Then come faint grey B / I / U / link glyphs, a glossy dark-grey sphere colour swatch, and three alignment icons; left-align is dark and active, centre and right are pale. Below, a 6-line Inter-like paragraph (~19 px, 37 px line pitch, left edge x=165) fades from dark grey on lines 1–3 to very pale on line 6. A small white state tag at x≈44,y≈299 reads 'idle' and later 'selection', 'menu', 'carry', 'done'. The clip is a screen recording with a virtual camera. From 0.85–2.9 s it zooms in (~1.45x) and pans toward the text. The I-beam then drag-selects ', guided by clear standards' in pale pink, with a black 'Select' pill tooltip under the cursor. At ~3.2 s a frosted translucent Cut / Copy / Paste menu floats above the selection. Hovering Cut (4.8 s) raises the Cut chip and shows a 'Cut ⌘ + X' tooltip. From 5.6 s the camera pushes in further. A dashed rounded outline appears around the phrase, and a black-handled pair of scissors travels along it (left-top at 6.7 s, right-bottom at 8 s). At 8.7–9.2 s the phrase lifts out as a paper strip tilted ~-8°. It settles flat (10.2 s), then is carried with a black 'Move' pill (11.3–14.5 s) while the paragraph reflows to close the gap and the camera pans right. At the drop point after 'component', a 'Select all | Paste' menu appears. Hovering Paste (15.9 s) shows 'Paste ⌘ + V'. The strip tilts and drops into the line (16.2–17.4 s), giving 'components, guided by clear standards'. From 18.35–20.25 s the camera pulls back to the original framing with the tag reading 'done'. Around 21.6–22.5 s the paragraph fades out entirely, leaving the toolbar and tag.

tfehkd-listening-loader.summary: A single dark control centred on a near-white page (#f7f7f7–#fafafa): a flat near-black pill (#010101) spanning about x 119–982, y 244–475 (863 x 232, fully round ends, radius ≈116), lifted by a soft grey shadow that falls only below it (darkest ≈#c8c8c8–#d3d3d3 just under the bottom edge, fading out by about y 620). Inside, left to right on one centre line at y≈360: a circular audio indicator centred at (234,360), which is also the centre of the left end cap; the word "Listening" in a near-white medium sans (box ≈[364,332,307,67], cap height ≈52 px); and an elapsed timer such as "0:02" in a dimmer grey (≈#c8c8c8), left edge fixed at x 738, proportional digits. The indicator is a light ring with a solid centre dot (Ø≈22). When quiet it is a dashed ring of 12 short rounded dashes, Ø≈109, stroke ≈7, mid grey (≈#9a9a9a), turning slowly clockwise. When the voice gets louder the dashes lengthen and merge into one continuous ring that grows to Ø≈121, thickens to ≈14 px and brightens to near white. The dot brightens with it too. The edges are slightly soft, and the ring has no outline and no gradient. The pulses are irregular and audio-driven: solid around 1–2.6 s, opening on the upper left at 3.5 s, dashed at 4 s, solid again around 5.2, 6–7 and 8.2–8.6 s, then quiet and dashed from about 9 s to the end. The timer counts up from 0:01 to 0:14, one step per second. Nothing else moves: the pill, label, shadow and page stay fixed.

13ccu9-minimal-history-timeline-explorer.summary: A macOS browser window (nekada.vercel.app) sits on a blurred blue wallpaper, inset ~46 px, with a light grey #eeeef0 canvas, faint dashed vertical year gridlines, and a white timeline ruler band across the bottom (y≈851–1034): dense thin grey ticks, taller ticks at labelled years, grey labels. At rest the prompt is a wide white pill (≈499,418,864×122, radius ≈40, soft shadow) reading "Add an event, person or era" over a ruler spanning 2000 BCE–2000 with a bold black "0" marker at centre. The user types "picas(s)" (0.9–1.8s, grey ✕ clear at right); on submit the pill slides up to y≈150 and shows a dimmed placeholder with a small grey ring spinner; at ~2.9s the ruler rescales to 1850–2000 and a Pablo Picasso card fades in (large rounded-square B/W photo ≈330 px, bold name, grey "1881 – 1973") with a black lifespan bar with round end dots that draws left→right from 1881 to 1973, dashed drop lines to the ruler. "elvis" is typed (4.3–5s), spinner again, and at ~6.1s an Elvis Presley card (smaller ≈137 px photo, "1935 – 1977") appears upper-right while Picasso shrinks to the same small size, both bars sitting on their year positions. At 7.65–8.2s the camera zooms into the content (chrome cropped away, ~1.5x). The cursor hovers each photo, which gains a ~5 px blue (#6b8fe8-ish) ring; at ~9.7s the overlap is revealed: a pale blue translucent column between 1935 and 1973, blue segments on both bars, a white pill "38 years overlap" on the ruler flanked by blue ticks, and "1935"/"1973" labels in bold blue. At 11.65–12.25s the camera zooms back out to the full window.

72xxyw-dark-fintech-card-animation.summary: Two dark feature cards sit side by side, vertically centred on a near-black (#0c0c0c) stage: a narrower "Transaction Messaging" card on the left (x128–670, y276–803) and a wider "Document Management" card on the right (x685–1516, y268–811). Both are #131313 slabs with ~40px radius and a faint 1px lighter rim, a title in white ~22px and a two-line grey description at the bottom-left. Each holds a recessed demo panel (#181818, ~24px radius) whose bottom edge fades into the card. The left panel is a chat on a faint dot grid: a centred pill "Request created and Escrow funded", a right-aligned "You" bubble and a left-aligned "John Doe" bubble. The right panel is a window mock with three grey traffic-light dots, then an inner darker list titled "Documents" with rows (checkbox, grey file icon, filename, date, kebab) separated by a hairline; a third row "KY-8453.pdf" fades out under a bottom mask. Motion is a looping ~8s demo: at the start the card titles and descriptions resolve from a word-by-word blur reveal (~0–1s); chat bubbles fade in while rising ~10px (You first, John Doe ~2.3s), a small green arrow cursor glides in the documents list toward the W-2 row, then to the first row's checkbox, which turns green-checked (~4.5s); a second green cursor wanders in the chat panel; around 7–8s the chat bubbles fade out while drifting down and the checkbox clears, and the cycle replays (empty chat at ~8–10.5s, bubbles back by ~11–14s). Card frames, titles and list text never move.

193du9-minimal-serif-portfolio-hero.summary: A full-bleed portfolio page on near-white (#fdfdfd) with a thin pale-blue gradient strip across the top (y 0–36). The hero is one left-aligned column starting at x 321: a 1044×587 photo of the Upper East Side skyline above a park (x 321–1365, y 118–705) drawn as a halftone grid of round dots, about 64 columns × 36 rows at a 16 px pitch. The dots are ~15 px wide and almost touch, so the gaps between them read as small four-point stars. Below it sits a two-line dark serif headline, "I'm designing software for the world on your / screen, inspired by the one outside my window." (y ~755–855, ~44 px), then a two-line grey sans bio (y ~888–942, ~19 px). In the bio, "David Luft" is underlined by a row of 11 small dots coloured from the scene. To the right of the image (x 1402) is a small sans sidebar: "Scene →", "Backdrop" with a small rounded-rectangle icon, then light-grey metadata ("Upper East Side", date and time, then Wind / Cars / People with right-aligned values at x ~1532). Motion: at 0–0.5 s the page fades in. The photo starts as a soft blurred pale image with a grey headline, then resolves into the dot grid by ~1 s while the bio and sidebar fade in. The scene then cycles, and each change crossfades every dot's colour and updates the date line: 6/20 10:04 AM sunny → 7/6 4:45 PM overcast (~3 s) → 6/18 5:23 PM (~5 s) → 7/3 8:30 PM dusk (~7.5 s) → back to 6/20 10:04 AM by ~11 s. The Wind/Cars/People numbers keep ticking, and dots flicker locally (cars and people moving) while the scene holds. At 6.0 s, clicking Backdrop fills its icon solid black and turns the star-shaped gaps between dots near-black. Between 10.05 and 10.45 s the whole page scales to ~0.82 into a rounded white window card (x 62–1625, y 63–1016, radius ~16) floating on a soft sky-blue gradient. At ~12.5–14 s an About modal (grey scrim, white card with a round portrait) opens and closes. From 15.25 s the page scrolls up ~560 px to show a project card ("Site management at scale" with a green-framed app screenshot), and from ~18 s it moves into a product demo.

4063qa-chatsheet-automation-landing-page.summary:
A light SaaS landing page for "Chatsheet", recorded as a full scroll-through. The whole page scrolls down section by section, pausing at each one, then scrolls back up to the hero. The page background is near-white #fbfbfc. Hairline guide lines run down the page at x≈33 and x≈1469, and the hero and enterprise bands are framed by thin grey rules on a slightly greyer #f4f5f7 fill. All type is centred or left-aligned to x≈203. Headings use an elegant dark-navy (#0c1632) transitional serif; body text is a grey sans; every CTA is a #4374f5 pill.

Sections from top to bottom:
1. Hero at 0 s: nav (Chatsheet ring logo, four links, a white "Book a Free Call" pill); a two-line serif headline about 70 px tall, "Turn Manual Tasks into Automations"; a two-line grey subcopy; a blue "Book a Free Discovery" pill beside a white "Case Studies" pill. Below sits an isometric illustration: a blue concentric-ring hub disc with a navy side wall. Small white app-icon tiles (Slack, PDF, YouTube, Drive, Gmail, Sheets, Excel) travel along a dashed path into the hub from the lower left. A rail of translucent cards leaves the hub to the upper right, carrying blue pill labels "Automation Action", "Strategy Content" and "Personal…".
2. Three numbered steps ("01." / "02." / "03." in light-grey serif before navy titles), alternating text and isometric periwinkle-plate illustrations.
3. "Examples of What You Can Automate With Chatsheet": a hairline-bordered grid of 3 + 2 cards, each with a serif title, grey copy and a line illustration.
4. "Enterprise-Grade Automation, 100% Done-for-You": a band of three illustrations with saturated blue planes, three titled columns, and a centred CTA.
5. "Ready to Save Hours Every Week?": a CTA beside concentric pale-blue rings, with circular app badges (Notion, Gmail, Salesforce, Excel, Slack) orbiting along a dashed arc.
6. Footer: a large ring logo with the "Chatsheet" serif wordmark, three links, and a copyright line.

Motion:
- The page scrolls in eased steps: 0.25–2.15 s, 2.85–4.45 s, 5.15–7.25 s, 7.75–9.75 s, 10.35–12.55 s, then a slow drift to the footer by about 13.6 s.
- It holds near 2.5, 4.85, 7.45 and 10 s.
- It scrolls back to the top over 14.15–16.8 s and holds on the hero until 17.97 s.
- Inside the page, the hero icon tiles drift along the dashed path toward the hub, and the CTA's circular badges travel along their arc.

1oi0w9-lanyard-id-badge-portfolio.summary: A clean off-white (#fdfdfd) portfolio hero. Two small black serif paragraphs sit top-left ("I design products and the / stories behind them. [more]", left edge x=124, y≈106) and top-right ("Currently studying Arts, / Technology, & Business @ USC", right-aligned to x≈1438). Across the bottom runs a giant black serif "Sam Cheng" (cap height ≈225px, y≈770–1060), bleeding off both side edges and the bottom ("g" cut at the right edge). In the middle hangs a 3D physics lanyard: a dark charcoal flat strap forms a V from the top edge (x≈651 and x≈912) down to a silver metal swivel clip at x≈780, y≈290–400, holding a clear plastic badge holder (≈327×525px, rounded corners, two punched holes and a slot at the top, a ridged zip seal line under them). The holder is transparent plastic: its clear margin shows the giant black text through it, while the white card inside is opaque and hides the "C" of the giant name. The card carries "Sam" in black and "Cheng" in blue (#1a1ae6-ish) serif with a slightly rough, inky printed edge, then "Currently / Design, Tech, & Business @ USC / Previously" and three pills: black "Kleiner Perkins Fellows", red "Oracle", purple "Multiply". A soft grey drop shadow falls right and down behind the badge and the strap. Only the lanyard and badge move: at 0.5–1.0s the badge sways a few degrees; from ≈1.35s the cursor (a grab hand) drags it up and right, the strap bends and the badge lies rotated ≈90° at the top right (2.5s); it is released and swings pendulum-like, is grabbed and flung again around 5.5–6.5s and 9.5–11s, and from ≈12s swings with decaying amplitude, settling to a slight tilt by 17.5s. The corner text and the giant name never move.

ti5i8b-vercel-agents-homepage-redesign.summary: A Vercel-style hero on a 1482x1080 canvas. A slim nav bar runs along the top (black Vercel triangle at x 127, links Products ▾ / Resources ▾ / Enterprise / Pricing, then three pill buttons on the right: Get a Demo, Log In and a filled Sign Up ending at x 1334). The left column, aligned at x≈127, holds a two-line tight-tracked headline, "Build and run / agents on Vercel" (~56px, y 298–402), a two-line grey subhead and two pill CTAs: a filled "Create an agent" and an outlined "Talk to an expert". The right half shows an isometric 3D cube drawn as a hexagon (box ≈803,347,352,320). It has three rounded rhombus faces, top, lower-left and right, separated by gaps. Six thick black chevron frame segments sit around them, and a faint hexagonal halo and a soft drop shadow sit underneath. A small white Vercel triangle sits on the top face. Above the cube are two chat bubbles joined to it by hairline connectors: a user bubble "@data-agent How did revenue trend last quarter by region?" at the top right, and an agent reply bubble with a small robot avatar circle to its left. Along the bottom, a four-column stat row (4T+, 3×, 1M+, < 5 min; ~56px light-weight numerals at y≈858, two-line grey captions at y≈930) starts at x 126/434/741/1048. Motion: a cursor moves over the cube. The face under the cursor lightens to a soft grey gradient, and an annotation fades in (~200 ms) with a short hairline leader, a bold title and a 3-line grey caption: Connect (bottom-left, ~0.2–1.0s), Sandbox (right, ~1.0–1.7s), eve (top-left, ~1.8–2.4s), Drives (left, ~2.5–3.2s). From ~3.3s nothing is annotated. At ~4.1s the page hard-cuts from light (#f7f7f7 bg, near-black type) to dark (#000 bg, white type, buttons inverted). The cube becomes outline-only: black faces with thin grey stroked edges and outlined frame segments. In dark mode, hovering the lower-left face lights it and brings back Connect (~5.1–5.9s), which then fades as the cursor leaves. The layout never moves; only the hover highlights, annotations, cursor and theme change.

1cr7lo-minimal-animated-footer.summary: A full-bleed footer laid over a rendered scene: a beige 1984-style Macintosh stands centred on a grassy hilltop (TV body about x 776–1128, y 492–924) under an open sky, with dandelion seeds drifting low on the left. The footer type sits in the top 300 px on a four-column grid. Column 1 at x≈105 holds the serif wordmark "offline", whose first o is a power symbol, at about 45 px tall, then a two-line white sans tagline and a smaller copyright line. Columns 2–4 start at x≈633, 1037 and 1441. Each has a condensed serif heading (Platform / About / Social Media, about 32 px) at y≈96 and white sans links (about 19 px) at y≈155, 197, 238 and 280. All type is white on the image, with no panels, cards or dividers. Motion: (1) 0.1–1.0s the type fades in from blurred and transparent to sharp, top rows first. At the same time the Mac's screen powers on: a thin white scan line at y≈650 on a black screen (0.1s) opens to a noisy white glare (0.3–0.5s), then settles into SMPTE colour bars with scanlines and a violet/pink glow around the screen (from about 0.6s). (2) A pointer hovers links one at a time: How it works ≈1.5–2.2s, Careers ≈2.8–3.1s, Instagram ≈3.4–3.8s, Pricing ≈4.2–4.5s. The hovered link gets a 1–2 px white underline the width of the word and a red/cyan chromatic-split fringe on its letters. (3) 2.15–4.0s the whole scene grades from day to dusk. The sky goes from mid blue (#396cb1) to deep navy at the top with a warm orange haze on the horizon, the grass turns golden and the Mac picks up warm light. From about 2.5s small white asterisk-shaped sparkle stars fade in and drift across the sky. (4) ≈4.3–4.9s the TV switches off: the bars wash out to pink, collapse to a horizontal band, then to a thin line, and leave a dark screen. (5) ≈5.5–6.3s a glowing white moon-like dot about 16 px across, with a soft halo, drifts from the upper middle down to the top-left and settles into the logo's power-symbol o, fading as it lands. The night scene then holds to 6.93s. No layout moves at any point; only light, screen content, type opacity and small particles change.
