1t92dp-skeuomorphic-image-compressor-mac.summary: A white page at 1440x1080 with one centred column. At the top is a photoreal retro compressor machine (box ~[425,178,590,230]): a warm-grey plastic body, a brushed-metal top deck with a dark LCD window, a blue knurled metal knob and a small red-orange push button, and a long horizontal feed slot across the front. Below it is a drop zone with no border, drawn as a faint grey dot grid on a 24 px pitch that fades out at its edges (~[445,440,545,270]). It holds two centred lines: "Drop your image here" (~22 px, near-black) and "or click browse files" (~18 px, mid-grey). At the bottom centre (y≈924–1004) is a segmented pill control: a light-grey capsule track holding a grey "Compress" pill with a white compress glyph and white text, next to a white "Size" pill with black text. To the right of the drop zone, a photo card (a woman with windswept red hair against a blue sky, in a green top) rests tilted about −4°, with rounded corners, a soft drop shadow and a small white image-icon badge at its top left. Motion: from 1.9 s to 2.6 s the cursor drags the card left about 460 px until it sits centred under the machine. Around 3.0 s the card vanishes, the drop-zone text blurs out, and "Size" rolls to "58KB" with a blur. By 3.45 s the photo hangs from the slot inside a frosted, translucent white plastic sleeve with soft diagonal sheen stripes, and the sleeve lengthens to y≈790 by 3.75 s. From about 4.5 s to 5.5 s the Compress pill turns black (pressed). From about 6 s to 9.5 s the sleeve vacuum-shrinks: the plastic wrinkles, the photo pinches in at its sides and warps, and the bottom edge turns ragged. Around 10.5 s an orange glow runs along the left of the slot and the value rolls from 58KB to 21KB. By about 12 s the Compress pill has become a light-grey "Download" pill with a download glyph and dark text, and everything holds there to 16.8 s.

16hivf-vercel-open-source.summary: A light Vercel open-source hero on a #f7f7f7 page. A top nav runs across y≈33: black Vercel triangle at the left, then grey links "Products ⌄", "Resources ⌄", "Enterprise" and "Pricing". On the right are two small white outlined buttons, "Ask AI" and "Dashboard", and a round avatar. Centred below is a large stage panel [336,151,975,540] with a ~16px radius. Its fill is a vertical gradient from light grey #e6e6e6 at the top to the page colour at the bottom, where it dissolves into the page with no hard edge. A faint white Vercel triangle watermark sits at its centre (≈823,435). A white pill dock with a soft shadow sits on the stage's lower edge, centred at y≈648. It holds 8 small framework logos in this order: Next (N), Svelte, a ring logo, Nuxt, black block stairs, a gradient lightning badge, an E/E wordmark and a grey paperclip mark. Under the stage: a huge tight-tracked headline "Open Source Software" (~80px, near-black), a three-line grey paragraph and two pills, a black "View on GitHub" and a white "Code of Conduct ↗". Motion: at 0.3–0.8s the dock fades in and rises ~33px into place. After that a cursor drags logos out of the dock. Each one grows as it leaves into a big glossy die-cut sticker, with a white border, a specular highlight on the upper-left edges and a soft drop shadow, and stays where it is dropped. The order is: Nuxt (dragged ~2.5s, landed ~3.0s, left of centre), the lightning badge (~4.3s, right), the block stairs (~5.0–5.45s, top-left) and Svelte (~6.9–7.25s, top-centre). From ~8.3s the stickers are removed one at a time, each blurring and fading out in ~0.2–0.3s: lightning ~8.4s, Svelte ~8.9s, Nuxt ~9.3s, stairs ~10.0s. The stage is empty again by 10.1s. The dock, headline, copy, buttons and nav never move.

upmtie-agents-platform-hero.summary: A centred, light hero on an off-white page (#fcfcfc). At the top an orange-red outline four-point sparkle (≈44 px), with four short amber diagonal rays at its corners, sits at x≈404, y≈93. Below it is a dark headline, "A faster path to production AI" (≈26 px, #181818, centred at y≈175), and a two-line grey subtitle (≈24 px, #676767, lines at y≈222 and y≈264). Under the copy is a square stage (64–743 × 337–1015). Its fill is a hair greyer (#fafafa) than the page, it has a 1 px very light border, and a tiny orange-red dot marks each of its four corners. All stage content is clipped to it. At the stage centre sits a white capsule command pill (≈380 × 82, fully rounded, hairline light border, soft diffuse shadow below). It holds the Cloudflare cloud logo, then monospace "$" in grey, "npm" in near-black and "i agents" in orange-red, followed by an orange block cursor. The motion runs in three acts. (1) 0–0.4 s: the pill opens from an 82 px circle holding only the cloud into the full capsule, growing sideways from the centre. (2) ≈0.4–1.3 s: the command types itself one character at a time ("$ n" at 0.5 s, "npm i a" at 0.8 s, "npm i agen" at 1.0 s, "npm i agents" at 1.3 s). The cursor moves right with the text and later blinks. (3) From ≈1.3 s, a puff of tiny dots rises at the "i". By 1.5 s it becomes a tight cluster of miniature logo discs around the pill. The cluster bursts outward into a ring about 330 px across by 1.65–1.75 s, and by ≈2.0 s it fills the whole stage. From then to the end (12.3 s), the stage is a dense field of white circular discs, each holding one AI-company logo (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Meta, Microsoft, Google, Nvidia, Mistral, Hugging Face, Cloudflare, Z, Replicate-style R, a pause-style II, a striped globe, a blue star, a pink waveform and others). The disc sizes are mixed, about 55–215 px. The field drifts and pans continuously, and discs swell and shrink as they travel. Large discs pass in front of the pill, which stays fixed at the centre. A small grab-hand mouse cursor shows the field being dragged. The heading, subtitle, sparkle and stage frame never move.

1luoq5-ticket-ui.summary: A single event ticket sits centred on a near-black page (#101010): a 920 x 575 dark-charcoal card (#191919–#1b1b1b, x 262–1182, y 251–826) with quarter-circle bites at its four corners and two semicircular notches (about 52 px across) at top and bottom where a dashed vertical perforation at x≈932 splits a wide main panel from a narrow stub on the right. The main panel holds left-aligned type at x=322: two lines of small, wide-tracked grey caps ("Y COMBINATOR PRESENTS" / "STARTUP SCHOOL 2026"), a heavy condensed two-line name "EVE" / "BOUFFARD" in light grey (#c5c5c5), the line "FROM: SAN FRANCISCO, CA, USA" right under it, and "CHASE CENTER, SF · JULY 25–26" near the bottom. The stub carries a giant "2026" set rotated 90° clockwise in flat dark grey (#363636), with a monospaced "ADMIT ONE" in mid-grey running vertically over it. Nothing moves until the cursor enters at ≈0.3s. From then on the card tilts slightly in 3D toward the pointer (edges skew by about 4–12 px, perspective, not a flat translation), and the pointer paints a soft, glowing heat-map trail into the card: a blurred fluid blob with a red-orange core, yellow and cyan rings, and a deep-blue halo. The blob trails behind the cursor, stretches into ribbons, and diffuses over about a second. It is clipped to the ticket shape and never spills onto the page. Where the heat passes over the type, the letters take on an opposite-palette fill (gold, brown, navy, teal) instead of being covered. The pointer sweeps across the main panel and stub from 0.3s to about 18s. The colour piles up until the whole card is a royal-blue wash (#1f2d7c) with every text line gold (#c8b040), apart from a cream "CHASE CENTER" line. After the cursor leaves to the top right at about 18s, the card settles flat in that blue-and-gold state and holds there until 20.5s, with only a faint slow drift in the blue.

1y5exc-dark-pro-welcome-modal.summary: A single dark modal (640x870, ~32px radius, #1d1d1d lower panel) is centred on a near-black #0a0a0a page. From ~3s a cursor moves over the card and the card follows it with a small 3D perspective tilt (edges skew a few px). As it tilts, the foil's rainbow band (pink/green/violet, grainy and posterised, over a horizontally brushed silver-lilac base) slides across the card. The modal's text, button, close and reader never move.

5h6d0-hero-intro-animation.summary: A light SaaS hero for Context.dev on a 2110x1080 browser capture. Top to bottom: a 49px announcement bar with a grainy blue-to-violet gradient and white centred text; a white 100px nav (logo left, grey pill holding five links centred, outlined "Book a Call" and black "Sign Up" pills right) with a hairline border at y≈148; four dashed vertical guide lines at x≈149, 288, 1822, 1961; a centred stack of a "Backed by [Y] Combinator" eyebrow, a two-line ~76px black headline with "{API}" and "AI agents" in royal blue, a grey subhead, and a 1256px wide white translucent card. The card holds a tab row of 8 tabs with Extract active, and a pale-blue URL input with a black round go button. Under the card sits a white CTA line. Behind everything the page background runs vertically from near-white (#fcfcfc) at the top through pale blue (#c9d9f4 at y≈620) to saturated royal blue (#4a65d9 at y≈910, #2d42b3 at the bottom). The lower ~260px is a WebGL water shader. At 0.5s it reads as flat, choppy, wind-rippled patches of darker and lighter blue. It grows into a glossy, liquid-glass surface: large rounded swells with dark violet troughs and thin bright specular crests. Its motion is strongest around 1.5–2s, slows through 4–4.5s and freezes from about 4.5s to the end (7.57s). Separately, the URL placeholder after a fixed dark "https://" types and deletes domains in light grey: "st"…, "lin", "linear.app" (2.5s), deleted back to "line" (3.75s), then "not" (4.25s) and "notion.com" (6s). Nothing else moves. Nav, headline, card and cursor are static throughout.

1eucu6-paper-plane-scroll-toc.summary: A single "On this page" table of contents sits left-of-centre on a flat near-black (#101010) page, with no card or panel behind it. A three-line hamburger icon and the grey heading "On this page" (about 34px sans, x 712, y 160) sit above eight entries. There are three indent levels: Installation, Usage and Features at text x 709 with node x 668; Prerequisites, Installation Steps, Configuration and Customizing Content at x 748 with node x 708; Submenu Content at x 788 with node x 747. The rows are spaced 89–90px apart, from y 286 to 913. One continuous rail joins the nodes. It runs straight down within each level and takes short 45° diagonals where the indent changes, and a short lead-in stub rises above Installation. Before the indicator reaches a part of the rail, that part is a faint grey dashed line and its nodes are hollow grey rings (~18px, ~3px stroke). Once passed, that part becomes a solid grey ~3px line and its nodes become filled grey dots (~20px). The indicator is a flat white paper-plane dart (~34×40px, notched tail, no outline, no shadow). It flies along the rail, rotating to point the way it travels: down on the verticals, diagonal on the slants, and up/back when the reader scrolls back up. The active section's label turns bright white (~#f0f0f0) and the previously active one fades back to mid grey (~#8a8a8a). In the clip the plane flies from Installation down through every entry to Features (~0–5.4s), returns up to Installation (~6–9.6s), and after a layout cut at ~9.8s (whole TOC shifts down ~23px) flies down again (~10–15.5s), then back and forth for the rest. Each hop between neighbouring entries takes ~0.4–0.6s, and the solid line fills in behind the plane. The mouse cursor stays mostly parked near (1020, 612).
